tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// yi dam rta mgrin dmar po dang mdun bskyed dbang phyug 'dod rgyal dmar po'i 'don 'grigs rat+na'i do shal bzhugs soḥ

cu // na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye/ rgyal kun gsung gi zla gzhon las/ mtshan dpe'i ku mud 'dzum pa yi/ pad+ma dbang gi lhar btud nas 'don 'grigs rat+na'i do shal spel: deyang dkyil 'khor rtsa gsum sgrub gtor dang/ g.yang phor g.yang rgye bla rdo srog 'khor rnams/ mchod gtor bsang shug mda' dar tshe bum bcas/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzasakun bsags te/ chos spyod sogs rgyun srol ltar byasal/de nas ngo bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la rnams pa o rgyan rin po che'i rgyan cha lugs yongs rdzogs ma 'dres par gsal bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ hūṃ : snyen rgyan yul gyi sogs sidhi hūṃḥ gsol 'debs rnam gsum ni/ yi/marde sku gsum ston pa sogs regag skye ba kun tu yang dag sogs regag bdag bskyed rgya snyi wa'i lhan 'thabasamu tag phreng mdzes las bsang chu byin rlabs ni/ hri: bsang chu tshanadamigs sogs sngags nyer gcig dang / lha nyid 'od zhu sogs dmigs: mchod rdzasabyin rlabs dang spos byung rnaḥ / bisnan ta sogs nge ye swā snya gsol 'debs gang rung dang / rol mo byin rlabs ni/ sgo ma ha badz+ra dzñā na sogs a hūṃ: skyabs yul bskyed pa ni snyen ma ha shu n+ya sogs rab mos te gzhung las/ na ma : gdod nas ma ngakhresas sogs gsal stong bsgom ldeb shar la tshogasabasags maṇ+ḍal ni/

ra༅༅// na mo: gsung mchog pad+ma sogs āX/: dza hūṃ baṃ hoX tshogs zhing rnams sogs gyur: dkar dmar gtor 'bul ni/ sā snya wa sogs sa ma yā: bgegs gtor bsngo ba na/swā bha wa hūṃX las sogs phaṭa suhā bka' bsgo ni/ hūṃ hrī: gdod nas rnam dag sogs phaṭa: gong gi glud gtor 'dod yon sogs phaṭa: / bzhi'i sngags dang thub gyi brab/ srung 'khor ni/hrīḥ phyogs mtha' mi dmigs sogs rak+ṣa hūṃ: ye rdzogs bgegs gsum dang / byin 'bebs ni/ hūṃ trīX mi gnas zla gam sogs ā: mchod pa byin rlabs ni 61 ā2) : dbang po yul gyi sogs mchog thob re ga nyer ru ga'i yig brgya da / 'dzab dmigs ni hūṃ hrīX bde chen dbang drag sogs dgongs pa'i ngang: bgrangs phreng byin rlabs ni oṃ sarba dharmā sogs dmigs sngags nyer gcig dang dbyang gsal rten snying gi rab tu gnas/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum da / lhag chad kha bska na/ dbang 3 na bdud dasdo/nga sogs shākyar cig dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying bcas gsuma'adod gsol na/ ho: bdud dpung zil gnon sogs a la la ho: mchod bstod ni/ hā hrīḥ bde stong mnyam nyid sogs sangs rgyas shog trī: dge ba 'di yis bdud dpung zil

gnon sogs sgo ga 'di ltar bskyed rdzogs sogs 31ga tshogs la nyamasachagasabashagasapa ni rang snang ye shes sogs dza: ye: tha snyad mtshan ma'i sogs bshag yig brgya rdzas bskang zhe sa hrī bde stong spros bral sogs sor bzhes tshogs bsdus ni hūṃ hrī: lhan skyes rdo rje sogs 31ga ci 'thub dang / sa twa ci nus bzlas rjes yig brgya rje btsun bla ma sa twa yig brgyastodam tshig nyams chags sogs re/ga nam mkha'i mthar thug sogs thegag tshogs mchad bsod nams sprin kung las hūṃ hrī: chos nyid sgyu ma sogs pu dza kha tī: bskang dzos byin rlabs ni sarba dharmā ga sogs gyur cig/ rten snying lan bdun gyis spel bskang rdzas rnams 'phags pa sogs gyur dgyesabaskang na hūṃ tī: ka dag spros bral sogs ā hūṃ hrī mtha' bral sogs bar bshags ni nyo: lta ba dman zhing sogs ā: yig brgya tshogasa'agugs ni dzapags spyodad lcags khe shākya sogs rba ho: lan gsum bsgral bstabasan hūṃ bh+yo: dbang chen zla gam sogs kha hi: gnam phud ni hūṃ hri: 'og min gnas dang sogs shog tshogasal rol ba ni nyo: bde bar gshegs so sogs la ho: bsam lhun gang spro brjod he ru ka dpal sogs

༄༅// sgo ga lhag ma byin rlabs na/ s+t+waṃḥbhañdza ka pa sogs ha he ho: gzhung las/ bh+yoḥ rdo rje khrag 'thung pad+ma sogs kha hi: tshogs mchod phul bas sogs thob re ga de nas mdun bskyed 'dod rgyal dmar po sgrub pa la/ 'gorje mnan 'gong bkar 'gab 'dre mnan khrus gsol bya zhing g.yang bsang gto / dang po bka' srung rten dbab ni/ na 31: dasko na mchog gsum dang sogs gyur cigaḥ ye dharma he sogs ma khyo: lan gsum/ dkon mchog gsum gyis bden pa sogs gyur cig gtor ma byin rlabs ni/ stong pa'i ngang las āsapas sogs ho zab sgrub dbang gi gter bum las sa rang nyid pad+ma dbang chen sogs sa ma yā dza dza: rten 'jug ni/ kye: rgya tshad las sogs sa ma yāX bzhugs gsol ni/ hū hrī: dad pa dam tshig sogs tiṣ+ṭha lhan:mnga' gsol bde chen rol mtsho ni/ hrīḥ kun byed mkhan po sogs skyel ma mdzod zab sgrub phyag 'tshal ni/ hrī: srid na mtshungs bral sogs sarba sa ma yā āḥhūṃ bsang gsol bdud rtsi'i spran phung las trī dza: khams sum 17nga khyer sogs sa ma yā: bska gsol yid 'dod char 'beb las hrī dza: stong dbyings nam mkhar sogs bkra shis regag lam lha gnyer bcol bsam don lhun

grub ni/ hrī dza: lha min dmag bzlog sogs phun tshogs 31ga yon 'bul yid bzhin nor bu ni/ zu chos dbyings mi 'gyur sogs/ phrin las mdzod: phrin las dab sdud lcags kyu ni/trī:ting 'dzin dbang phyug nam mkha'i sogs dza yan+tu: gnyer gam na trī dza: lha dbang lha yi sogs phun tshogs mdzod: g.yang 'bod dbang gi lcags kyu ni trī dza: 'bod do dbang gi sogs mdzod cig g.yang 'bod bsdus pa ni kye lha yi bla ma sogs sho lo ka zab sgrub las bstod pa ni/ hūṃ trī: ting 'dzin dbang phyug sogs du gsol bshags pa nirta bde ba chen po'i sogs sa ma mā a: yag brgya dang / 'dzab dmigs ni/ bdag nyid pad+ma dbang sogs bsnyen sgrub las gsum skabs bstun byas la/ gtor rdzas byin rlabs ni/ rdo dgongs su gsol 21: dbang phyug sogs dza dza: sngags drug phyag drug gis spel gsol mchod pad+ma'i lcags kyu na trī dza: 11sa bzang lha yi sogs sa ma yā: grangs bsogs mthar/ gsol mchod dbang gi lcags kyu ni/ kye: ting 'dzin dbang phyug sogs phobs/ ci mang bskyar zu 'dod 'byung dpal ster sogs (3 ma hā de wa sogs hūṃ ༷ dbang phyug chen po sogs sa ma yā: 'byugs bska ni/hrī dza khams sum lha

༄༅// yi sogs sa ma yā: grangs bsog mthar zab sgrub las mchod bstod na/ hū hrī: dga' bzhi'i dbang phyug sogs g.yog 'khor bcas la bstod: rten bzhugs ni hū hrī nying 'jin dbang phyug sogs tiṣ+ṭha lhan: rten snying brjod la 33 'dir ni sogs swā hā: spro na rang lugs kyi gsol kha dang / gter srung yongs rdzogs kyi gsol mchod ni/ bho rdo rje khrag 'thung sogs phrin bcol na kyiḥ skye med nam mkha'i sogs bzhed don stsol: gang zhig yid la sogs rgyal ba kun gyi sogs pad+ma'i ring lugs sogs rgyal dbang pad+ma'i sogs sangasargyas kyi bstan pa sogs 11na tshe ces rgyan sogs sa dre/gas sogs du gathegal: de nas nor sgrub dbang ga lcags kyu las thog mar rmang sri bkar ba ni/ bca' tshogs gzhung ltar grub byas la che/ dasko na macesag gsum sogs lam bstan mjug gi ta ya phaṭa: las byang gzhung gi bka' bgo ni/hū trī: gdod nas rnam dag sogs phaṭa: / bzhis sngags dang thun gyis brab/ srung gur ni hrī phyogs mtha' mi dmigs sogs rak+ṣa hūṃ: khrus chab gsol ba ni/ hūḥ 'byung ba chen po sogs gzhu sa ltar rten bzhugs mjug tu mchod stod bya bsngo smon ni na mo bsod nams sogs

'tsho ba'i bkra shis regag de nas tshogs la nyams chags bshags pa ni/ rang snang ye shes sogs khaṃ: kye dbang phyug 'dod rgyal sogs sa ma yā ā yig brgya dang tshogs bsdus skabs bstun bya/rje btsun bla ma sogs sa twa ci 'grub dang yig brgya bcas/ ho dam tshig nyams chags sogs nam kha'i mthar thugs sogs 31ga tshogs mchod bsod nams char 'bebs ni/ /: rig pa'i rang mdangs sogs kha twe: bskang ba yid bzhin sprin 'khrigs ni/ hū trī: khams gsum dbang bsgyur sogs yā: bskang bsdus ni/ e: yang gcig thugs dam sogs 31ga b.rabashagasan ho blo chung rtog sogs ā: tshogs 'gugs ni 37gas byedad lcags khang sogs ho: lan gsum bsgral las na/ /: snying rje'i 'gal zla sogs tsit+ta la kha nyi: tshogasal rol/bsam lhun gang spro dang he ru ka dpal sogs 37ga lhag ma byin rlabs ni/ sbyo bhaji ka pa sogs he ho: gzhung las/ bh+yo: rgyal ba kun dngos sogs bā ling ta kha hi chogs mchod phul bas sogs sa thob shog bskul ba ni/ hi ya bde stong spros bral sogs dam can: 'dod rgyal las/hrī dza: ting 'dzin 'phrul snang sogs sa ma yā yang na/ hrī ma

༄byubyu// chags pad+ma sogs yā:chad mod byin rlabs ni/ āX las bhan+ta sogs ha ho hrī: gzhung las/hū bh+yo:thog mtha' bar gsum sogs sa ma yā: 'dod rgyal las/bh+yo dza nga khyer sum sogs las mdzod: bstan gtor byin rlabs ni/bdag nyid pad+ma sogs ha ho trī gzhung las bh+yo:tshogs bdag bka' yi sogs khā hi: 'dod rgyal las/ bh+yo:rlung gi rjes 'gro sogs sa ma mā:bro 'gugs ni gtor gzhong kha sogs bar bsam:gzhung las/hū trīḥrang bzhin rnam par sogs nan:'dod rgyal las/hū:e nyid stong pa sogs nan: lhan thabs las gtor gzhong rat+na sogs ye swā hā: bdag mdun gyi gnas sogs la: 〉snye dngos su 'byor sogs mchod: 37 pad+ma kro ta h+ya snyi wa ma hā de wa a sogs bha ling ta kha tī slar yang rdo rje'i rig ma sogs bsam la:hrī:ma bcos spros bral sogs bstod hū hrī:dbang chen bde ba'i sogs bstod:hū hrī:khams gsum dbang bsgyur sogs bstod:trī: bka' rgyud bla ma sogs bstod: bstod par 'os sogs bstod:slar dga' ston sogs bhi shu dhe ā:ho:gnyis 'dzin sogs ā

ho golasgrib sogs gsol: dbyangs gsal yig brgya/ lan gsum/ bsngo smon ni/ hūṃ hrī: tha snyad mtshan ma'i sogs thegag lan gsum/ ho: 'dusam byas pa sogs gyur cig lan gsum/brten bzhugs ni/hoḥ lus sems sogs hūṃ: rdo rje sa bzungs ba ni/ a ā: sa ma17ga 'od gsal sogs bzhag ho: tha snyad mtshan ma'i sogs phaṭa: rtsa sngags rten snying gcig bkrashis ni gong gi rang gi snying ga sogs gyur: gzhung las/ na mo dbang chen bde ba'i sogs na mo: kun gzhi phra rag sogs bkra shis shog ston pa 'jig rten sogs bstan pa'i sogs gnas 'dir sogs 'byung po gang sogs su dza ya: sogs de ltar du sogs gyur cig sangs rgyas bstan sogs mtha' sdud smon lam sogasargyun srol ltar ro/ ༈ zinanyin ni/ gong gi mchod bstod bsdus pa dang maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma sogs gang skabasadang bstun/ dngos grub ni/ hūṃ trī: mi gnas ye shes sogs la ho: hrī: 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs sogs sirnyi hrī las byang gi mchod bstod hūṃhrī: bde stong mnyam nyid sogs thugs la bstod tshe 'gugs ni/ bdag nyid dam tshog gi sogs smon lam mjug gi byin regag g.yang gtad ni/ 36 dam/na

༄༅// mchog rin chen sogs/tram̐:bden tshig grub pa'i smon lam bawas g.yang sgo sdom min skab bstun bya/tshe 'gugasamajug gi shis brjod niho bde ba chen po'i sogs bkra shis stsol bsod nams ri bo bsang gsol bdud rtsi'i sprin phung ni/sngagasadrug phyag drug gisaspel la/hrī dza:khamasasum grong khyer sogs yā gzhan bsang ci rigasadang ho dbo ngas su gsol sogs dza dzahrī:dza:chos bzang lha yi sogs kyi:ting 'dzin dbang phyug sogs bh+yo:rdo rje khrag 'thung sogs rlu rta bskyed pa sog bya zab sgrub lasamaja bstod ni/hū hrīdaga' bzhi'i dbang phyug g.yog 'bor 4sal bstod 'phrin bcol ni/rkye:skye med nam mkha'i sogs stsol:bshagasapa ni/ho:bde ba chen po'i sogs ā:yig brgya 'ur bzhag bya'o/bsngo smon ni/ho:rnams dkar dge sogs regagalan gsum tshogs 'jug bzod gsol nas bzungs bkra shis yan sngar ltar mthar chags su bya'o/bsreg blug sogs go sla'o/slar smras pa/rmad byung zab gter chu bo bdun ldan las/pad+ma dbang gi lha tshogasasgrub pa yi/'don 'grigs rat+na'i do shal spel ba'i dges/bstan 'dzan zhabs brtan bstan pa dar rgyas shogaces ragasasras pad+ma theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyisabaka' mngag bzhin dung dkar ba dgung los bris pa maṅga le/
ze zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:dbang chen zil gnon rtsal gyi spros med don gyi myur lam bde stong 'ub chub kyi lhan thabs zur bkol mu tig phreng mdzes bzhugs/

zejedazang na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye pad+ma bde klong rol ba' dkyil 'khor ni spros pa'i mtha' dang bral la phyag 'tshal lo dbang chen sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor skal ldan rgyas sgrub pa'i cha lag 'di nyid gces par zungs sa ma yu dang po bsang chu byin rlabs ni trī: bsang chu mi dmig stong pa'i ngang nyid las: khro bo rdo rje bgegs tshogs 'thar byed dang: khro mo rlung 'byin shes rab gsang ba'i yum rigasakyi zhal gsang bde ba chen por spyor: rdo rje rdul gyi spro bsdu 'khrigs pa las: 'byung po dam sri 'thar zhing brlags byed cing: ye shes bdud rtsi'i rol bar bsgyur byed kyi: nus mthu gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par gyur: hūṃ bisnan ta kṛt+ta tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa: nyer gcig brjod la gzi byin nus mthu bskyed lha nyed 'od zhu bdud rtsa'i rol bar dmigs gnyis pa mchod rdzas byan rlabasan hūṃ bisnan ta kṛta sogs phaṭa: swā bha sogs mchod rdzas mi dmigs stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las phyi mchod nyer spyod bdun: nyon mongs rang grol nang mchoda'adod yon lnga: dug gsum rang grol sman raka gtor gsum dang rdo rje rig ma mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur ngom sbor smol byang sems mchod pa bsam mtha' yas: dngos 'dzin

(1 mtshan rtog spros pa rnam dag cing: kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa phun tshogs gyur: ma badz+ra spra ra ṇa khaṃ gsum pa spos byung ni hū dhi:tsan ldan a gar seng ha lasogs pa'i: bzang po drug ldan bdug pa spos kyi dri: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i byin rlabs pa'i: tshul khrims bzang po'i dri bsung 'thul ba yis: gnyis 'dzin rnam rtog drim bsang sbyangs byed: saṃ sa le sang nge ye swā hā: rol mo byin rlabs na 31 ma hā badz+ra dzñā na sa ma ya hūṃ rlu:hrī:snang ba ma 'gags thabs kyis rdo rje dang: tshang dbyangs 'gag med shesarab dril bu'i sgra: thabs shes zung 'jug rol mos don kun 'grub: bde mchog yab yum thod rnga ḍā ma sa chos sgras stong khyab ye shes rnga bo che: bcu drug bde ba'i rol ston glum zung ro mnyam 'khyug ma sdong po brgya ba'i sgra: pho nya 'bod pa'i mchog chen rkang gling dang kha grag mogs bskul rgyang khyab skad po che ma tshogs bskul ba'i g.yel phreng tingating shag gsang ba'i bshugs glu nye ba'i phag sdob pa: thams cad kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin te: lha tshogs chos sku'i dbyings las gzugs skur bskul grags stong rdo

rje'i chos sgras khams gsum khyab: 'khrul ba ru bzlog ye shes dbyings su bsre: gsang chen sngags kyi spyod pa bla na med: bla badz+ra sharte spra ra ṇa sa ma yā ā:hūṃ: rol ma'i rdul spruganyes skyon sbyangs chos nyid gsung gis dbang chen bskul sa ma yu lnga pa skyabs yul bskyed pa ni snyen ma hā shu rgya: sogs ko3 nya: tshogadachags ka dag chos sku'i rol pa las: rang mdun nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng: bde bshegs kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma 'byung: snang srid zil gnon ye shes sgyu ma'i sku: lta stangs gzir bas sde brgyad zil gyis gnon: rgya bod lo paṇa rig 'dzin spro bsdu 'gyed: g.yas su rgyal ba shākya seng gel: bskal ba bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong gis bskor: rgyab tuyum chen bsda rab phar phyin la: lung dang rtogs pa'i dam chos rnams kyis bskor: g.yon du 'phags pa byams pa mgon po la: sa gnas byang sems rig 'dzin tshogs kyis bskor: mdun du yi dam dbang chen yab yum la yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i 'khor kyis bskor: bar mtshams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rnams: nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin ma 'dres lam mer rdzogs: kun kyiganas gsum rdo

ze rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas: phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan rnam pa dra spyan drangs dbyer med bde ba chen por bsre mkhyen brtse nus pas skal ldan sgrub pa por: zhal gyis phyogs la spyan gyis rab gzigs te: rtag par byin gyi brlabs par rab mos te: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshogs bsags maṇ+ḍalaphul dza hūṃ baṃ ho: tshogs zhing rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rgyud smin cing grol bar gyur: drug pa dkar gtor 'bul ba ni rang nyid 'jag rten dbang phyug gi bskyed rim ting 'dzin gnad ldanapas gtor ma sbyang spel bsgyur ba ni yo swā bha was sbyangs treḥlas rin chen yangs pa'i sgod nang du: gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsir gyur: a ka ro yas zad med spel dza hū phyag rgyas mgron rnams bkugs kyi: stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten dbang bsgyur ba'i: rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs dam tshig can dkar phyogs skyong mdzad pho mo ma ning rigs: ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol gtsang sbyar gtor ma gser skyems mchod pa bzhes: rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi phrin las sgrubs dbang chen sa yi lha

mo bstan ma dang: sa bdag lto 'bye tsang kun mched bzhi dang: lo zla zhag dus rgyal blon 'bangs 'khor tshul dam tshig can rnams gnas 'dir gshegs gtsang sbyar gtor mogaser skyems mchod pa bzhes: rin chen sa 'di bdag la stsal du gsol: khyad par yul gzhi skyong ba'i dam tshigs can: mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon rdza brag na ba lam: gang la rten bcas gnyug gnas glo bur lhag ma lus 'khor bcas sngon gyi dam tshig bzhin: sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs gtsang sbyar gtor ma sgrub pa'i rkyen bzlogamathun snang legs tshogs sbyor bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā snu mi pa tis pa ri wā ra e rda bha ling ta kha kha kha hi kha tī: lan bdun gyas phul gtor skyem mchod phrin las sgrub cesakhas blangs bsam bdun pa dmar gtor 'bul ba na swā bha was sbyangs sbyo las rin chen yangs pa'i snod nang du: slo las gtor ma 'dod yon phung por gyur: nam mkha' mdzod sngags gsum rgyasaspel dzaḥ/ phyag rgyas pho nya bkugs hūṃ trī: sngon tsho o rgyan pad+ma thod phreng gis: bka' dam la bzhag dregs pa'i tshul 'dzin pa: sde brgyad gza' the'u rang rang g.yog 'khor bcas:

(1 dam tshig gnas 'dir 'bod do da tshur byon: sha khrag dmar gyi mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: 'dre srin gdug pa'i mgo 'phang dma' bar mdzod sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen nyer 'tshe tha dag bzlog mthun snang legs tshogs dpal 'byor dngos po stsol: bcol ba'i brin las ma g.yel sa ma yu: ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs phrinalas sgrub ces khas blangs bsam brgyad pa bgegs gtor bsngo ba ni swā bha wa yis stong par sbyangs sbyo las rin chen snod du 31 yig las: glud kyi gtor ma zag med bdud rtsir gyur: 61 ā(3 sam bha ra yis zad med spel oṃ ka ro yis bdud rtsir bsgyur gzhung bzhin bka' bsgo btang ba' rjes 'dod yon gtor ma bsngo ba ni glud gtor 'dod yon lnga ldan 'di: gsang sngags sgrub la 'tshe ba'i bdud: dug gsum rang mdangs 'byung po ni: sha khrag za zhing mtshan mor rgyu: sgrub pa'i drod la 'gab 'dre byed: rnal 'byor tshe srog mdangs la za snyan 'gyur rol mo'i sgra la 'jab: bdud rtsi sman gyi bcud la re: dpal gyi gtor chen rtsi la 'jib: rak+ta a mdangs la blta zhun chen snang gsal 'od nyams byed: dri zhim bdug pa'i ngad

pa 'phrog chag sgo nyer 'tshe sgong byed pa'i: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang: byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga po: nad rims yams kyi bdag mo sogs bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po rnams: lan chags glud gtor 'di khyer la: rang rang so so'i gnas su dengs: gal temi'agro 'tsho gyur na ye shes khro bos nam mkha' gang: dam tshig khro bos sa gzhi gang: 'bar ba'i khro bos bar snang khyab: dbang chen rta yi brtul zhugs kyis: khyed rnams lus srog dngos po 'thar: de bas da lta byir dengs shig: nyu /:u tsu ta ya phaṭa: / bzhi'i sngags brjod thun gyi brab lta stang bgrad cing brtul zhugs bskyed sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen brlag par byed dgu pa phreng ba byin rlabs ni snyen sabo dharmā ga ga na yi :snyedang pa(pengang las bgrang phreng rnams: bde gshegs zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyir 'khor du gsal: phreng lung ye shes lnga yi zer thag gi lu gu rgyud du 'brel bar bsam kun kyang nyams bde ba chen po'igazi byin 'bar te: gsung chos nyid rang sgra sgogs bzhin rdo rje'i rtse gar bsgyur nas 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i mdzad pa lhun gyis grub par dmigs oṃ ru tsu ra ma ṇi pra waju na ye

snajeX swā hā: nyer gcig brjod la dbyangs gsal da rten 'brel snyang po' gzi byin bskyed sa ma mā dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi lha tshogs thams cad 'grub par gyur cig: dbyangs gsal yag brgya rten snya gis lhag chad bskang 'dod gsol na ho bdud dpung zil gnon gyi rgyal po dbang chen pad ma gsung gi lha tshogs khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes: brtse ba'i thugs rje: mdzad pa'i phrin las: skyobs pa'i nus mthu: sgrol ba'i 'dren stobs: 'dul ba'i brtul zhugs: bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas bdag cag sgrub pa po rnams la mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub thams cad dang: bde stong mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i 'od gsal chen po mngon du gyur ba'i dngos grub dam pa dus da lta nyid du rtsol bar mdzad du gsol: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni sarba sirnyi pha la a la la ho: bcu pa bska rdzas byan rlabs na sarba dharmā ga ga na a: ste nga pa'i ngang las mkha' dbyings rnam par dag pa'i klong du: ye shes sgyu 'phrul gyi rol rtsed bsgyur ba: rang byung bhan+ta ka pā la stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du: tshogs rdzas snod bcud 'dod yon gyi dngos po

thams cad: zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rol ba chen por bsgyur te: steng lha yi dga' ston blo yis mi dpog pa: bar mi yi longs spyod tshad bzung dang bral ba: 'og klu yi dpal 'byor zad mtha' las 'das pa: ngo mtshar ba'i rdo rje'i rig ma bcu drugaḥ dgyes bskang gi mchod sprin kun tu bzang po'i rol pa: dus 'khor ba ci srid ma stong gi bar du yul dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor rab 'byams: dgyes pa bskyed pa'i 'phrin las zad pa med pa'i dpal ting 'dzan rdo rje'i rol ston mtha' yas pa 'byung bar gyur cig rten snying lan bdun dang bcas te ting nge 'dzan gyis bskangs rdzas spel sa ma yu bcu gcig pa tshogs 'gugasabya ba ni snangagathangaspyodad lcags khang sdo/ gas ma 'bar ba'i nang du: 31gas rdzas dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad dngos su gsal la: na mo mchog gsum rtsa gsum sku gsum bden gnyis baglu ba med pa'i bden pa'i mthus: spyir mchog gsum bstan pa'i spyi dgra bshes gnyen dam pa'i sku dgra: khyad par du bskyed rdzogs ting nge 'dzin la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la khug cig rtsim badz+ra e gu

(1 sha dza dza:hūṃ baṃ ho lan gsum brjod la tshogs bsgral bya bcu gnyis pa lhag ma byin rlabs ni spyo bha3 ka pā la hūṃ bha3 ljang bla can yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du mang sa rak+ta cit+ta kai ni ri ti ho gti mug gi rang bzhin gcod pa'i mang sa sha yi ri bo: 'dod chags kyi mtshan ma bcom pa'i rak+ta khrag gi rgya mtsho: zhe sdang gi rtog pa gcod pa'i tsit+ta snyingagi dga' ston: mtshan bcas kyi 'khrul ba dbyings su gcod pa'i kau ni ri ti rus pa'i gram khrod chen po gcig tu gyur ma āhūṃha ho hrī: lan gsum brjod:ho:rdo rje gsang ba'i pho nyadabang phyug ma sring king dang la thams cad: rdo rje'i bshud pas bskul lo: sngags tshig glu yis 'bod do: zhing chen g.yab mos mtshon no: dpal gyi gtor mas brngan no rdo rje'i tha tshig bsgrag go: dam tshig gnyan gyis drangs so: gsang ba las kyi dkyir 'khor chen po 'dir: e a ra li pho po : bdag nyid pad+ma dbang chen gsal ba'i ya rkan zlaba'i dkyil 'khor lce nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dam tshig gi chu bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin can: ya so dpa' bo pho tshogs kyis bskul: ma so shes rab ma tshogs kyis dbab: rdzas

pham phab bka' yi gtor ma: dam tshig sgog gcig tu bsre bar byed pa'i rang bzhin du gyur: trī ha ho dzñā na pañtsa trī: yang dbang chen gyispyogatsug nas rta skad theng gsum bton pas dregs pa las la bskul: sde brgyad dam la btags: zhing bcu sgrol ba'i las kyi gnyer gtad do yum rdo rje phag mo'i dbu gtsug nas phag skad lnga ngur bas 'khor ba'i chos la gad mo bsgrag ma rig ru ṭa'i dpa' bskong: log 'dren 'byung po'i smra phab shes rab bde ba'i dbyings bskul: rak+ta tshal gsum gyi dgongs pa'i phrin las lhun gyis grub par bsam: pad+ma sa ma ya ha he ho: gzhung ltar lag gtor rgyas par 'bul bcu gsum pa gtor ma byin rlabs na ā las bhan+ta yangs shing rgya chen po'i snod du: gtor ma gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad dngos su gsal la: na moḥ brgyud pa drug ldan bla ma dam pa dang: yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho lhag pa'i lha: gnas gsum ma dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang pho nya bstan srung dam can nor lha'i tshogs: bden gnyis baspu ba med pa'i bden mthu yis: sangs rgyas bstan dgra dkon mchog spri dgra dang: dge 'dun dgos dgra sngags 'chang

the dam dgra dang: skye rgu yongs la 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs: bsam ngan sbyor rtsub log pa'i blo ngan can ngan song rgyu 'grub thar med las ngan rnams khug cig badz+ra e gu sha ya dza: ske nas 'chang shig badz+ra pa sha shā: yan lag sdom shig badz+ra spro tra baṃ myos par gyis shig badz+ra gaste ho: phyes shigabadz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭa: dbyer med bstims shig a we sha ya ā: zhes brjod pas dgra bgegs kyi phung khams dum bur gtub ste rnam shes ā dkar po dri ma med pa'i rnam par mdun bskyed lha yi thugs gar bstims te sangs rgyas: tshe bsod nams rtsi:yig ljang gu'i rnam par rang la bstims te bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rgyas: gzugs phung khrol gyis zhig te sha yi ri bo khrag gi rgya mtsho rus pa'i 'gram khrod chen po ngo bo zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur: o ā ༷hūṃ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum brjod la pha mdo gtong bcu gnyis pa bstan gtor byan rlabs ni bdag nyid pad+ma dbang chen kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas: mi sdug khro zhal ma'i bu mo bdud mo mched bzhi dang: dkar gsal bzhin bzang ma'i bu mo gnod sbyin

ma bzhi dang: sman btsun bde ba gzugs legs ma'i bu mo sman mo mched bzhi rnams rang rang g.yog 'khor sprul ba dpung dang bcas pa rnams skad cig gis byon te da la'irgyab tu dar gyi yol ba bkram pa'i phag tu dbu 'phang dma' la dpa' zhum pa'i tshul gyis 'dar yed yed du gnas par gyur rin po che'i sgod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bshal chu'i gtor ma zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur: sa āXhūṃ ha ho ༷ lan gsum brjod la bstan gtor 'bul bco lnga pa bro 'gugs bya ba ni gtor gzhong kha sbubs pa dang mnyam du mi mthun pa'i phyogs dam sri 'byung po thams cad nub par gyur na mo: mchog gsum rtsa gsum sku gsum bden gnyis basmu ba med pa'i mthus sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i gnod byed dam sri nyul le mi la spun dgu bse rag pho mo thams cad chos nyid e yi sgrom du khug cig badz+ra o gu sha ya dza: rat+na pa sha hūṃ pad+ma sbo ṭa baṃ: karma garnye ho: gnod byed dam sri pho mo sa rim pa dgu'i mar zhabs: 'chi bdag las gshin pho mo'i lto ba gru gsum e yi btson khang 'bar ba'i nang du pho rnams

the kha sbubs mo rnams gan rkyal gyi tshul du gnas pa la: rkang pa lcags gzer gyis rgyas gdab ste: 'phar sdang 'gul bskyod mi nus par bde ba'i ngang dubargyal bar bsam gzhung gi bro mnan ba'o gtor gzhong rat+na mjes pa'i snod yar bteg tshe: bdag cag rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dpal bsod nams snyanagrags thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngos bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig:spyo a yu pukhye dzñā na puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye swā hā: brgya drug pa mchod bstod rgyas spro na bdag mdun gyeganas rnams las spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med pa'i sku mdzes pas gar bsgyur zhing: phyag na kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin mtha' yas pa thogs te: dkyir 'khor lhatshogs rnams la dgyes mchod phul bar bsam la mchod pa rgyas par 'bul slar yang rdo rje'i rig ma rnams kyis: sku dam tshig gi phyag rgyas bro gar khrig khrig gsung chos kyiphyag rgyas bstod dbyangs 'ur 'ur/ thugs chos nyid kyi phyag rgyas ye shes klong sbyor mnyam mnyam: yon tan phrin las kyi phyag rgya sna tshogs par drangs te lha tshogs rnams la

bstod pa glu yi mchod pa 'bul bar bsam la: bstod pa rgyas par bya slar dga' ston 'gyed pa mo thams cad bdag mdun gyi gnas so sor thim pas dbang byin dngos grub 'phel zhing rgyas par bsam la: bcu bdun pa bzod gsol 'bul ba ni ho: dbang chen pad+ma gsung dzagadakyil 'khor thams cad thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs su gsol: 'dir tshogs rnal 'byor pho mo rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin bying rmugs su gyur pa dang rtog pa 'i gol sgrib ma chod par bag med 2brul ba'i spyod par 'phyan pa dang: bde ba chen po'i ye shes dngadu ma blangs pa dang: mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i 'od gsal zab mo'i gdangs shor ba dang: tan gaṇa sbyor sgrol gyi dgongs pa dang du ma blangs pa dang dngos po bcu'i dam tshigayang dag par ma spyod pa dang: lta ba'i stangs dang sgom pa'i gdangs dang spyod pa bag med du shor ba la sogs: mdor na rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chags ral bathams cad mthol lo bshags so: mi 'chab po/ mi sded do: phyin chad srog gi slad du sdom par bgyid na: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol:sa ma ya snyi

re shuste.ā: dbyangs gsal yig brgya lan gsum brjod lhag chad kha bskang dag par bya sa ma mā bco brgyad pa rdo rje'i sa bzung ba na a ā: samachog 'od gsal rdo rje'i rtse mo dra bde ba'i mthar son dngas ma'i thig chen rnga ye shes gsang ba srog lnga'i dkyil 'khor klong: mtha' bral rta phag dgongs pa rtag par skyongs: zhes sdod bcud lha snang bde ba'i dkyil 'khor la de yang thugs srog nā da mtha' bral ngang: dpa' bo yab yum sku gsung thugs kyi mthil: 'od gsal spros dang bral bar ci gnas bzhag /dang po rtsal sbyang bar dungang la gnas tha ma nyag gcig dgongs par btsan sa zin sa ma wā bcu dgu pa bden tshag bskul ba ni rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros te phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi lha lam yongs su gang bar byon te: zhal nas bkra shis dge mtshan gyis glu dbyangs brjod cing: phyag nas me tog man dha ra ba'i char chen po bsnyil bar gyur: bkra shasabaden tshag rgya cher brjod me tog sil ma kun tu bkram bkra shis dge ston mdzes pa ra bya sgo 'dis don gnyis lhun grub byed sa ma yu ces pa 'ad nyid dbang chen gsung gi chos skor spros med don gyi nyams len bde stong 'ub

chub kyi cha lag tu dung dkar gsang sngags smin grol gling gi grwa gzugs 'dzin pa thub bstan grags pas zur bkol byas pa nyes 'gal gang mchisayi dam lha la bshags dge'o sarba maṅga le/(( rtsa sngags gong 'og ni oṃ pad+ma kro ta h+ya skṛ wa hi baṃ ma hā su ka sidhi pha la hūṃ: tshe ma hā de wa a pa ra tsit+ta u ma ga ga de wi ha ri ni sa bā su de ba sa ma mā:hring dza dza: yedharma he tu sogs

bas zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen pad+ma he ru ga'i phyi nang gsangaba'i zab sgrub rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i: gsol 'debs bdud dpung 'thar byed bzhugs so: ze na mo gu ru pad+ma kro ta rwa dza ya rwa ba dzaḥdza pad+ma dbang go mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba gdab pa ni e ma ho: bde chen dbang gi zhal bzang bzhad pa'i gar: dmar nag bzod dka'i rnam 'gyur khro gtum sgeg: gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung zil gnon pa'i: mthu rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: 'bar ba'i spyan rnams sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug: drag po hūṃ glus bdud dpung 'dar zhing sngangs gsol ba bdebs so bdud dpung zil gnon pa'i: mthu rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: rta skad bzhad pas sde brgyad dam la btag: ye shes me yis nyon mongs mtshan 'dzin bsreg: gsol ba bdebs so bdud dpung zil gnon pa'i: mthu rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: zhabs gnyis bsgrad bas bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon: dur khrod dpa' chas dpa' bo rtags su bgo gsol ba bdebs so

bdud dpung zil gnon pa'i: mthu rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: pho gdon 'thar byed thod dbyug ral gri gdengs: ma tshogs dam 'dogs thod khrag sbrul zhags bsdams: gsol ba bdebs so bdud dpung zil gnon pa'i: mthu rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: dpa' bo dgyes byed phag mo sku la 'khril: bde ba'i rang bzhin rtsa khams lha sku'i sprin: gsol ba bdebs so bdud dpung zil gnon pa'i: mthu rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: phyogs bzhi'i bdud 'dul khro chen rigs bzhi dang: gsung gi dkyil 'khor rab 'byams rgya mtsho la: gsol ba bdebs so bdud dpung zil gnon pa'i: mthu rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: rig sngags zhing skyesadapa' bo mkha' 'gro dang: dmu long rgyab 'brel pho nya dam can la gsol ba bdebs so bdud dpung zil gnon pa'i: mthu rtsal rmad du 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs:deng sang snyigs ma'i smag rum 'thug po ༄ chos byed skal bzang nyin skar las kyang dkon: nag pos gzengs bstod nyi rdul bas kyang 'thibs dam sri 'byung po nag phyogs

(1 za kha dar: dmag gzugs mtshon chas gzengs pa rtag tu g.yo: dgra yi kha dar nad dang mu ge 'tshubs: dus kyi tha ma las nyon smag rum 'dir: dbang chen pad+ma'i rjes 'jug skal bzang rnams: log lam bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal bar mdzod ma rig 'khrul ba'i 'dam las brgal du gsol: bzod dka' ngan 'gro'i 'phrang las bskyab tu gsol: dus kyi 'khrugs rtsod sna tshogs zhi bar mdzod 'jig rten rgud pa ma lus rab zhi nas: drag po pad+ma dbang chen he ru ga'i: gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul 'khor lor longs spyod nas: he ru ka dpal sras su byang chub regag: de ltar gsol btab dgongs rgyud byin rlabs 'jug bar chad g.yul rgyal don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub sa ma pā e ma rgyal ba' dab po pa d+ma sa bha wa'i tha 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs rkya zig le zab gsang rdor snying skor grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la bsnyems mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gzings pa lang pa'i tshe dpa' po khyod nyid 'dusapa rtsal du bzhengs skyes bu de dang gdam pa 'ad 'phrad nas 'gro don phrin las byang gi phyogs su rgyas 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma

'od du 'god bka' 'di srungs shig gnod sbyin btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor sbu gri gsum thugs sras rnams la sprod cig ging dmar nag sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gsol 'debs bdud dpung 'thar byed rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi ces pa 'a da'angalung zen sku skyes pad+ma bsod namasagrub pa'i rdo rjes bkra shis lha reg shin tu dge ba'i skyes ya mtshan can du mar bcas te nan tan chen pos bskur ngor 7 kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i ya ge pa ni lungazan chos kya bdag po nyid kyas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lo/

(( zab gsang rdo rje snying po las dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon gyi spros med don gyi nyams len la mkho ba'i gsol debs gzhan phan thugs rje'i nyi ma bzhugs so: na na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yi 057) dbang chen lha phyogs mdun rgya nam mkhar gsal mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol gdab ni em ho rdul bral bde chen rgyal po 'od mtha' yas dbang chen gsung gi rdo rje klu sgrub snying bde stong mchog rtsol pad+ma rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs so dgongs rgyud rtogs pa spor lhan skyes dbang chen gsang gsum mngon gyur shog:mi brjed gzung thob ye shes mtsho rgyal dang:grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal ba mchog dbyangs rtsal:smon lam mthu btsan rje 'bangs nyer lnga la gsol ba 'debs so dgongs rgyud rtogs pa spor:lhan skyes dbang chen gsang gsum mngon gyur shog:phan bde'i nyi ma rgyal mchog bzhad pa rtsal bstan pa 'dzin srung smon lam mthu 'dzom pa'i:chos bdag rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs bcas la:gsol ba 'debs so dgongs rgyud rtogs pa spor lhan skyes dbang chen gsang

gsum mngon gyur shog: gzung 'dzin rū dra'i gshed gyur he ru ga: zil gnon dbang chen za byed phag mo yum: rtsal snang sgyu 'phrul 'khor gyi tshom bu la gsol ba 'debs so dgongs rgyud rtogs pa sbor lhan skyes dbang chen gsang gsum mngon gyur shog: phyi nang zung 'brel gnas yul mkha' 'gro dang: bde sbyin dbang phyug drod skyong bka' sdod tshogs rdul rnyed dbang chen gsung gi dkyir 'khor la gsol 'debs so dgongs rgyud rtogs pa spor: lhan skyes dbang chen gsang gsum mngon gyur shog: khams gsum mtshan 'dzin 'khrul pa ka dag ste: chos nyid glu gar rta yi brtul zhugs kyis: srid zhi'i sa rnams ldog pas rab bsgyur te: dbang chen bde 1nga rol bar byang chub shog: de ltaragasol ba btab pa yis nyams rtogs mkha' ltar 'phel rgyas 'gyur sa ma wāḥs maḥrgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma se bha was ma 'ongasagadul byar shin tu brtse sems kyis yang zab rtse shod gsham du dgong pra btabs dus su thugasasras bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gsol 'debs gzhan phan thugs rje'i nyi ma rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya gsang rgya gu rgyaḥ o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas

shas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang spyong ma dbang dam pa dbang chen lha rgyal nas bskul ngor 7kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyas mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi sgrom rgya las dag par phab pa'i ya ge pa ni sa marnya bha dra ma ṇasabagyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga le/

41 tshogs bsags ni na mo: gsung mchog pad+ma rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rang rig 'od gsal rjen pas phyag 'tshal lo: gang shar rang grol ye shes rgyan mchod 'bul: rtag chad mi bzhir gol ba mthol lo bshags: dus gsum mnyams nyid bzhugs la rje yi rang 'khor ba dong nas sprug pa'i chos bskor bskul: ka dag zang thal dgongs klong bzhugs gsol 'debs: dge kun gcig bsdus 'khor gsum dag par bsngo 'gro kun rang rig mngon gyur byang chub shog malkopa niḥ sa āhūṃḥ stong gsum rgyan bkod rat+na'i maṇ+ḍal 'di: bla ma sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku la 'bul: rang lus rnam dag dbang lnga 'dod lnga'i sprin: bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la 'bulaḥ sems nyid rnam dag ye shes gsang chen po bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la 'bul: bdag sogs 'gro ba'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang: 'khor ba dong sprug sku gsum mngon gyur shog tram̐ e de rat+na maṇ+ḍal byu dza me gha mu tra spra rat+na sa ma ya āḥshā:
྾྾ sa444྾ snga྾4/zushā'i / ja ྾sgo zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:dbang chen zil gnon rtsal gyi spros med don gyi myur lam bde stong 'ub chub bzhugs so:

—4rdo na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye 113sgyurte bdostong tso chub pad+ma gsung gi dal ye nas gnyis med thig le'i ngang du mchod rnal 'byor bde go ye shes mngon gyur bas rtag tu 'od gsal donagyi nye lam skyongs sa ma shā dpen pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la 'dug blo sems bag phab ma dag rlung dug dbyung spyor ba bzhi ldan 'byung ba'i dwangs ma bsre tshogs chen rab rdzogs gtum mo 'bar 'dzag bsgoms lhan skyesabade stong rtogs pa mkha' ltar rgyas sa ma māḥ bde stong chas rgyan sku'i rtags su bsgo ma bcos thad gar brkyang la skyabs sems ni na ma gdod nas ma bzhesas rig pa byang chub sems: ye yin dbang chena'akhor lo skyabs su mchi: gzung 'dzin snang ba sems kyi byed las ste: gzhi med rtsa bral rang byung gsal stong sgom: lan gsum rjesasu bka' bgo ni hūṃ trī: gdod nas rnam dag chos sku'i dkyil 'khor laḥ 'phral byung gdon gyi mtshan ma ka nas dag 'on kyang gnyis 'dzin 'byung po rang rgyud can mtha' bral bde chen dbyings su rtog pas bsal: ( hūṃ phaṭa gzhom med bsrung ba'i rwa gur ni hriḥ phyogs mtha' mi dmigs de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings: san blom thig le smos pa'i gra zur bral gzhom gzhig 'pho 'khyar med pa rngo rje'i bur

ba tshu 'di la rnam rtog gdon gyis glag mi rnyedaḥ dzñā na dhartu ra spre byin 'bebs na hū hrīḥ mi gnas zla gam dgu rdzogs pho brang nas bde ba chen po pad+ma dbangagi sku rnam kun mchog ldan ye shes phag mo yum: zung 'jug rol gar byi la pu shud zhal zil gnon khro rgyal yab yum sprul 'khor g.yog: skye med dbyings las ye shesagazigs pa ngom: rjes chags bshad pa'i dpa' rtag gar ngoms bzhin: bde ba mchog gi gnas 'dir dbang byin phobs: ma rig rū tra'i dpung tshogs zil gnon zhingaḥ donadam pad+ma dbang chen mngon gyur mdzod: pad+ma spyodata e a ra li phe phe a we sha ya a ā: sna tshogs mchod rdzas byin rlabs na 37 ātudabang po yul gyi gsal sgor shar ba'i chos: tshogasadrug lha mo bde ba'i rol gar bcas: sna tshogs rgyan mchod kun tu bzang po'i sprinaḥ mi bzad nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor spel: sa badz+ra spra ra ṇa khaṃ de nas lha bskyed ni hūṃ hri stod bcud brtan g.yo dbang chen bde ba'i dal ma chags dri bral chos 'byung e yi dbus: snang stong nyi zla rtog med ro gdan steng: bdag nyid ma brtsal rang byung ye

rdzogs sku: pad+ma dbang chen 'char ga'i gzi mdangs can: gar dgu'i nyams 'khyud bzod dka'i gzi brjid 'bar: dmar ser ral dbusarta zhal ljang spyod bzhad: 'khora'adas che btsan dregs pa dbang du bsdud: phyag g.yas gzung 'dzin rgyun gcod ral gri phyar g.yon pa khams gsum rgyan rol thod khrag 'dzin: dur khrod dpa' chas dpa'abo' rtags su bgo: zhabs gnyija/ bgrad pas skye ba rnam bzhi gnon ma rig mun bsregs ye shes me chen 'bar: bde stong dpal bskyedardo dze+ephag mo mthing: khro 'dzum nyamasargyas bde ba'i gzi byin 'bar: phyag g.yas gri gug dpa' bo'i mgul nas 'khyud: g.yon pas dung dmar dbang chen yab la stobs zhabs g.yon yab baspyod g.yas pasa'akhor ba gnon: zhal sbyor gad rgyangasanyiya ru lu sgrogs gzig sham rus rgyan dar dpyangs dril g.yer mdzes: dmar ser ral gsebardo dze+ephag gdong nguraḥ sa gsum 'grob ma rig smag las bsgral: 'khor 'das gnyis med bde chen mkha' ru spyor: / hūṃX dzad tu dwangs ma chos kyi 'khor lo sa bde ba'i sku canapad+ma dzad phreng stsal: dmar skrug

btsarnya zhi ma khro 'dzum gri thod 'dzin: rus rgyan dar dpyangs he ru ka pa'i chas: ma 'dres mnyam nyid bde ba chen por brgyan: dbang phyug rdo rje rnal 'byor gnyis med 'khril gcer bu rin chen pad phreng rtags su bsgo: rdo rje dril 'dzin gdos bral 'od kyi sku: ye shes lnga ldan 'ja' thig klong du bzhugs bde stong spros bral thugs rje'i gzi 'od kyis: rdul rnyed zhing khyab bde gshegs spro bsdu 'gyed: don gnyis mdzad pas 'gro ba'i gnas rnams stong hū 〉: brtse byed gsum mar yang dag yab yum shar: bde chen 'dod mar 'jam dpal gshin rjes gshed: 'od gsal 'byud mar bla med he ru ga: shes rab dbyings mar rdo rje gzhon nu'i dal: re stong chen mor che mchog he ru gaḥganas ma chen mor dregs pa kun 'dul rgyal: byin chags chen mor stobs ldan drag sngags lha: shin tu mnyam mar bka' nyan pho nya'i dal: kun kyang chags pas ma gos don dam par: bde ba chen po'i rol rtsed rlabs g.yos te he ru'i gnas khyab mdzad pa'i mnga' dbang phyug: gnas yul thams cad byang chub sems sprin 'khyug: kun kyang bde ba

chen po'i rol ston spro phyi nang gnyis med gnyam pa nyid du bsgyur:dur khrod brgyad kun brtul zhugs spyod pas skyongs: yul dang yul can kha lo gcig tu sbyor: 'khor ba'i sadang ldog pa'i sa rnams gnon ye shes pa dang chos nyid sa rnams 'byed 'khor ba'i bde ba mtshan ma'i 'khor lo stong: don dam bde ba'i rigs dang dkyil 'khor sprin:/ hūṃmakha' khyab spros pa'i 'khor lo zung 'jug klong: bde ba'i dkyil 'khor 'bar ba'i sprin rab 'byams: gnyis med mnyam pa'i gnas su 'dud par byed: rigs dang dkyila'akhor gtso mchog mnga' dbang bsgyur:nyiyo 'og phyogs dkyil 'khor rdul chen bkod pa zung: sna tshogs 'bar dang g.yo ba kha lo ba: don la gnyis med rdo rje'i gar la dril/ye shes gsang chen thig le gcig tu phyogs: bde chen mdzad pa'i sbyor sgrol phrin las 'byung gang 'dul ye shes gzigs rol bsam mtha' yas:〉〉:dbang chen bde klongazla gam thig le gsum: bde gshegs sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor bzhugs: phyag rgya'i rang bzhin spros pa'i 'od zer gyis: mkha' khyab rgyal kun dbyer med gcig tu bsre: de

badz+ra nas spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni hū trī: bde stong spros bral thig le chen po'i dbyings: rang bzhin 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dpal: bdud dpungazil gnon dbang chen he ru gaḥ gnyis med bde ba'i 'khor lor spyan 'dren gshegs nyi zla kha sbyor dpa' bo'i dal steng bzhugs: rab 'bar ye shes gsal ba'i phyag 'gyi'o oṃ pad+ma kro ta hiḥbaṃ ༷sa ma ya dza dza: dzñā na tiṣ+ṭha lhan na mo pū ru sha ya ho: de nas mchod 'bul ni hūṃ hrīḥ gzung 'jen mtshan ma'i rū tra bsgral ba yi0 dbang yul phung khams skye mched malus pa: mnyam nyid bde chen dgongs pa'i deng blang nas: dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi lha la 'bul: bdag med mnyam pa nyid du 'dren rol nas: 'khor ba ka nas dag pa'idangos grub stsal: ma ma hā su kha pū dza ho de nas bstod pa ni hūṃ hrī: zla gam dbang chen bde ba'i thig le'i sang tha snyad mtshan ma shes rab dbyings su gnon ye shes bde mchogamanyam nyid mdzad pa stonaḥ dbang chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: chags pa'i ma gos pad+ma rgyas 'dra'i zhal: ye shes gzigs ldan spran gyi dkyil 'khor gsal: bdud

dpung zil gnon dur khrod dpa' chas klubs che ba'i dbang phyug pad+ma drag por bstod:dzaX tu phra ba bde chen ga'u na ye shes bzhi sbyor sgrub sde'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs gnasayul dur khrod he ru'i mnga' dbang phyug: 'bar ba'i khro rgyal rdo rje sprin la bstod:'dibazung dze+esrid byang chub sems mchog par: he ru ka dpal pad+ma rgyal po yis: skad ciga'abral med bde stong zhal bzang mo khams gsum rol ba'i brtul zhugs mngon gyur nas dbang chen gsang gsum ye shes mchog thob re ga he ru ga' yig brgya'i bzod gsol phulade nas 'dzab dmigasani hūṃ hrī: bdochen dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi sum brtsegs 'dod 'khyil stong pa'i ga'u sa rig stong ngo bo bla ma yab yum gyis: thugs klong pad+marā ga'i rdo rje'i sbubs nyi zla kha sbyor snyong pohrī yig dmar: shin tu phra ba sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bzlas pas 'od zer bde ba chen por 'byed: dpa' bo yab yum kun gyithugs rgyud bskul: gnyis med bde ba chen po'i rol rtsed bsgyur: dbang mchog phra ba'i 'od gsal thig le'i bcud: skur thob bral ba'i gnas lugs mngon gyur te: gang

ba tshu shar rang grol kun bzang dgongs pa'i ngang: ma pad+ma kro ta rgya gh+ri wa hi baṃ ma hā su kha sirnyi pha la (ཿ ting 'dzin 'byur med ye shesadagongs pa skyongs shes rab bde chen don gyi rtogs pa rgyas sa ma yā sgrub sngags ni oṃ pad+ma kro ta 3tshobaṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭi da ka ha na da ha pa tsa khrom gha ru ḍa sarba yaka ḍak+ki ni garma bh+yo dza panyu la hā shrī he ru ka dzñā na dhartu hrī be: sarba sirnyi pha 75 hūṃ ā: bye ba bzlas pas snang srid bran du bkol rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam bde stong spros bral 'od gsal rtog pa rgyas rig 'dzin mchog gis sa la nges par sbyor sa ma yā las sngags ni thobadz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa ri badz+ra ki li ki la ya ma hā yak+ka ka la ru pa garma ram̐ ram̐ dz+wa la ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa: pad+ma ta kṛt+ta ma hā su kha rā ga sa ma ya ho: khro rgyal stobs 'dus me yi gsar lo 'di bum phrag bzlas pas drag pa zal gyis gnon nad gdon grib yam gang gis glags ma rted pha lam ja bzhen nus mthu stobs dang ldan gsang sngags rgyal po 'ad dang mtshungs dpe bral nyams su blangs tshad ban bon byad las grol che btsan dbang phyug kun gyi gtsug na spa bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal dkon mod rgyal khams 'grims la stos dang mthong sa ma yu de nas mchod cang bstod pa ni dbyangs gsal yig brgyasalhag chad

bskangs rten snying mthu yisanus pa gso 'dod gsol gdab pa'i re 'brasabaskangs rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangasabacas te hūṃtrī: bden stong mnyam nyid mchod pa che ba'i mchog: kun khyab lha mo 'dzum pa'i rol ston bcas: dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi lha la 'bul: bcu drug ye shes rgyas pa'i dngos grub rtsol: ma ma hā pañtsa byu tsa ho hūṃ hrī dbang chen bde ba'i gzi byin me ltar 'bar: gar dgu rngam pa'i brtul zhugs glog ltar 'khrug: hi ya bzhad pa'i 'dul glu 'byug ltar sgrogs: pad+ma gsung gi sku gsung thugs la bstod: rta bde ba'i dbang phyug pa d+ma he ru ga: ye shes srog gi dang blang rnal 'byor la: shin tu phra ba gnyug ma'i 'od gsal rgyun: bde mchog bde ba chen po mngon gyur shog: stong nyid gar dbang shes rab tha ga mo yum: rtag tu blo yid 'khri zhing phyogs pa'i mod lhan skyes gnas yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma'i: ye shes gzigs pa'i zhal bzang bstan du gsol: chos kyi mdzod tshen dwangs ma'i 'khor lo ru ye nas rang byung dpal chen 'dus pa'i zhal: lkog tu ma gyur shes rab gsal ba'i mthong tha snyad spos bral dbu mar byang chub shog blo yis

ba tshu spros pa'i sa lam bsam yas kyang cig chod bde stong rta yi 'gros 'gyogs kyis: myur brgal dbang chen pad+ma rgyal po'i lhums: dka' ba med par bdechen mchog thob shog bdag nai masang sgos dran reg 'gro ba yi: rgyud la dbang chen bde bas rgyas theb nas ma chen gar dbang phag mo'i gsang lam la: drangs nas tshom bugacig tu sangs rgyas thegag gzhan yang bsngo smon rgya yis gdab shis pa brjod cing dga' ston bya de mthus nyams rtogs nya ltar rgyas tshe ring nad med dbang phyug thob sa ma mā yi maḥ rgyal bami dbang po pad+ma sa bha wani ma 'ongs 'gro la lhag par thugs brtse bas shin tu zab pa rdo rje snying po' skor grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung lo tsā dang dbang chen bka' babargyal ba mchag dbyangasal pha nor bgo skal smon lam 'phro bcas gtad da lta spelaba'i dus la ma bab pa'i rin chen brda la bstims shigs ra bye mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon chas gzings pa ling pa'i tshe dpa' bo khyed zung sprul pa las ldan gyi zab gsang 'di rnyed bstan 'gro'i rgud pa sel 'gro don rlabs chen rma smra byang rong 'gyed 'brel tshad don ldan pad+ma 'od du 'god don gnyis lhun gyi 'grub par the tshom med bka' 'di srungs shigagand snyin btsan

rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor a dam rgya la can thugasakyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya spros med don gyi nyams len rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gurgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha pa' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin chosakyi bdag po sog sprularin po che pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis dge ba'i skyes bzang po du ma dang bcagate 'bad rtsol lhur len gyi bskur ngor 7kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsalagyisamakha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bdus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chosakyi bdag po nyid kyi bgyasapa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga la/

ba tshu rab gsal shel gya me long/snyi sgrib bral bde ba go po'i sprin la phyag la' lo ye: tha snyad mtshan ma'i chos rnams bdag tu bzung: ma rig rdul gsum rkyen gyis ye shes sgrib: bde stong spros bral 'khor ba'i bde bar gol: dbang chen bde klong ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: hi: rū tra sgol ba'i brtul zhugs bog ma thon: bdud bzhi lam slong phyag rgya gnas ma stobs: gzung 'dzin dbyings sgrol gar chen bsgyur ma nus: mnyam nyid thig le spros dang bral bar bshags: baṃ: bde chen dbu mar 'dzag med bcing ma nus: shes rab bde ba'i ro la spyod ma shes: chos nyid rtog bral 'od gsal rgyun ma brkyangs: thams cad ma chen mkha' 'gro'i dgongs klong bshags: swe: bde chen nam mkha'i thig le bskul ma shes: mkha' 'gro bde ba'i me chen sbar tshul 'tshol: brkyod byed rgyu ba brtul zhugs thabs ma mkhas kun kyang lhan skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gror bshags: ā gzhi rtsa dag pa'i chos sku chen po na dam tshig chags nyams gdos mtshan ka nas dag: bshags dang bshags bya bshags byed ye sangs rgyas gnas lugs

rdzogs pa chen por mnyam brdal bzhag de ltar gzhi rtsa dag pas bshags pa bya don gnyis lhun grub 'bras bu'i rgyal po thob sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya dri med nam mkha' dag pa'i dgongs mnyam 'di rig 'dzin 'ja' rtsasardo rje'i bskul bzang po dam tshig las smon dag pa'i sku skyes la gces pa'i snying nor nus ldanardo rjes la bslab gsum rnam dag rgyan 'chang tshogs bzang pos bstan pa 'di nyid 'dzin skyong spel bar shog sabo ma lam̐/bkra shis/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:dbang chen bdud dpung zil gnon rtsal gyi dgyes bskyed rdzas bzhi'i bskang ba tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho bzhugs so:gsaX na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra yi 2148rten bdud dpung zel gnon dbang chen gsang ba'i dal ma shig dwangasama'i thig le'i ze'u 'byur rol skal ldan tshogs gnyas rgya mtsho rdzogs pa'i phyar sabazhi'i bskang ba bsod nams mtha' yas 'bul sa ma pā hū hrī:bde stong spros bral 'od gsal dkyil 'khor du:dbang chen pad+ma gsung mchog bskang ba'i rdzas:rtsa brgyad stong sbyar pañtsa amṛ ta:mnyam nyid bde ba chen por 'bul gyis bzhes:mtshan ldan bhañtsa lcang lo can gyi nang:srid pa bskyed byed rgyu'i khrag chen po pad+ma rak+ta zhing bcu bsgral ba'i khrag rtsibacud 'byung ba'i dwangs ma shes rab rdzas:dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor dgyes phyir 'bul gtor gzhong rnam dag rat+na'i snod yangs par 'khor 'das dwangs ma dpal gyi gtor chen po brjid ldan 'dod yon lnga yi rgyan gyis mdzes gzi byin bskyed phyir yi dam lha la 'bul:dbyings rig gnyis med bde chen skong bu ru zag med byang chub

sems kyi bcud chen bskyil: ye shes lnga yi 'od stong sgon me sbar: ma rig mun pa sangs phyir 'bul bar bgyi: dpa' bo dgyes bskyed dza gad sbreng ba yang: 'khor ba ru bzlog ye shes dbyings sbyor phyir yi dam pad+ma dbang chen lha la 'bul: a la la ste dgyes pa chen por bzhes de ltar phul bas tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib dag don gnyis lhun 'grub 'byur sa ma shā mim rgyasadabang pa5'i thug gad skor bla med rdo rje snying po'i sgo ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i rgud skyob phyir rin chen sa yis gter du sbos dus pha nad mtshon gzing ming tshe rgyal mchog sprul pa dpa' bo yis rted nasaphan bde'i dpal kha ngom de bar srungs shig btsan rgod rgyal bka' log lag tu ma shor zhig sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya rdzas bskang tshogasaganyis rgya mtsho rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sba rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi zlob dpon pad+ma /snya pha bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzasabakod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'angabung zen sku skye pad+ma dga' bamirdo rjesabaskur ngor bdag 'dranu ldan rdo rjesamakha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i 'phrul bdo lasadag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni cho nabadag nyid kyis bgyis pa'o sarba maṅga lam̐/

badz+ra tshogs bsdus ni ma hā ma sa gtso bor gyur ba'i bza' 4'a gas ba'i rigs rnams dum khrig snod du bsags te hū hrī: lhan skyes rdo rje phung po'i grong khyer du ye mnyam pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor la bde stong dga' bzhi'i tshogs ston 'bul lags na: bdag gzhan ka dag nang dbyings mngon gyur shog de ltar phul bas tshogs rdzogs 'gyur sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya zhes pa'ang thugs rgyud gcig pa gang des bskul ngor nus ldan pasaso sarba ma le/
them medasnyi ba rte zab gsang rdo rje snying po las tshogs chen rab rdzogs bsod nams sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

—4rdo na mo ma hā gu ru sapad+ma kro ta rgya sgro wa be+e ༷ kun khyab bdechen mtha' dbus mi dmigs pa pad+ma dbang chen ye shes gsang chen mdzod bde gshegasarab 'byams sprin gyi phung po bcas mi shig snying dbus ze'u 'byur dad brgya'i mchod ma 'ongs las ldan skal bzang pho mo yis gsang chen bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe tshogs chen rab rdzogs bsod nams 'dir brtson na nyams chags rtog sgrib sbyang zhing dngosagrub thob sam mā ma dwa na dang me sa gtsor gyur pa' bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs rnams kun bsags te:sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzan gyis spel lhar gsal ting 'dzan ldan pas 'ad skad do hūṃ trī:dzadas /)de sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis:snod bcud 'dod dgu'i dpal yon bcud dril bas:tshogs rdzas kun tu bzang po'i sprin du 'bul:ngo mtshar med byung rgyal ba'i zhing khyab spro:re yekho o.āX hūṃ kun btags 'khrul ba dri ma dbyings su bcom ye shes sgyu 'phrul ltad mo bsam mtha' yas:gang shar rang grol lha mo'i rol ston bcas:'di na phun tshogs zhingabakod sbos mtha' bral:o badz+ra spra ra ṇa sa:de nasatshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni hūṃ hri:bdestong spros dang bral b.lipho brang nas:dang po'i sangs rgyas kun bzang yab yum dang dbang

ba tshu chen bde ba'i dkyil 'khor sras dang bcas: dgongs pa'i dbyings las thugs rje'i rtsal mdangs ngom: 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor spyan 'dren gshegs:zag med bde ba chen por bzhugs su gsol: kun khyab rig pa rjen pa'i phyag bgyi'o: dam bskangs tshe dbang mchog thun dngos grub stsol: ma ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ: pad+ma kro ta sarba sa ma yā dza dza de nas tshogs phud 'bul ba na hūṃ hrī tshogs kyi rang bzhin sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: kun khyab lha mo'i spro bsdu bsam mtha' yas: gnyis med pad+ma dbang chen lha la 'bul: ro mnyam thim pa'i tshul gyis dgyes par bzhes: ma hā gha ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: de nas bar bshags na ho: lta ba dman zhing spyod pa 'chol dbang gis: sor byang sngags kyi sdom pa dam tshig la chags nyams zhig ral gang song nongs pa kun mi 'chab mi sped rig pa chos skur bshags: badz+ra sa ma yā ā: de nas tshogs bsgral ni hū bh+yo: dbang chen zla gam e yi dkyil 'khor nas: bdud dpung zil non pad+ma dbang gi sna rngam brjid srin po khros pa'i tshul du bzhengs: zhing bcu sgol ba'i las la ma g.yel zhig: ma badz+ra kro ta

rbad sarba sha t+t+waṃ ma ra yā pāṭa: de nas bstabs mchod na hūṃ hrī: dbang chen bde rol zhal gyi hom khung du log rtog bsgral ba'i phung khams skye mched bstabs: mnyams nyid bde ba chen po dgyes rol nas 'khor ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzod: ma sarba rba ༅ a la la kha ram̐ khā hi: tshogs la rol pa na ho: bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes zhal: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: gnyis med mnyam pas tshogs ston bzhes: a la la ho theg pa mchog gi dam rdzas 'di: rin thang med la legs 'ong chos: gzung 'dzin mtshan mas ma gos par de bzhin nyid spyod bdag phyag 'tshal: sirnyi pha la ma.aḥhūṃX 'di ni rnal 'byor mchog gi rdzas rigs lnga yab yum dkyil 'khor te: reg myong ngan song skye sgo kheg: rig 'dzin sa la sbyor bar byed: a la la ho gtsang ste'i rtog pa dang bral bar gnyis med mnyams pa' ngang du spyod sa ma yā de nas lhag ma 'bul ba ni bh+yo: rdo rje khrag 'thung pad+ma he ru ga'i: bka' dang dam tshig gtsug tu 'chang ba yi dbang phyug ma sring king ling 'bar ba rnams glog ltar myur ba'i shugs kyis 'dir byon

ba tshu la:pham 'bab bka' yi lhag gtor mchod pa bzhes:sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sgrub la 'gal rkyen sol rnal 'byor tshe dbang nyams rtogs ting 'dzin bskyed gang bcol thog med sgrubs shig dam tshig can:ma ma ma ḍāk+ki ni hrīng ba lidha kha kha khā hi kha hi ༷de nas bskul ba ni nyi ya:bde stong spos bral zla gam e klong nas du tra bsgral ba'irdzu 'phrul mthu stobs can:dgongs pa'i dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs:dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dpa' skyems gtor ma bzhes:mngon spyod drag po'i phrin lasa'agrub pa dang:rgyal bsen dam sri ming gi lag mar mdzod:'jig rten rgud pa mtha' dag gzhom pa dang:gang bcol brin las mdzod cig thugs dam can:de nas chad mdo ni hū bh+yoḥsgog mtha' bar gsum dus tshig lnga pa la:rdo rje rgyal po'i spyan sngar dam mnos pa'i pho mo ma ning dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kyis:sngon tshe zhal bzhes las rnams sgrub pa'islad bka' yi gtor ma phud mchod 'di bzhes la:rgyal bstan srung zhing der 'dzin 'dus sde spel:sbyin bdag 'byer ldan bshad sgrub nyi ltar gsal nag phyogs sma phob

dgra bgegs mgo bo non: bskyed rdzogs sgrub pa'i mthun snang legs tshogs spel bka' dang dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya: de nas brtan ma ni bh+yo:chogs bdag bka' yi gnyer skyong dam tshig can: gang ldongs bod khams srung ba'i sa 'dzin ma: rdo rje kun grags gangs kyi g.yu bun sogs bstan ma ya ma skyongs ma'i tshogs rnams kun: lhab lhub brgyan bcas skad cig 'dir pyon la: rang rang mthun snang bshos bu bshal chu bzhes: mtha' dmag dus 'byug rgud pa mtha' dag sol bod khams bkra mi shes pa'inyer 'tshe bzlog rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi mthun rkyen spel bka' 'das dam nyams rigs la chad pa chod legs nyes so kha srungs la ma g.yel cig:khyed rnams nyams na khrag 'thung chen pos mnar: de bas dam tshig mnyan po gtsug tu 'chong phrin las gang bcol sgrubs shig bstan ma'i tshogs sgo ma ma sring 'gro ma e dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hikhā hi de na rta bro ni hūṃ hrī rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i e klong du: gzung 'dzin du tra dam sri 'byung po brub mnan no ldang med rta yi brtul zhugs 'debs: dbang chen bde

gas/: klong mngon gyur bar du rgya oṃ ā:/ swā hā stum bha ya nan: ma ra ya nan: de nas dngos grub ni hūṃ hrī: mi gnas ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: dbang chen bde klong sku gsung thugs kyi dpal: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa: da lta nyid du sgrub mchog bdag la rtsol: rtsa sngags mthar ma hā su kha sirnyi pha la a la la ho:de nas bshags pa ni ho gnyisa'adzin sems kyi dbang du gyur pas nongs: gzhi snang chos sku'i don la sgrib byed kun ye shes chos sku'i dbyings su bshags bgyi'o: shes rab dgong pas rdul tshogs mkha' la gtor: a ā: pha ge brgya pa bzlas la lag chad bskangs de nas bsngo ba smon lam na hūṃ hrī: tha snyad mtshan ma'i dge ba ma lus pa: kun khyab rig pa chos sku'i dbyings su bsngo: zag dang zag med spros pa rnam dag nas: sku gsum 'bras bu'i rang sa zin par shog: lan gsum de nas bsdu ldang ni ho: tha snyad mtshan ma'i chos rnams ma lus pa: ye shes dbang chen thig le'i klong du bsna: slar yang rig stong pad+ma he ru ga'i: rā tra sgol ba'i bstul zhugs sgod lam bya: a ā: phaṭa phaṭa: de nas shis brjod ni na mo:

dbang chen bde ba'i zhal bzang byin rlabs mdzod: chos nyid rta yi dgongs nyams dngos grub gter: bde chen 'bar ba'i gzi mdangs dga' bzhi'i dpal: mchog thun grub gnyis char 'bebs bkra shis 31ga: gzhan yang bsngo smon rgya yis gdab shes pa brjod cing me tog 'thor desani don gnyis lhun gyi 'grub the tshom med do sam mā stem rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma tha rte was ma'ongs 'gro la shin tu thugs brtse'i phyir mtha' dbus thams cad ran chen gter gyis gtams khyad par zab gsang rdo rje snyang po'i skor dbang chen bka' babargyal mtshag khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen brda la bstams mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der dgongs rgya sdoms ma 'ongasasnyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon cha'i gzings pa lang pa' tshe dpa' bo khyod sprul 'dzam gleng dbang rgyal dpa 'phrad nas bstan pa rin chen 'dzan skyongs spel 'gro don phrin las bsam mi khyab pa 'byung bka' 'di srungs shig gnod sbyin btsan rgod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor thub par mdzod sam mā rgya rgya rgya them med tshogs mchod 'bul ba bsod nam sprin phung rdzogs so gterargya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya guh+ya o rgyan gyislob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyibaka' bdag 'dra mkharachen gzasabakod pa'o bdo thim lha zhes pa 'di'angalung zen sku skyes pad+mamimatshan can gyis bskur ngor

ba khro kho bo dbang go gsung gi rnal 'byor 'dzam gling dbang rgyal rtsal gyi mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag nyid 3 bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sa maṅga la/dge'o/bkra shis/

༄༅/ trī ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod bla ma longs sku'i rje: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul ba'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang 'a'atshal bstod: hūṃ hrī: dbang chen bde ba'i gzi byin me ltar 'bar gar dgu rngam pa'i brtul zhugs glog ltar 'khyug: hi ma bzhad pa'i 'dul glu 'brug ltar sgrogs gsung gi sku gsung thugasal bstod: ( hrī: khams sum dbang bsgyur lha yi bla ma rje: rjes chags ro la rol ba'i dam tshig 'dzin phyag g.yang 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs byobadag: 'dod pa'i rgyal po khyod dran rtag par bstod zib nub bshags pa'i 'dug ho rnam dkar dge tshogs mar gyur 'gro la bsngo: rgyal bstan dar rgyas der 'dzin 'a smin gdul zhing tshogs smon las kyis 'brel rnams kun: zla gam dbang chen e klong gsung thob 31ga lan gsum dge'o/

gtsaji: tshe lasags bya ba ni bdag nyid dam tshig gi tshe dpag med sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i gzi byin 'bar ba: longs sku'i rgyan dang mtshan dpe'i rnam par 'byud pa phyag mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'chi med tshe yi bum pa 'dzin pa: zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing: sku lus 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros te: 'khor 'das brtan g.yo 'byung ba'i dwangs bcud thams cad bsdus te bdag dang bsrung bya rnams la sib sib thim pas: 'chi med tshe yi dbang dang dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam la: sbyo a yu dzñā na tshe hūṃ n+ni dza sidhi pha la hūṃ ā: brgya rtsa brjod la tshe rdzas rnams dbang bskur byin rlabs gzi byin bskyed slar yang tshe bsod 'gugs pa ni bdag dang bsrung bya'i bla tshe nyams pa dang yal ba dang 'khyams pa dab chad gas ral ba dang: gdon chen gyis phrog pa dang: gdon phran gyis bskus pa: byad ma lha srung gis bkugs pa thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnams par bsdus te: bdag dang bsrung bya rnams la sib sib bstim pas: 'chi ba med pa rdo rje tshe yi dbang dang dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam la: hū trī rang snang mi shig

dag pa'i zhing lnga ldan zangs mdog dpal gyi ri: pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: 'gro ba'i mgon po thod phreng rtsal: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mos ldan sgrub mchog pho mo la: dgongs rgyud byin rlabs 'pho ba dang 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub rtsol: / hrī: zla gam dbang chen e yi 1nga:bdud bzhi nyi zla pad+ma'i steng: chos 'byung zur drug mdzes pa'i dbus: bde mchog dbang chen he ru ka gar dbang gzi ldan dbyings dang bsre thabs kyi pho nya glog ltar 'khyug:shes rab rang bzhin char ltar 'beb gnyis med bde ba chen po'i gzi: dad ldan mos ngor sgyu mar byon dgongs rgyud byin rlabs 'pho ba dang 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub rtsol: ( trī: tshad med thugs rje'i klong yangs nas: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub pa'i: 'jam dpal sku dang che mchog gsung: yang dag thugs dang brin las dpal: bla med drag po stobs ldan sogs: rgyad sde rgya mtsho'i sprin rab 'byams: dad pas thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: ting 'dzin mos ngor gsal bar byon: dgongs rgyad byin rlabs

ba tshu 'pho ba dang: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub rtsol: nyu hrī bde chen 'od gsal thig le'i 1nga: nyag gcig gsang ba chen po nas: rgyal ba kun yum rnal 'byor ma: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas yul nyer bzhi'i 'du ba mchog: phyi nang gnyis med sgyu 'phrul sprin: dad ldan sgrub mchog mos ngo na ye shes gzigs pa'i zhal bzang ngom dgongs rgyud byin rlabs 'pho ba dang: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol hūṃ hrī: lha dang rig 'dzin tshe yi bdag: 'gyur ba med pa'i gzi byin can: pad+ma gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyis: 'dir tshogs rnams la tshe dbang bskur: 'chi med rig 'dzin mchog thob nas: don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog: o pad+ma kro ta sarba ā yu dzñā na sirnyi pha la hūṃ hrī: tshe bum dang tshe chang tshe ril tshe 'brang rnams ram bzhin btad de nas rgyas gdab ni hūṃ hrī: mda' ni rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rten: dar tshon ye shes lnga yi gsang: gser ni rin thang bral ba'i nor: bal ni longs stsod g.yang gi rgya: sha ni byis pa chung gi rjen: dung ni bkra shis dge ba'i rdzas: pho yi ga sten pho la gtad: tshe srog bkrag mdangs rgyas gyar cig:

mo yi bla rten mo la gtad zhi dul lang tsho'i dpal 'dzom shog: byis pa'i bla rten chung la gtad bkra shis las mtha' phun tshogs shog: tshe srog 'gyur med ka chen 'dzug lo brgyar 'tsho zhing ston brgya mthong tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan: dge legs chos ldan dpal 'byor shog: ( tra tra shag: mu tra ho: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: brgya rtsa brjod la che rba bstims de nas smonalam gdab pa ni hoḥ gsang chen rdo rje sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor rnams snang mtha' yas pa'i tshe la mnga' brnyes shog: mi bskyod rdo rje'i lang tshor mnga' brnyes shog: rin chen 'byung gnas dpal yon 'byor bar shog: don yod grub pa'i brin las mthar phyin shog: rnam par snang mdzad nges pa lnga 'byor shog: 'khor ba dong sprug mdzad pa mthar phyin shog: denas shis brjod ni ho: bde ba chen po'i rigs dang dkyil 'khor bdag: gsung mchog pad+ma dbang gi 'khor lo'i dpal: bde legs kun gyi 'byung gnas rta phag zhal ye shes 'bar ba mchog gi bkra shis stsol: gag yang shis brjod rgya cher bya

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dbang chen gsung gi dgyes bskang dgos 'dod char 'bebs bzhugs so zem med snyi:—41 na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye chen17sa tsho bde ba'i gze byin 'byug pa'i he ru ka pad+ma gar gyi dab phyug rtsal la bdud gdul zhing snyigs ma'i 'gro khams sman grol phyar dbang chen dgyesabaskang bdud rtsa'i char 'bebs bstan sa ma yā snod bcud dpal 'gror 'dod dgu'i longs spyod kyis dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskang bar bya thod rnga bcu drug ltag sprod mi rkang gling dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dmagand nas bskul sa ma yu hū hrī ka dag spros bral gnas lugs mngon gyur pa'i: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang rang bzhin ma 'dres 'od gsal thig le'i ngang: rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: bka' lung dbang dang man ngag rtsol mdzad pa'i: gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: gter rigs bcod rgyad zab mo'i chos char 'bebs: shog ser tshig brgyud bla ma'i 'gro kun rang byung ye shes mngon mdzad pa: smon lam las 'phro'i bla ma'i thugs dam bskang brtse bas rjes

bzung man ngag snying khu sbyin: rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i hū hrī: dbus mtha' med pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las: bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang dngos kun bdud rtsir 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu: che mchog yon tan lha tshogs ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor spros dang bral: yang dag yab yum sras 'khor thugs dam bskang:yon tan rgya mtsho'i gsang mdzod he ru ga: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang mngon spyod drag pos dgra bgegs rdul brlag pa'i: thal 'byin 'phrin las lha tshogs bde stong spros bral bla ma'i dkyila'akhor nas ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs 'jig rten drag pa las la glog ltar 'khyug dregs pa kun 'dus lha tshogs dmod pa'i mtshon cha zhing bcu'i srog la 'bebs: stobs ldan las kyi lha tshogs tshom bu dgu yi bka' skyong dam tshig can: rdo rje pho nya yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang dkyil 'khor mtha' dbus mi dmigs yangs pa cher: dbang bsgyur gtso 'khor sprul ba'i thugs dam bskang: hū trī dmar nag chos 'byung zla gam e klong nas: rta mgrin bdud dpung zil

ba tshu gnon thugs dam bskang dbang chen yab la bde ba'i rgyas 'debs pa'i:dbang phyugs rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam bskang:za byed thabs kyi cha 'dzin phogadon 'dul:bka' nyan byi las mgo can gso byed shes rab rang bzhin mo gdon 'thar:las byed byu shud mgo can phyogs mtshams dregs pa bran bkol brin las myur zil gnon khro chen yab yum tshad med rnams bzhi'i gzhan snang rjes su 'dzin:bka' sdod sgo ma bzhi'i thugs dam bskangs:ma rig rmongs pa'i 'gro ba dbyings sgrol phyir dmu long rgyab 'brel tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang:bde chen sbyor ba'i las la mdzad tshul mkhas:dpal gyi khyi sbyang bcu drug thugs dam bskang:mngon spyo da drag pos dmanyams zhing bcu sgrol:drwa ba glog 'gyur 'dab bzhi'i thugs dam bskang:phrin las thog pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul can:dregs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang:bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba'i sgog dbugs bsdud:gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po'i thugs dam bskang:zab gsang snying po'i bshad sgrub rtag tu skyongs rgyud mgon legs ldan yab yum

phyogs bzhi mtshams kyi dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i: las mkhan lha srin sde brgyad thug dam bskang: ( hrī: thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni phyi mchod gzung bdag pa'i nang mchod 'dzin pa grol ba'i thugs dam bskang gsang mchod bde ba chen po dug gsum rnams dag sman gtor rak+tas bskangs: dgra bgegs bsgral mchod shakhrag rus pas bskangs dga' ba bzhi yi byang chub sems kyi bskangs: grag stong chos sgra rol mo'i tshogs kyis bskangs nyams pa gso phyer gā ṇa tsa kras bskangs: lta bamakha' ltar dag pas thugs dam bskangs sgom pa nyi ltar gsal bas thugs dam bskang: spyod pa 'ja' ltar bkra bas thugs dam bskangs: 'bras bu sku gsum klong yangasathugs dam bskangs: bskang bya skong byed dngos 'dzin dag pa'i bskangs khyab brdal rig stong rdzogs pa chen por ā: de ltar bskangs bas tshogs go rdzogs rnal 'byor nyams pa sor chuda'agyur rtogs pa'i yon tan mkha' ltar rgyas dngos grub chu bor rtsol med 'byung sa ma mā yem rgyal bsladabang po pad+ma so rte was ma 'ongs 'gro la thugs brtse chen po yis snyang dang 'dra ba' ya zab rmad byung ba grub pali

—41 dbang phyug rgyal mchog khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen brda la bstims mdo khams bkra shis rdzong der mdzod: ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon gyi gzeng pa lang ba'i tshe dpa' bo khyod sprul 'dzam glang dbang rgyal dang 'phrad nas bstan pa'i 'gro don bsam yas byed gdul zhing ma lus lho nub dpal rir 'god don gnyis lhun gyi grub pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' 'ad srung shig gnod sbyin btsanargod rgyal dam nyams lag tu ma shor sa ma yu las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya dgyes bskangs dgos 'dod char 'bebs rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gurgya orgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zen chos kyi bdag po sku skyes pad+ma dga' ba'i rdo rjes bkra shis pa'i rdzas du mar bcas te yang yang bskurangor kho bodabang chen bka' bab 'dzam gling dbang rgyal rtsalagyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul bdo las zhal bshusate dag par phabs pas yig ge pa ni chos bdag nyid kyis bgyis pa'o sarba maṅga lo/

ba:tshu them med bskang ba nisnyi ga54sko/: dngos 'asgor yid sprul kun bzang mchod sprin spel lha sngags ting 'dzin rab gsal dbyangs snyan pos hūṃ hrī: mtha' bral nam mkha'i dbyings kyi 'khor lo na sku yi bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: sbyor sgrol yum chen khro rgyal gshed bzhi dang: phyogs skyongs bcu gnyis ging bdud rtsis shan sogs pho nya yongs rdzogs za byed gtum rngam can 'jigs byed rnam par rol ba'i thugs dam bskangs hūṃ hrī: bde stong rab 'bar dga' ba'i 'khor lo na dpal chen yongs 'dus che mchog he ru ga: gnam zhal dbyings phyug kro ta rigs bzhi dang: he ru mched dgu bka' nyan sgo ba bzhi las mdzad pho nya lce spyang ma brgyad sogs: yon tan bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i lha tshogs ni: gnyis med mnyam pa chen pos thugs dam bskangs: hūṃ hrī: ye shes bde mchog thugs kyi dkyil 'khor na: 'gyur med yang dag khrag 'thung he ru ga: bde ba'i dpal sprin kro ti sha ri yum: khrag 'thung rigs bzhi yab yum smo ba bzhi gnas ma yul ma dbang spyag nyi shu brgyad: ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bsam mtha' yas

bde gshegs bkod pa'i rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangs: nyu hrī: rngam byed mkha' 'gro bde ba'i 'khor lo na: phrin las dpal 'dus rdo rje gzhon nu yab: gnyis med bde klonga'akhor lo rgyas 'debs dbyings thugs sras rigs bzhi khro rgyal yab yum bcu za gsod khra thabs sgo skyong mkha' 'gro bzhi: bka' nyan pho nya ma mo bcu gnyis dang skyes buging bzhi bdud rgyal las byed bzhi: 'byung po sna yon yang sprul bsam mtha' yas: snying rjes 'gal zlar khros pa'i he ru ka thal 'byin phrin las lha tshogs thugs dmabaskangs: / hrī: bde rol mnyam nyid gsang ba'i 'khor lo na: stobs kyi dpal chen bla med he ru sa: nyid bzhi mu kha kun bzang zhal lnga yum: rje mo drug dang rgyal mo bcuganyis zhal: sman mo lnga bcu yang sprul bsam mtha' yas: dgongs pa dbyings su thig le chen por bzhugs rnam rol thugs rjes gdul bya'i mos mtshor gzigs bde ba'izhal bzang dad ldan bu la ngom mchog tu mi 'khyar dbu ma'i dbyings su smol: srid pa ma mo'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: hūṃ hri: 'bar b.lirang bzhin bde ba'i 'khor lo na

bsgotshu 'jig rten dregs pa zil gnon he ru ga: khams gsum spyi 'dul bde ba'i dbang phyug yum: sde dpon sum bcu 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha rngam: ye shes las can gar yang thog med rgyu: rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis sangs rgyas bstan pa srung: khro rngam gshe bas zhing bcu'i don snying 'byen: sha khrag dpa' zas stobs bzhin sgrub la brtse mchod bstod dregs pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs: hū trī: bskyed pa'i rang bzhin bde sbyor 'khor lo na dpal chen yongs 'dus stobs ldan he ru da: dga' bzhi'i dpal rtsol 'byung bzhi'i bdag mo yum: dregs pa bco rgyad dpa' rngam brtul zhugs ldan rdzu 'phrul thogs med las myur pho nya ba: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i dam tshag can: rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi grogs su rgyu: smon log rgya 'dre srin po 'thar mdzad pa'i: drag sngags dmod pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs: hū hrī:bde chen gar dbang pad+mahe ru ga'i sku yi gsang ba bsam mi khyab pa'i char: bde gshegs tshom bu dgu yi pho nya ba: ma bdun sring bzhi dbang byug nyi shu brgyad: sa bdag so gnyis 'bum phrag mkha'

'gro dang:gdab phur brgya rtsa rtogs byed 'joms byed tshogs bde stong dga' bzhi bskyed pa'i gsang srog mchog:legs nyes stong 'dzin dam tshig rjes su gcod:phrin lasashugs ldan bka' sdod thugs dam bskangs:hūṃ hrī:thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni:sha chen lnga dang bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga:rtsa brgyad stong sbyar pañtsa a dṛ ta:nyonamongs rgyu bsgral rak+ta bde ba'i skyems khams drug lha mor spro ba'i bha lirnyi:bza' ba tshogs pa'i longs spyod nam mkhar mnyam:rnam rtog gcod pa'i 'khor lo ro snyoms ngang mchog chen mchog phran mtshan ldan za le 'bri:shel gong lugs dang tsa ra mkha' lding dang rdo rje zil ba dpa' mo dgyes pa'i rdzas:pad+ma rak+ta dpa' bo bskul ba'i skyems sprosabral lta ba don dam gsang mchod dang:nyag gcig zang thal sgom pa gsal ba'i me:rnam rgyal spyod pa brtul zhugs che ba'i mchog:rdo rjemirig ma bud+dha bskul ba'i dpyid:rtogapa'i glu dbyangs mtshan ma gcod pa'i tshig:ye shes bro ni bdud dpung rtsad gcod thabs:shes rab gar ni 'khor ba dong sprugs lam:dza gad a dṛ gsang chen sngags kyi rdzas

btsasdo: bkra shis rdzas rtags rig pa'i rgyan shar srid: rgyal srid nor sna phun tshogs dpal 'byor ste: rang byung rang shar kun bzang mchod sprin gyis: bde gshegs bkod pa'i rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang: rtog pa mngon gyur mchog thun dngos grub rtsol de ltar bskang bas tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho rdzogs sgrab pa kun dag don gnyis lhun gyis grub nyams da rtog pa'i yon tan 'phel rgyas 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje pad+ma'i bka' sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya chos kyi bdag po pad+ma dgyesapasangor kho bo rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis so sarba masgo lo/ bkra shis/

badz+ra zab gsang 〉〉 rje snying po las: gnam phud gnas yul srung ma'i bskang ba bde stong dga' ster bzhugs so:btsardo namogu ru pad+ma ka ra ye zug65snye she: dga' ston tshogasakyi long spyod bsags ye shes ting nge 'dzin gyis spel snyan 'gyur mgrin glu rol mo' sgra chos nyid mnyams pa' brtul zhugs bcas hū trī: 'og min gnas dang mkha' spyod zhing: bde chen spyor ba'i dkyir 'khor na: gnas dang nye ba'i gnas mchog dang: tshan+dho nye ba'i tshan+dho ha: zhing dang nye ba'i zhing la sogs: he ru ka yis gnas bcu na: bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma bde stong tshogs kyi mchod pas bskangs: spyi bor dza lan dha ra dang longs spyod 'khor lo le pa ga: snying ka gzhi ka yi yul: lte ba dri sha ku na'i grong: mtshan ma pre ta pū ri sogs: gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni: rdo rje phung po'i grong khyer dang 'brel ba'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams: bde stong tshogs kyi mchod pas basmangs: bsil ba tshal dang sma la rdzogs: pad brtsegs dang lid+ma brtsegs: bde chen brngal dang ro mnyam tshal dur khrod brgyad dang 'brel ba yi

phyi nang rten dang brten pa'i tshul dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma: bde stong tshogs kyi mchod pas bskangs gsang ba brda' shod ud+dha ya: sham+bha la dang ne ku tsi bde ba'i tshal dang dga' ba'i mdangs: ro gtun gram dang brdal ba can: phyi nang gnyis med bde ba'i yul: rang bzhin sum cu rtsa gnyis na: bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma: bde stongatshogs kyi mchod pas bskangs: gzhan yang mi mjed bye phrag brgya: rang bzhin dag pa'i gnas rnams dang: sa spyod mkha' spyod gnas nyul ba'i: dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma zhing skyong mkha' 'gro sngags skyes sogs: bde stong spyod pa'i brtul zhugs can: 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs: bde stong dga' bzhi'irol ston bzhes sdom dang dmatshig nyams pa bshags: rtsa rlung thig le rab bsnun pas: ma dag mtshan ma'i mdud pa grol: spang rtogs yon tan mthar phyin te: bde stong spros bral 'od gsal klong: lhan skyes mkha' la spyod pa'i zhing: skad cig nyid du mngon gyur regag de ltar phul bas gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dgyes bskangs nas lhan skyes rtog pa mngon gyur te bde stong phag mo'i gsang gsum

bsgo/ji spyod sa ma wā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma sa bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la shin tu thugs brtse bas zab pa'i yang snying rdo rje snying po' skor dbang chen rgyal ba mchog dbyangasanyid la rtsal spel ba'i dus tshigs ma 'ongs 'gro phyir bstan dgyes sde chen mos brda yi ris su pha ba phrin las ma nub gu ru'i smon lam gnad dus kyi snyags ma 'khrugs rtsod gzengs langs tshe dpa' bo khyod ni nu ldan rdo rjer bzhengs skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas 'gro don phrin las bsam ma khyab pa 'byung bka' 'di thub par srungs shag btsan rgod rgyal dam med lag tu ma shor sa ma yu las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya gnam phud gnasayul bsrungs ma'i bskang ba rjo gas gso gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpo na pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa 'o brda thim lha ces pa 'di'ang lung zin pad+ma mkha' spyod dgyes pa'i rdo rjes ngo mtshar dge ba'i skyes bzang du mar bcas te bskur ngor kho bo dbang chen dgyes pa'i rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda zab mo dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa na chos kyi bdag po nyad kyas bgyis pa 'o/ sarba ma la/
rmu bu — ༄ ༅ du

༄༅ / bka' srung gam po'i rten dbab ni na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum sku gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang don dam chos nyid ngobo gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang: kun rdzob rten 'brel bslu ba med pa sgyu 'bras zab mo'i bden pa'i mthu stobs kyis: bka' srung che ge mo yab yum sprul 'khorabaka' sdod dang bcas pa sgrub thabs bskyed chog ji lta ba bzhin du bdag gis mdun sar mi dang mi 'grogs pa bzhin du mngon sum dbang po'i yul du snang zhing mi 'bral ba'igrogs su 'grub par gyur cig: rtag tu gtam gyi lab grogs su mchis par gyur cig: dbang du 'du zhing bran du 'khor bar gyur cig: 'bangs su 'gyur zhing las la 'junapar gyur cig: 'grub pa'i ltas mtshan mngon du gyur cing 'phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs med du 'grub par gyur cig: ces lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes susman lam 'grub pa' bden brngod ci mang dang sngags rnams bzlas so bdud 'joms rdo rjes so/ dge legs 'phel

〉( rdo dgongs su gsol lo dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal po: dgyes bskyed gnam sman chen mo: 'byung ba dus bzhi'i rgyal mo bka' nyan dzam lha gter bdag dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga: gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po las ma 'da': dam tshig dbang gis sgrub cing brten pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs cig byon cig: badz+ra sa ma yā dza dza: lan gsum / chos skyong gtor ma byin rlabs ni stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib kyi rnam pa thams cad: rigs lnga yab yum rnam par dbang bskur: me rlung 'phrod pa'i brda thabs kyis dngos po mtshan ma thams cad bsregs sbyang bkrus la rang bzhin zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur ka ā:hū ha ho trī: lan gsum brjod dngos po dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag la rnam pa 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung po zad mi shes par gyur badz+ra spa ra ṇa kho: rang nyid dbang chen rta mgrin du gsal ba'i

thugs ka nas 'od zer glog 'byugs pa ltar 'phros te: rdo rje chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad: sngon gyi bka' tha tshig drananas rang bzhin gyi gnas so so nas rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa dam tshig gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir byon par bsam: panyu ma hā kro ta dharmā pā la tri sh+ya ya ho:

thaX chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i zab sgrub dbang gi gter bum zhes bya ba bzhugs so:sgod pa na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye 'a rnaskoskas/ kho dben pa'i gnas su bsgrub pa'i dam rgya bsdam pad+ma dbang gi bsnyen bsgrub sngon song ba'i dkyir 'khor gtor ma bla rdo srog 'khor bkod bskang rdzas yo byad nam mkha'i mthar mnyam spel ser sna bral ba'i dngos 'byor rgya cher bsags bsang khrus bya zhing 'gab 'dre mnan pa gnad bde ba'i ngang la mkhon 'dzin dben par gnas brtse zhing gdung shug drag po'i lhader gtad rnam pa kun du yad la dran zhing 'bod dang po mdun bskyed bsgom pa'i ram pa ni hū : rang nyid pad+ma dbang chen gsal ba'i mdun: yid sprul ngo mtshar dga' ldan lha yi gnas: khamasagasum yongs kyis bkur sti phul ba yi: phywa g.yang 'dod dgu'i sprin 'khrigs gzhal med khang: rat+na lnga las grub cing nor bu'i mdzes: me dang chu shel las grub saṃ ska har phyinang kun tu 'ja' 'khyugs 'od zer 'bar: zla gam dgu rdzogs 'dod yon lha mos bstod: drwa mig thams cad stong gsum nor snas phyur rnam pa kun tu phywa 'bebs g.yang
