'beb pa'i: pho brang dbus su pad+ma rā ga'i khri: yangs shing rgya che khod snyoms pad zla'i khar 'dod lha dmar po'i g.yas nas nor bu stobs: dga' ston bu mo'i dar zab 'dod yon 'bul: gzhon nu'i tshogs kyis mdun nas g.yos sbyor byed: de dbusamaḥyig 'khor 'das dpal yon dril: yongs gyur dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal po ni: dbang gi 'oda'abar zhi ma khro 'dzum sgegs: chags pa'i zur mig skal ldan yongs la brtse: ljang sngon ral pa thod bcing nor ba'i mdzes: rin chen snyan cha pad+ma'i thod gdeng bkra nor bu mthing ser dmar po'i do shar 'phyang: zal bu sil ma stang gi rtsa ru sleb: phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu dbang rgyal 'dzin: lha klu mi yi 'dod yon gang 'os spro: g.yon pas 'ching byed rlung gi zhags pa bsnams: 'khor sgob skye rgu'i blo yid dbang du byed: gter gyi bum pa bzang po gru mor bslang: bshad dang sgrub pa po la mthun rkyen spyor: chags pas nyams 'bar bde ba'i liṅga bsgreng: ting 'dzin dga' bzhi'i byed par snying nyer 'gyur: 'dzum pa'i zhal bzang snga 'gyur bstan la phyogs: lte bar nyi ma'i 'od kyis rmongs

sgo da nga mun sel:phyag zhabs rat+na'i gdu bu phra yis mdzes:gyad thabs bsgrad pas 'gong 'dre pho mo gnon:g.yon du ma:las dgyes bskyed gnam sman ma dmar ser zhi ma khro 'dzum chags bde 'bar:ljang sngon ral pa thod bcing pad+ma'i brgyan:gcer bu rat+na'i do shal nu pad rgyas:phyag g.yas gri khug yab la reg cing btud bde stong gnyis su med pa'i phrin las 'gyed:g.yon pas nor bu'i gzhong pa dku la brten sgrub mchog pho mor dgos 'dod longs spyod stsol:zhabs gnyis dor stabs yab kyi g.yon ngos rol:bde stong a nu'i bstan pas zhabs tog sgrub:chags pas zil 'khrigs dbang gis 'od khyims g.yo:shar du 'byung ba dbyar gyi rgyal mo ljang:ku sha'i chunapo pad+ma'i lcags kyu 'dzin rtsi shing lo bcud dkar thog rgyas par byed:lho ru 'byung ba dpyid kyi rgyal mo ser:snang gsal dang ni pad+ma'i zhags pa 'dzin:long par drod 'beb sa gzhi'i mdog kyang bskyed:nub tu 'byung ba ston gyi rgyal mo dmar:ba dan rtse gsum pad+ma lcags sgrogs bsdom:stong par bsil bskul 'byung ba rlung gis g.yo byang du

'byung ba rgun gyi rgyal mo dkar: lcags kyis sgrom bu pad+ma'i dril bu dkrol: grangs lhag ngad 'byin 'khyag pa bu yug bskyed: dus bzhi'i snang ba bskyed pa'i lha mo rnams pado shal rin chen rgyan gyis spras: 'byung ba yongs la dbang byed las kun sgrub: de rgyab 'dzam lha dkar ser mar ljang dang: smyug 'dzin dkar po 'dzam khra mched drug po:gnyer lhun chags mdzes 'dzum blta na sdug: dbang gi lcags kyu rte'u le'i skyal pa 'dzin dar dang rat+na nor bu'i rgyan cha spras skal ldan bu la chos mthun longs spyod gzhan yang dpal mgon bdun cu sde brgyad tshogs: ma 'dres gza' skar bkra bzhin lam mer gsal rang rang thugs sgog sa bon las spros pas 'od kyi khams gsum gnas mchog nas: dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal po spyan drangs bstim: snyan gsan 'bul ba ni ho dgongs su gsol 'i : gsan du gsol: ri bo gru 'dzin gyi zhing la mnga' dmadzad pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje can dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pas dbang phyug ma hā de wa tshogs bdag ga ṇa pa ti lha chen 'dod pa'i rgyal

cheX dbang phyug ma hā gdong drug: lha dbang mtshon 'khor nag po 'byung ba dus bzhi'i rgyal mo: nor bdag 'dzam lha spun drug dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga lha sran dregs pa sde brgyad bka' 'dza ra sprul pa bran gasku ga dang bcas pa rnams: gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi na bzhugs sam gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun na bzhugs sam: 'dod pa khams kyi gnas mchog na bzhugs sam: 'jigs rung rtsub 'gyur gyi tshal na bzhugs sam rgya bod mdo rtsang gi sgrub gnas gang na bzhugs kyang dengs gi gnas mchog khyad par can 'dir sgrub mchog skal ldan gyi mos ngor gshegs cig byon cig: badz+ra sa ma ya dza:dza: spos bsregs rol mo dang 4sa te spyan 'dren pa ni hū hrī: ting 'dzin 'phrul bsgyur lha yi gnas mchog nas: lha dbang lha yi bla ma 'dod pa'i rgyal: gnam sman yum dang dus bzhi'i rgyal mo bcas: gdung sems bu yi 'bod do da tshur byon brtse ba'i zhal bzang skal ldan mos ngor ston: phyu g.yang longs spyod 'dod dgu'i char ba phob: o ma hā de bā lo ki shā ri sarba sa ma yā dza dza: bzhugs gsol ni hu hrī: dad pa dam

tshog ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyi: dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas yo byad bkram pa 'dir: lha yi bla ma 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs khyod: phywa g.yang dpal bcas sgrub pa'i rdzas la bzhugs sa ma ya stum sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan phyag 'tshal ni snyu hrī srid na mtshungs bral bla ma spyan ras gzigs: bstan pa'i dpal bzhings dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal: don gyi ye shes 'jig rten zol tshul can ma hā de wa khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal na mo ma hā de bā a ti byu ho: pra ti ts+tsha ho: mchod pa ni hūṃ trī dga' bzhi'i dbang phyug 'dod yon lha mo'i tshogs dkar ser dmar mthing ljang smug mdzes 'dzum sgegs: sor rtser panyu ngasgran steng bkod pa'i rdzas: bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid nor sna bdun: phyi nang gsang ba'i nor bu chabadun dang: 'bru sman pad phreng dar 'phan rnga yab gdugs dung gling rol mo mkhar rnga cing te'u sogs: thugs mthun yo byad nam mkha'i khyon bkang ste: bro brdung glu gar mdzesapa'i rnam 'khyar bcas lha yi bla ma sras 'khor bcas la 'bul: dgyes te phyu g.yang 'dod dgu'i char pa phob: sang ma hwa de wa badz+ra pā dza sarba sa ma ya ā hūṃ: bstod pa ni hūṃhri

tha da ting 'dzin dbang phyug klong yangs nam mkha'i gter:skye med bdag nyid blta ba'i btang snyoms pa:mu bzhi'i dbang phyug kun gzhi'i bdag nyid can:lha chen snyoms 'jug dbang po khyod la bstod:gsal snang mi zad yangs pa'i khams la spyod:bcu bdun dbang po 'od lus 'ja' khyims bzung:zhi bde sgrub la brtse ba'i zil mig can:tshogs bdag gtsug na zla ba khyod la bstod 'dod pa'i khams su legs nyes stong sgog 'dzin:dga' bzhi'i ro la rol zhing rjes chags pas:a nu bde stong spyod la snying nye ba:lha chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po bde stong klong yangs gnam sman dga' bzhi'i gter:dgyes na bstan g.yo dpal 'dzin dus bzhi'i rgyal srid na phywa g.yang mchog stsol dzam bha la:dam ldan dpal mgon g.yog 'khor bcas la bdag dang bdag gi nye 'khor rtsa lag bcas:lha yi bla ma khyod la gnyer du gtad dge mtshan grags snyan srid na ya mtshan pas 'khor lo'i bsgyur rgyal dpe mtshungs dbugs dbyung mdzod:sdug bsngal nyer 'che'i gdung sogs zhi ba dang:legs tshogs dge mtshan nam mkha'i tha

grur rgyas lha 'dre mi gsum snang ba dbang du bsdus dgra dang bgegs las rgyal ba'i phrin las mdzod: mtha' yi dmag dang phyi rol kla kle'i sde: bstan la 'gal zla ston pas nyes pa can smon lam log pa'i ngan gtong bdud kyi rigs: ming gi lhag mar bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: pad+ma'i rang lugs snga 'gyur yo ga gsum: chu bo bzhi ldan sems klong man ngag bcud bstan pa 'dzin pas skyes bu sbyin bdag bcas dbu 'phang mdzad phrin dar rgyas phrin las mdzod bkrag gsal dkyil 'khor dam tshig rdzas bsags te ting 'dzin yo byad ro mo'i sgras bskul na sngon nas g.yar dam can gyi lha chen po grub rtags mtshan ma bzang po bstan du gsol: 'dzab dmigs ni bdag nyid pad+ma dbang chen gyi thugs sgog hrī las 'od zer 'phros: lha chen dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i thugs rgyud bskul khams gsum bstan g.yos dpal 'byor thams cad bdag sgrub pa po la stsol bar dmigs la/ skye ma hā de wa a pa ra tsit+ta u ma ga ga de wi ha ri ni sa bā su de wa sa ma ya hrīX dza dza: rtsa sngagasachu bo'i gzhung ltar bzlas ting 'dzin spro bsdus gnad kyis gzir slar yang

thaX dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i sku yi cha thams cad nas dbang gi 'od khyims phyogs kun tu spros te steng lha yi mnga' thang: bar mi dpal 'byor: 'og klu yi nor sna 'jin rten dregs pa'i che btsan: 'gro ba bu pho bu mo dge btsun sngags skyes bon po: drangs sgong sman dang rig byed: rgyal blon 'bang phyug gnag nor thams cad meramer mnga' dbang du bsdus nas bdag sgrub pa po la stsol bar dmigs: la sngags bzlas gzhan yang srid pa dus bzhi'i rgyal mos 'byung ba'i dwangs bcud thams cad bsdus te stsol ba dang: 'dzam lha mched drug gis phywa 'bebs g.yang 'beb mdzad nas zas nor longs spyod 'dod dgu'i char chen po dbab nas gnas khang bang mdzod ra ba khyims tshes thams cad mer gyis gang nas rab tu rgyas par bsam la: rtsa sngags sarba rat+na bā su na na kha dhe a dri tri a ba ya bsdus bsdus sirnyi pha la hūṃ: smra bcad gdan drod mi yal bar zla ba gcigatu sgrub par bya bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad bye ba'o bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin gnad du zung nas khal gcig gis mchod dzos bya mar drang lnga bcu'i mar me 'bul sha khog che ba gcig gis brngan gro khal chang gi ston mo bya 'bras bre

lnga yi phye mar spung lha shing sna tshogs dud pa spro nyin mtshan thun bzung skabs su gsol dang po 'od 'byug dri bzang 'thul skyes pa gzhen nu'i zas nor ster bud med yongs kyi dga' ston sbung de dag 'grub ba' rtags su'o michen bla rje bran du bkol nyi zla gdan gting ri rtser 'dug mi gtsang 'dam tshud gos la 'go zas nor mnga' thang rgyas pa'i rtags mgron chen mang 'tshogs g.yos sbyor byed lha khang nang du lha mi'i gang skar tshogs mang mo lag tuthon ljon shing rgyas pa'i thog du nyal de dag 'bod pa'i rtags su'o dmags mang dang 'grogs yul mang bcom stag gzigs 'brong g.yag 'brug sbrul zhon rtsi shing mang po bsregs cing skem de dag rbad pa'i rtags su'o sharlon za zhang pags pa mnye glad khrag bsre zhing rus pa brdung ro rdul 'thag tsang rgang lpags bkad de dag bsad pa'i rtags su'o dri ngan 'thul zhing lus po gzer ting 'dzin mi gsal bsnyen pa sdud snying sgog gzer zhing 'grosnying 'jug de dag 'khu ba'i rtagasayin pas 'khrug bskang mnol bsang 'gab 'dre mnan tshogasadang mchod pas bskang bar bya ma nusapa la sbyin gtong zab bzod gsol bshags pa rgya cher 'bul lo bzhin bsnyen bsgrubakha gso dang rgyun du bskang gsol 'bad mkhas na srung ma lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs ma 'a thang stobs 'byor grags snyan rgyas tshe 'dir dam chos sgrub la dbang bar chad dgra 'dre'i glags mi rnyed phyi ma thar lam byang chub

2 11 rnyed yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam mo shin tu zab pa'i man ngag 'di skal ba can dang 'phrad par shog bka' srung gza' bdud rā hu las thub par srung shig dam tshig can sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gter rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gnyan rgya gsang rgya gurgya brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang las smon 'phro 'dzom mthar phyin rdo rje nasabakra shis lha regasarin chen g.yu byur sgrub pa'i me tog dang bcas te bskul ba dang nye gnas mun sel nas rgyas dbang mtshon pas lha gos dang dga' spros lha phyag me tog dang bcas bskul ngor 7 kho bo sba pa'i rnal 'byor bdud 'dul nusaldan gling pas mkha' 'gro'i brda ris las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag me tri'i ming can gyis bgyis pa'o dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ legs so/ sarba maṅka le/ / dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i rten dar bri thabs la dbang gi dar dmar po'i leb la gser gyi 'dod rgyal yab yum bra de rgyab mu 'khyud bskor bkra shas rdzas rtags rgyal brad sna bdun nor bu cha bdun dpag bsam ldon shing 'dod 'jos ba mdzes pa'i bya grags snyan g.yu 'brug zil gnon khyung chen stag gzig dom gsum nyi zla skar gsum thams cad spusagatsangabakod legs yad du 'ong bar byas mthar mu khyud bskor bkra shas rtse mo dpung rgyan dbu can tshag med du bri yang mu khyud bkod pa'i mthar phyogs bzhir 'byung bsha' ri mo 'tshams su lcags zhags sgrogs dril nor 'dzan pa tra bcas

legs par bkod dar lce gsum la sngags tshan gsum sgog 'khor las byung ba ltar bri g.yang rdzasabazang drug bdud rtsi chos sman rnams byugagacing rten bzhugs rab gnasalegasapar bya zhing sgrub rten du bkod bkra shisadabangasdud kyi bya ba rtsom ched dar chen rlungs la byar zhing bsang chen bkyag la dung gling rol mo'i sgra sder na 'dod don bya ba gang sgrub kyang gegs med yid bzhin du 'byung bar gdod mi za'o sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya 'dod pa che ba mthar phyin rdo rjel 'dod chags ral grol nus ldan dpa' bo yis 'dod rgyal rten 'dzug dar chen brtsam pa'i dges 'dod yon bu mo thams cad shug 'byung shog sarba maṅga le

62 chos nyid nam mkha'i klongs mdzod las 'dod rgyal dbang sdud rlung zhags dmar po'i mnga' gsol bde chen rol mtsho bzhugs so:sgo / na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra me 252114 'dod rdzas sna tshogs stobs bzhi du mnga' gsol rdo rje glu yis bstod hrī:kun byed mkhan po skye med nam mkha'i klong:gang yang ma yin cir yang 'char rung ba'i:gsal byed me long lta bu'i rang bzhin can:'khor 'das yongs kyi byed por mnga' gsol lo:rten med dbyings las g.yo ba'i ba dan bskyod:'byung dang 'byung 'gyur kun gyi srog 'dzin cing:phung po khams dang skye mched yongs kyi gzhi:'phrul byed dbang phyug mchog tu ting 'dzin mi g.yo nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang:rtog med had po'i nyams la a 'thas te:skye mched mi bzhir 'thas pa'i btang snyoms klong:lha chen snyoms 'jug dbang por gsal snang zhi byed zla ba'i yid mtsho rtsating 'dzin rgya mtsho bkra ba'i 'phrul mo che:bcu bdun snang ba byed pa'i sa lam mkhan:'gags bral gsal byed dbang por snang srid rgyu mar bkra ba'i 'phrul mo che:dbang

yul rtog bcas 'dod khams rigs drug sogs:thams cad ma 'gags dbang za srog la spyod:'dod khams yongs kyi byed por rgyal bstan yongs la brtse ba'i zur migagayo:nang rgyud yo ga gsum la rjes chags cing:a ti 'bras bu'i zab mdzod sgog ltar 'chang:bka' gsang 'dzin mdzad mchog tu zhi ba snying rjes dbang phyug spyan rasagazigs bde mchog dbang gi rgyal po rta mchog dpal:rjes chags ro la rol mdzad 'dod pa'i rgyal:'khor 'das yongs kyi byed por tshogs brgyad rang mdangasadregs pa sde brgyad 'phrul:yul brgyad ma 'gags lha srin cho rol bsgyur lugs 'byung sems rtogs lha 'dre bsam mtha' yas dregs pa'i spyi dpal mchog tu zhi mdzad chen po dung gi phreng ba 'dzin:rgyas byed tshe 'phel gser mdog gter bum 'chang dbang sdud dmar po pad+ma'i lcags kyu 'dzin:drag mdzad srog gi gshed mar rgya gar chos mdzad ma hā kro dha dang zas nor gter bdag rlung zhags dmar po grags:rtsub 'gyur tshal du mtshon 'khor nag po dang:'byung lngar khyab byed dbang phyug rol mo glus bskul

za da / khams gsum nor sna'i mchod 'bod rbad bsad pa'i dam tshigs mchog gis bsgrubs: yar phyed tshe 'di mar phyed phyi ma ste don gnyis lhun grub byed por ki bswo cha gsum 'dzoms pa'i dpal bskyed do: mchod bstod brten pa'i dam tshig gzhi btsug nas: lha mi dpal gsum rdo rje'i srog bsre te: kun bzang gdod ma'i sa la skyel ma marngordod de ltar bskang ba'i phrin las 'grub daro sagrub bza po char ltar 'bebs rno nus byin rlabs bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang mthar phyin rdo rje dang slob bu paṇa grol klongasayongs rnams kyis bskul ngo mi bzlog pa' slad du kho bo nus ldan rdo rjes spel ba/ sarba masgo le/

thaX chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las: dbang phyug 'dod rgyal dmar po'i rten 'dzug nyi zla'i ga'u bzhugs so:sgod ka na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye cha ga bye: rgya tshad las 'das dbang sngon be+eḍūr ris chags pa'i rdul bral rgya mtsho shel mig 'dzum: 'dzin mar rin chen dang po'i me tog yung: rab 'bar dbang gi kha tog bde ba'i gzugs: legs bskyod rlung gi ba dan rnam pa lnga: 'dod rgyal dbang gi lcags kyu brten phyir 'bul chos skyongs rten la bzhugs shing bsrung skyobs mdzod rab yangs me chu'i nor bu zer bcas ngar: dpa' gtum rngam pa'i gdong lnga bkra ba 'dzin lha klu mi yi dga' ston rgya khyon yangs yangs pa 'byangs pa ngur zug rang 'dre'i sde: zil gnon 'brug mo char gcod thog dang glogs ting 'dzin 'ja' lnga'i khang pa ri mo'i dbyig: 'dod rgyal dbang gi rgyal po brten phyir 'bul chos skyongs rten la bzhugs shing mthu ma chung: dge mtshan dpal gyi dam pa bkra shis rtags: nyon mongs gdung bas mi brjed rin chen rdzas: phas rgol

g.yul las rnam rgyal rgyal po'i srid:gsang sngags nus mthu phun tshogs snyan phur dang:'khor ba'i 'khor lo chos skur bsre ba'i mtshon:gdul dka' nyon mongs 'dul ba'ithun rdzas ris:bdud bzhi'i dpung las rgyal ba'i go khrab rnams:'dod rgyal dbang gi chos skyongs rten la bzhugs shing skyabs ma zhan:dwangs gsal me long ngos sugazugs snang 'pho:'od 'bar dung ri'i ngos su gdong lnga brten:be+eḍūl mkha' la gser gyi nyi ma bzhad skal ldan sgrub mchog dpal du chos skyongs 'grogs de bas dmatshig mchog la g.yo med par:'di phyi'i re smon bcol ba'i rnal 'byor la:'dod rgyal dbang gi lcags kyu'i sdong grogs mdzod:mi dang dgra bla ma bral kha 'dzin mdzod dgongs pa'i mthil du bzhugs pa'i dkor nor srungs:bsam pa'i ba dan rtser bskyod don kun stsal:mngag pa'i pho nyas las kun lhun gyis grub:chos skyongs khyod brten donaganyis yad bzhin 'byung rnam mkhyen sa lam bsgrub pa'i grogs kyis la:rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bshul lam skyel ma mdzod:rgyu lus zag pa dwangs ba'i phrin las bcol tha

za da1 tshig ma g.yel phrin las lhun grub mdzod sa ma yu de ltar phul bas dgyes pa bskongs phrin las lhun grub the mi tshom sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thim snyi zhes pa 'ang mun sel gyithugs 'dun skongs phyir nus ldan rdo rjes spel ba dge legs 'phel sarba ma le/

—1 chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal po la yon 'bul yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so:—1 na tho gu ru pad+ma ka ra yi rnamasna rkye: chos dbyings mi 'gyur nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nas: lha dbang 'dod rgyal bdag la snying nye zhing: re ba'i zhing sa yongs su bkang ba'i slad: ting 'dzin rol mtshor 'khrungs ba'i nor sna las: thugs rjes bsil grib skyabs la brten gnas phyir: rin chen gdugs mchog gser g.yu ldan pa 'bul: chags thogs bral ba'i shes rab phun tshogs phyir: 'phur rtsal gshog ldan gser nya rin chen 'bul: chos kun ris med khong du chud bya'i phyir: 'dod 'byung bum pa bzang po rgyan ldan 'bul: gsang sngags chos kyi bden pa grub pa'i phyir: bkra shis rgyang grags dung dkar g.yas 'khrul 'bul: 'chad rtsod rtsom la thogs pa med pa'i phyir chags pa'i rdul bral rab mdzes pad+ma ting 'dzin mi 'gyur dgongs rgyud gter rnyed phyir: phun tshogs bsam 'grub dpal gyi be'u 'bul: sku ni mi g.yo sgrub rgyud mthar phyin

phyir: dpal ldan rnam rgyal dge legs rgyal mtshan 'bul: gzhan snang gdul zhing 'brel tshad don ldan phyir: dbang bsgyur rtsibs stong ldan pa gus bcas 'bul: yid la re ba'i don kun myur 'grub phyir: bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po 'bul gyis bzhes: pha rol smon log dgra sde tshar gcod phyir: 'phrul ldan rno mthong ral gri 'bar ba 'bul phas rgol rbod gtong rigs sngags bzlog pa'i phyir: khro rgyal rol pa'i phyag mda' yung dkar 'bul: 'brel tshad don ldan rig 'dzin sar 'god phyir: gser gyi rdo rje dung dkar dril bu 'bul phrin las mi nub 'khor ba dong sprugs phyir: chags pa dbang sdud pad+ma'i lcags kyu 'bul: bdag gi re 'dod grub phyir bzhes su gsol: phrin las rgyang thag ma rang dbang gi lha: dngos grub phyis su ma g.yer dbyar dam can: 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das dge mtshan gyis: bdag dang chos rgyud 'tsho zhing bkra shis nas sridan ya mtshan che zhing bsngags brjod bzhin: phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i phrin las mdzod: de ltar 'bul bas bsod nams 'phel mang 3 thang yon tan rab tu rgyas dbul rgud phri skyon mi 'byung zhang

za da1 bsam don lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya zhes pa'ang ting 'dzin dgongs mtsho rdol ba'i rba rlabs lasamun pa sel phyir gser gyi zebs ma rin chen sgron me'i 'od du snang ba maṅga la/ nusaldan rdo rjesaso/

41 chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las dbang phyug 'dod rgyal dmar po la gnyer gtad rdo rje'i rdzongs chen bzhugs so:rjod na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye rgya tsho rdo dngos 'byor yad sprul mchod sprin stobs 'dod don gnyer gtad bya ba ni hrī dza:lha dbang lha yi bla ma 'dod pa'i rgyal:rjes chagasabade ba mchog bskul u ma yum:tshad med dga' bzhi'i rang gzugs ma sring bzhi:dgos 'dod char 'bebs nor lha gter bdag tshogs:grong khyer sum brtsegs lha yi phobrang nas:ting 'dzin 'phrul gyis gnas 'dir da tshur byon:'dod yon rol ston sna tshogs rgyan rdzogs rol bdag nyid brtse bas ma dor gtan grogs kyis:bkra shisagasum ldan slob dpon man chad nas rigs gnas cung zad bslab mkhan yan cha da kun:bdag gi mgon dang ded dpen mchog yin pas:rtag par srung la sku tshe mdzada'aphrin bskyed:thub bstan spyi dang snga 'gyur rdo rje'i theg khyad par pad+ma'i rang lugs — gtar chos:bdagacag laju ga gan sa lam gyi dam bcas ste:rtag par srung la bshad

sgrub dar rgyas mdzod: dgon bzhi gtsug lag zur ba man chad nas sgrub pa'i gnas yul phra mo yan chad kun: 'di dag bdag gi phun tshogs gnas lags pas: rtag par srung skyobs byin phob tshug brtan mdzod rgan gyi pha dang khu bo man chad nas: mdang skyes bu dang tsha bo yan chad kun: 'di dag bdag gi gdung dang rigs yin pas rtag par gdung rigs skyong la 'phel rgyas mdzod: rin chen gser dngul zangs lcags man chad nas mu tig rdo sgyus lan tshar yan chad kun: 'di dag bdag gi dkor dang rgyan yin pas: dkor rgyan srung la 'byor ba phun tshogs mdzod: rta dang glang po mdzo 'bri man chad nas: be lug ba dang tsa ra yan chad kun 'di dag bdag gi phyugs dang nor yin pas phyugs nor skyongs la grangs spel brjid chags mdzod: chos skyongs gzhi bdag brten mkhar man chad nas: rtsa sogs gnas khang mu ru yan chad kun 'di dag bdag gi nyer bzung brtsan khang ste: nyer bzung brtsan khang skyong la rkyen bral mdzod: sbra khang sbis dkar bsil khyims man chad nas: thog khang lo khyims phur bo yan chad kun: 'di dag

zas bdag gi gnas khang phra rag ste: gnas khang srung la mnga' thang dpal rgyas mdzod yul gyi mi dpon rje blon man chad nas 'bangs 'khor bran g.yog khol po yan chad kun: 'di dag bdag gi yul mi rtsa lag ste: yul sde srung la btsan phyug 'phan dar mdzod: bskyed byed ma dang gsang yum man chad kun: sring mo bu mo tsha sman yan chad kun 'di dag bdag gi srid phywa mtsho mo ste: sring mo skyongs la bu tsha btsan dar mdzod: khrab rmog bem phub tshem tshem man chad nas lwa ba byang dkar ras gos yan chad kun: 'di dag bdag gi go dang gos yin pas: go khrab srung la gos g.yang 'phel rgyas mdzod: dar gos zi ring g.yang lugs man chad nas: gru gu khab dang rkud pa yan chad kun: 'di dag bdag gi 'brang dang chas ga ste: 'brang rnams srung la bang mdzod phyur bur bskyil: dug mda' me mda' mda' chen man chad nas: gri dang shang lang dgra zor yan chad kun: 'di dag bdag gi rno ngar mtshon cha ste: go mtshon srung la dgra dpung cham la phob: mdor na rnal 'byor yid la mdza' ba'i rdzas zas gos rgyan cha sbra khang gnas

mal sogs: mdor na bdag tu bzung ba'i dkor nor kun dregs pa'i gtso bo khyod la gnyer du gtad: nyin dang mtshan mo dus dang rnam pa kun: bya ra mel rtse 'tsho skyongs ji bu mdzod: dgra dang bgegs kyi dbang du mi gtong bar: phyogs las rnam rgyal bkra shis phun dzardogs mdzod de ltar gnyer gtad byas pa yis phrin las rab 'byams lhun 'grub cing bkra shis na ge legasadapal rgyas 'gyur ze tshom med do rdo rjes bka' sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang slob bu mthar phyin rdo rje dang paṇa grol zung nas bskul ngor nus ldan pas spel ba ma la

62 chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i 'khrugs bskang 'khu ldog rang grol bzhugs so:sgo pa na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra mā jabacanashādzadang rnal 'byor dam ldan pho mo yis bsnyen bsgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe bka' srung 'khru ba'i rtags byung na 'di nyid la ni brtson pa ra bya mchod salongs spyod rgya cher bsags sngags dang phyag rgya'i sbyangs bsgyur spel lha gsal to 'dzan brtan po yis bsrung ma mdun du gsal byas te hrī dza:khams gsum lha yi dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal:ting 'dzin 'phrul gyi gter la mnga' mdzad pas:'jig rten dbang phyug gtso 'khor sprul par bcas:dad pas 'bod do ma g.yer da tshur 'dus:'dod bde rang mtshan gol zhing chags pas spyad ser sna'i dbang gis mchod rdzas yo byad chung rgyu chung phud nyams le lo g.yeng dbang gis:lha khyod 'khu sdog 'khrugs pa'i skyon byung na mchod rdzas longs spyod bcas te bskang zhing bshags:brtse ba'i mdangs ston chags nyams dag gyur cig don dam nyid du gdod nas rnam dag pas 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i spros pa mi dmigs

kyang: tha snyad sor byang sngags sdom nyam pa dang: bskyed rdzogs gnad ral ting 'dzin g.yer ba dang: ma rtog log 'khrul lta ba dman dbang gis: lha khyod thugs dang 'gal ba'i dri ma kun: dbyings rig rnam par dag pa'i klong du bshags: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa mchog brtsal te: mi grogs lha yi kha 'dzin srung skyobs mdzod dgra bdud bgegs dpung 'am la phab pa dang: chos mthun bsam pa 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma ya: de ltar grangs bsogs nakhu ldog gi snying nye bu sdug bzhan duskyong gang bcol phrin las thogs med cing bsod nams longs spyod dpal thob 'gyur sam yu gurgya brda thim lha zhes pa'ang las smon 'phro 'dzoms mthar phyin nasabakra shi lha reg dang rin chen gnyasapa'i skyel bcasabaskul ba dang nye gnas mun sel nas kyang dge'i skyes du mar bcas te yang yang bskul ngor kho bo nu ldan 'du pa rtsa gyisamakha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul mdzod lasabasgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni snying nor me tri'i bgyis pa dge legasa'aphel sarba masgo le/

tha ༷ chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las: lha chen 'dod pa'i rgyal pos g.yang 'bod dbang gi lcags kyu bzhugs so:za daX na smo gu ru ya dgyes sprin mchod rdzas sna tshogs stobs dbang gi mda' dar g.yab byas te hrī dza 'bod do dbang gi lha mchog 'dod pa'i rgyal khams gsum grong khyer brtsegs pa'i pho brang nas: rig 'dzin 'phrul gyi dbang phyug gtso dang 'khor: dam tshig dag pa'i 'bod do da tshur byon: lha klu mi yi dge mtshan yod do cog:grags snyan tshe chos bsod nams nor gyi gter sgrub mchog bdag la brtse ba'i 'dzum bcas stsol: chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba mthar phyin nas: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i 11gas ma:rdod cig: de ltar g.yang 'bod bsdus pa 'di rgyun khyer bzlas na chos mthun rgyas 'byor ba gegs med lhun gya grub ze tshom med do sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu h+ye snyi zhes pa'ang slob bu mthar phyin don gsal gnyas nas bkra shis dge ba'i skyes bcas bskur ro ra nus lan pas spel ba maṅka le

tha chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las: dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i gsol mchod dbang gi lcags kyu bzhugs zad / na mo gu ru padha ka ra mā bye/bamismonasmo dga' ston mchod sprin sbyangs bsgyur spel lha gsal ting 'dzin brtan po yis rkye ting 'jin lha yi dbang phyug bla ma che: 'dod pa'i rgyal po srid gsum phywa g.yang bdag: gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol dbu 'phang bstod: grags snyan tshe chos nor gter char pa phobs: de ltar bskang bas phran las bsgrubs dgosa'adod longs spyod char ltar 'bebs no nus byin rlabs bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu h+ye brda thimaḥsnyi zhes pa'ang slob bu mthar phyin don gsal gnyis nas bkra shis lha regs dbang mdog zhags pa dge mtshan lha'i skyes bcas bskul ngor nus ldan pas spel ba maṅga le

(1 g.yang 'bod bsdus pa ni kyi: lha yi bla ma nyi ma'i gos can srid pa gsum gyi dpal 'dzin pas: 'dod pa'i ro la rjes su chags bzhin 'dzum dang zur mig g.yo bshan du: 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das dge mtshan dpal yon chos srid phywa dang g.yang: ma lus sgrub mchog dpal stsol bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel pa'i gzhir gyur cig:'di yang nye gnas mun sel la nus ldan pas phul ba dge ches brten bzhugs ni hū hrī: ting 'dzin dbang phyug lha dbang 'dod pa'i rgyal: nam mkha'i dbyings phyugs dpal btsun gnam sman yum: 'byung ba'i dpal 'dzin dus bzhi'i lha mo dang dzam lha gter bdag nor skyongs sras 'khor bcas: snying nas brten bsgrub bskang gsol bsnyen lags kyis: brtse ba'i lha grogs kha 'dzin sdong grogs slad bla rdo sgog gi 'khor lor brtan bzhugs gsol: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: rten snying brjod la me tog 'thor rab gnas phrin las rgya mtsho 'grub sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya nye gnas mun sel nas nan bskul ngor nus ldan pas bras pa sa maṅga le bshags pa ni ho bde ba chen po'i brin las mkha' mnyam dus: rlung gi rjes 'gro bcu drug spyod pa'i mchog: lha klu

gnod sbyin rig ngan nye rgyu'i lam: rjes chags ro yi khams gsum zhu bder smin: 'on kyang chags pa'i myos shing gti mug pas: 'dod rgyal yab yum thugs dang 'gal ba'i las: bltas shing 'dzum la lag bcing sgo sbyor nas: dpa' bo'i rang bzhin pad+mor 'dzag pas skyon: rnal 'byor na na rag myong gyur sgrib pa gang: mi 'chab mi zed chags pa'i rdo rjer bshags: bde ba chen po'i ba nag pa bdag la stsol: badz+ra a nu rā ga haṃ baṃḥs ma ya ā: yig brgya bzlas pas nyams chags byas nyams rtogs yar ngo zla ltar 'phel sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya zhesapa'ang nye gnas mun lo la nus ldan pas phul ba sarba masko le

thaX chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las: dbang phyug 'dod rgyal dmar mo' phrin las dbang sdud lcags kyu bzhugs so:sgod ka na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra māḥ 18stosago phud gtor mchod sprin rgya mtshor bshams sngags dang phyag rgya'i spel byas te hrī: taing 'jin dbang phyug nam mkha'i lus can bde ba kun gyigazhi: lha yi bla ma 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs 'dod pa'i rgyal por 'dud: dngos bshams yid sprul rgya mtsho'i bstod cing bskang bar bgyi: 'dod don phrin las thog med lasadabang rlung rta 'phel rgyas malnga/da: yin ma hā dhe wa swā sti sidhi maṅga le dza yan+tu: grangs bsogs snying nye phrin las myur 'dod don bsam 'phel the mi tshom sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda tham snyi: zhes pa 'di'angadad ldan slob bu a rdo nas bkra shis ma regs bcas te bskul ro ra kho bo bdud 'joms rol pa rtsal gyis chos nyid nam mkha'i mdzod las bsgyur ba'i ya ge pa ni me tra'i mtshan can gyis bgyis pa dge sarba masgo la hū hrī: dbang phyug chen po byis pa lha lnga po stobs chen gzi 'bar 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs shig 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin gyis thams cad bskang: dman no 'gab 'dre chung sri 'dul
ba dang: byis pa'i tshe rje bsrungs skyobs mel rtse mdzod rnal 'byor gang bcol bsgrubs shig sa ma ya: ces grangasabasogs sla ba'i ched du nusaldan rdo rje'i brisapa dge legasa'aphel

zos chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las: dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyalapo'i phyag rgya khams gsum rab sdud bzhugs so:sgodang na mo gu ru pa d+mā ka ra yo dz+rarnganacanan 'a je lhar gsal tang 'dzan brtan po yis sgrub rdzas zhal shes ltar du bkod rmang sri 'gong 'dre brngan zhing bkar khrus dang gtsang sbra dag la 'bad rol mo snyan pa'i sgra sbar zhing gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad gyer tī rang nyid dbang chenarta 'grin gsal ba'i mdun: yid sprul khams gsum lha yi bkod rdzogs dbus:'dod dgu'i sprin 'khrigs dbang gi gzhal med khang: zla gam dgu rdzogs mchod pa'i lha mos rtse: de dbu'i rwa ga'i khri steng zla phyed khar: e yig dmar ser 'khor 'das dpal lon bstim yongs gyur dbang phyugs 'dod pa'i rgyal po ni: dmar gsal zhi ma khro 'dzum lang tshos 'khyud: phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu dbang rgyal 'dzin: lha klu mi yi phywa g.yang char ltar 'bebs: g.yon pas 'ching byed rlang gi zhags pa bsdam: 'khor slob skye rgu'i blo yid dbang du byed: gter gyi bum pa bzang po gru mor bslang: bshad dang sgrub

pa po la mthun rkyen sbyor: shin tu chags pa'i nyams 'bar liṅga bsgreng: bde stong ting 'dzin byed por snying nye 'gyur: ljang sngon ral ba thod bcing nor bus brgyan: brtse ba'i zur mig snga 'gyur bstan la brtse: ste bar nyi ma'i 'od kyi rmong kun sel gcer bu rat+na nor bu'i do shal mdzes: zhabs gnyis gyad kyis 'gong 'dre pho mo gnon g.yon du e:las dgyes bskyed gnam sman ma: dmar ser zhi ma khro 'dzum chags nyams 'bar phyags g.yas gri khug yab la reg cig btud: g.yon pa nor bu'i gzhong pa dku la brten ljang sngon ral ba thod bcing pad+mas brgyan: gcer bu rat+na'i do shal nu pad rgyas zhabs gnyis dor stabs yab kyi g.yon ngos rol: bka' 'khor 'byung ba dus bzhi'i rgyal mo ni rang rtag 'dzin cing 'khor 'das phywa g.yang sdud de mthar 'dzam lha nor skyong gter gyi bdag: ma 'dres kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin gsal: gnas gsum yig 'bru thugs sgog sa bon las: 'od 'phros 'khor 'das dregs pa spyan drangs bstim: 'dun pa rtse gcig tu gtad la oṃ ma hāde wa a pa ra tsit+ta u ma ga ga de wi ha ri ni sa bā su de wa

ca da1 sa ma ya hrī dza dza: 'bod sngags rtags byung bar du bzla las sbyor gyi sngags shams ni sarba rat+na bā su na na kha dhe a dṛ tri ā la ya bsdus bsdus sirnyi pha la t+t+waṃ: ci nusabazla zhing bskang gsol 'bad de nas mchod rjes bstod pa ni hū hrī: khams gsum dbang bsgyur lha yi bla ma rje: rjes chags ro la rol ba'i dam tshig 'dzin phywa g.yang 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs nor gyi bdag 'dod pa'i rgyal po khyod dran rtag par bstod: nor sgrub kun gyi rgyal po 'di pad+ma dab gi lcags kyu ste dran pa tsam gyis 'dod dgu'i char bslu med yid bzhin 'byung ba ni pad+ma nga yi gtan tshig yin rgyal tshabs bdud 'joms he ru ka mtha' mi'i gshed du bzhengs ba'i tshe gdam pa 'di dang 'phrad gyur nas bstan pa byang phyogs rgyas par byed 'brel tshad rig 'dzan zhing du 'god don gnyis lhun grub the mi tshom sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya brda thim dzi zhes pa 'da' las 'phros bskul ba'i 'bangs nyer lnga dang gter ston rang gi thugs mthun 'grub phyir nus ldan rdo rjes shar mar spel ba'i ya ge pa ni snying nor kun bzang nor bu' bgyis pa dge legs 'phe' sarba mang ga 'a ma

thaX chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i gsol mchod pad+ma'i lcags kyu bzhugs so:zad pa na mo gu ru padha ka ra ye cen nacasajurku dngos 'byor mched rdzas gtsang ma bsags yid sprul ting nge 'dzin gyi spel thogs med sngags dang phyag rgyas spel dgyes ston rol mo' sgra bcas te hrī dza: chos bzang lha yi 'dun sa sa zla gam dbang gi gzhal med khang: pad+ma rā ga'i khri steng nas: 'dod pa'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas: dad pas 'bod do da tshur byon: dam tshig dbang gi mos ngor bzhugs phrin las sgrub phyir lha phyag 'tshal: bdag gi grogs po mnga' gsol lo: thugs mthun phyi nang gsang mchod sprin: bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun dkar gsum mngar gsum zas kyi rig dar zab reg bya rin chen brgyan: sngags tshig glu gar rol mo'i sgra 'dod yon nam mkha'i khyon mnyam pa: ma tshang med pa'i dga' ston gyis dbang phyug 'dod rgyal gsol mchod bskangs gnam sman chen mo gsol dus bzhi'i rgyal mo gsol nor bdag rigs bzhi gsol mchod bskangs dzam

lha mched brgyad gsol mchod bskangs: bka' 'khor yang g.yog gsol mchod bskangs: skad cig 'bral med srungs shing skyongs: phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub rtsol rnala'abyor bshad sgrub gzhi 'dzug la: tshe chos mthun rkyen char ltar phob don gnyis lhun grub rgyal sa na tshe 'dir 'god pa'i grogs mdzod cig: dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: shinatu zab pa'i rno nus can skal bar ldan pa'i dpal du shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya zhes pa 'di'ang grogs rasnang ming can gyis bskul ngor bdud 'dul nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba' brda' ris las bsgyur ba'i ma ge pa na snying nor kun bzang nor bu'i bgyis pa dge legasa'aphel

tha ༷ chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las: dbang phyug 'dod rgyal dmar po la phrin las bcol ba gter gyi bum bzang bzhugs so:zad na mo gu ru parnya ka ra ye 14za/dza dga' ston mchod dzos sna tshogs stobs blo snying rtse gcig gtad bcas te phrin las gas po bcol ba ni kye: skye med nam mkha'i dbyings su mngon 'phags pa'i: khams gsum lha yi dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal: yab yum 'khor bcas brtse ba'i zhal bzang ngoms: ting 'dzin yid mtshor 'khrungs ba'i dga' ston rol: srid na ya mtshan che bar bsngags pa yi dge mtshan ma lus rnal 'byor dpal du stsol: grags snyan rlung gi rtar bskyon yangs pa'i khams dbang du bsdus la 'khor slob gdul byar bsgyur: che btsan mnga' thang rnam mang thos sras nor: dam tshog sgog gcig chos sde'i dpal du stsol: bdud bzhi'i dpal bcom dgra sde tshar gcod pa'i: phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbu 'phang bskyed: nyin byed stong gi phul du phyin pa'i bla: snga 'gyur bstan pa'i sgon me gsal bar mdzod: 'khor 'das dag mnyams sku gsum rgyal

srid la rang dbang 'byer ba'i skal ba thob par mdzod: 'pho 'gyur mi dmigs rang byung sangs rgyas zhal: srid zhi'i byed po bdag la mngon sum stsol: blo yi sa lam 'gros lami ltos par: tshe 'dir kun tu bzang po'i rgyal sar skyol: zag bcas sgyu lus skye 'chis mi gdung bar mkha' la mkha' thim 'ja' lus thob par mdzod: rang rgyal bse ru lta bu ma yin par 'khor ba dong sprug chos sku mngon gyur mdzod tha snyad 'khor ba'i yid smon las dben pa'i a ti rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor bzhed don stsol lor 'das byed poradregs pa'i rjer 'dod don phrin bcol thog med 'grub sam ya rgya rgya rgya gurgya snyi zhesapa 'di'ang chosabadag bu slob yongasal phan phyir bdud 'dul bzhi pa nusaldan rdo rjesachoganyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod la bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni sa marnya bha dra ma ṇis bgyis pa dge'o/ legs so/ sarba masko le

che sa bh+yo:dbyings dang rig pa ye dag kyang:glo bur gzung 'dzin 'brul dbang gis:phyi nang bstan srung thugs 'gal ba:rtogs bral bde ba chen por bshags dam tshig nyams chags 'gal 'khrul nong:ma lus mi 'chab bzod par gsol: bshags pa ni kyi:dbang phyug 'dod rgyal tshogs kyi bdag po dgongs:bdag rmong 'khrul bas mchod bskang rdzas ma 'dzoms:lta ba'i ma chun sngags dang phyag rgya 'chol:ser sna'i dbang gis mchod rdzas yo byad chung:le lo g.yang bas bsnyen bsgrub gnad ma thang:grogs ngan rkyen gyis cho gas gsang ba bsgrags:rnal 'byor ma ldan bde ba gnas su zag:lha klu rig ngan bu mor chags pas spyad ting 'dzin bde gsal mi rtog nyams kyis myos:'dod bde rang gar bzung zhing gti mug pas:dbang phyug yab yum thugs dang 'gal bas las:cis mchis bzod gsol 'bul gyis thugs ma khrel dga' ba'i mdangs ston 'dzum bzang zur mig g.yos srid pas gnas su bde legs dpal yon spel:rnam mkhyen bsgrub pas lam grogs skyel ma mdzod:thugs dam ma g.yel badz+ra
sa ma yā: bzod gsol 'bul zhing phrin las bcol bsrung ma'i snying nye phrin las bsgrub sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya skyabs rjes zab gter gyis brda' phran bu las nus ldan bas bris pa ma le
62 chos nyid nam mkha'i 1nga mdzod las: dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i dgyes bskyed tshogs mchod bsod nams char 'bebs bzhugs so:

ca da pa na mo ma hā dhe wa ye byas/ras/ga dum bzhi bsod nams snod kyi nang mā da na dang ma sa sogs bza' bca' bayo bar 'os pa'i rigs bsags la byin gyis rlabs pa ni 〉ཿ rig pa'i rang mdangs mi zad nam mkha'i rgyan: 'dod yon tshogs su shar ba yul drug gter: gang shar rang grol dgongs pa'i dang blang nas: dbang chen lha yi bla ma dgyes phyir spel 7u:hūṃ ho: spyan 'dren ni hū hrī: snyoms 'jug chos dbyings nam mkhar 'byams klas shing: stong gzugs 'od lus bcu bdun bdag po che: brtse ba'i mig g.yo rjes chags ro la gdungs lha chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po srid na spa: rgyal bstan nyin byed sems can phan bde'i gzhi: bdag gis bsod nams tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyangs slad: lha yi bla ma 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: ma ar+ya lo ki shā ra sarba sa ma ya dza dza tshogs phud 'bul ba ni ho: dga' bzhi'i rang gzugs mjes sgegs lha mo yis: gser dngul gzhong par 'dod lnga'i tshogs ston gtams gus 'dud bde spror nyams 'byur dang bcas nas: lha dbang 'dod rgyal 'khor bcas dgyes phyir 'bul o ma hwa ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi

za da ka bar bgags ni tho blo chungartogs pas nyon mongs skyon du bltas: lta spyod rtsing mos dug lnga rang khar spyod: bag med dbang gis 'khrul ba bdag tu bzungs:gang yang thabs chen tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya ā: bsgral ba ni hū ཿ snying rje'i 'gal zlar gyur ba'i zhing bcu'i dgra: thar lam tshe srog rku ba'i gnyis 'dzin bdud: chos nyid lta ba'i rdzong 'phrang srog gis 'dzin: rnam shes dbyings sbyor gzugs phung tshogs su bsgyur: mā ra ya ru tra pra be sha ya phaṭa: bstab pa ni sno bde stong klong yang pad+ma rol pa'i ltor: chags pa'i bcing rnams gzugs yul bsgral ba'i rdzas: sha khrag rus gsum 'dod lnga'i gter chen po: gnyis med dgyes stobs 'khor ba ka dag mdzod: me sa rak+ta tsit+ta la khā hi: lhag ma ni bh+yo rgyal ba kun dngos sgo rgyan pad+ma yis: spyan sngar khas blang dam tshig srog thob pa'i: dbang phyug ma sring ging lang 'bar ba'i tshogs: pham phab bzhes la bde stong gsang sgod sgongs: rnam bzhi'i phrin las thogs med 'grab pa dang: sgrab mchog don gnyis brtsams pa'i grogs po mdzod: bka' dang

dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: ma ma trīng bā zhing khā hi chad tho na bh+yo: grongs khyer sum brtsegs lha yi pho brang na: 'jig rten dbang phyug rjes chags 'dod pa'i rgyal: ye shes las grub dregs pa kun gyi rje: ma dang chung ma mdza' mo bran mor bcas: las byed pho nya dzam lha gter bdag rnams sngon tshe dbang chen chags pa'i rdo rje yis: spyan sngar gsang srog thob pa'i dbang phyug che: de rjes khrag 'thung pad+ma'i spyan snga rnga tha rgod nyon mongs rgyas pa'i gdul bya las bde ba chen po'i rgyas 'debs gnyer byang thob: chags pas drangs te ye shes nyid du sbyor: de rjes bdud 'dul rol pa'i rdo rje yis: zhabs pad gtsug khur bstan dang de 'dzin sde 'tsho ba chos dang nyams rtogs yon tan sgo: mi nub gong 'phel byed por zhal bzhes bzhin: zhen med rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dge mtshan dpal gyi 'tsho ba'i phrin las mdzod: bstan ma na bh+yo: rlung gi rjes 'gro sems kyi spyod pa skyongs: legs nyes dam tshig tha snyad tsam du ston: nges don ye shes nyid las g.yo med pa: dbang phyug lha yi bla ma'i 'khor na gnas: bde ba'i dpal 'dzin bstan ma 'khor

thad ka tshogs bcas: bshal chu'i skyems bzhes rnam mang phrin las sgrub bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: rta bro ni sa: e nyid stong pa chos dbyings nam mkha'i sgrom: rkyen snang gang gis mi shig de bzhin nyid: lha 'dre ar gtad dgongs pa'i rgyas btab po: dam sri 'byung po sdang ba'i skal ba med: tshesnaXhūṃ swā hā stum bha ya nan nan: bzod gsol mi ho: gol sgrib rtog pas ting 'dzin ma gsal zhing le lo g.yeng bas mchod tshogs dus las 'das: bde stong 'gal zlar gyur pa'i chags nyams nong snying nas bshags so tshangs par mdzad du gsol: yig brgya bzlo bsngo smon ni ho:'dus ma byas pa mkha' 'dre'i dgongs klong du: blos byas dge ba zag dang zag med kun 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bzhag bgyi na: gnas lugs chos sku rtogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig brtan bzhugs ni ho: lus sems ji srid tshogs pa de srid du: sgrub rdzas bla rdo srog gi 'khor lo la: dbyer med brtan bzhugs 'jig rten 'jig rten las: 'das pa'i dge mtshan dpal yon char ltar phob: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra byu: shas brjod na na mo kun gzhi phra

rags rlung gi byed las kyis: 'khor 'das thams cad srog gi dwangs mar shar: lugs 'byung lugs rdogs srid pa kha lo ba: gting gsal chos skur dag pa'i bkra shis shog:de ltar dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal dgyes bskyed tshogs bsags 'dir brtson pas gang 'dod phrin lasa'abad med 'grub phyi nang bar chad bdud las rgyal tshe bsod nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel don gnyis lhun grub ze mitshom sa ma kā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zim snyi zhes pa'ang lung zin dkon mchog blo gros dang slob bu klong yang mun sel chosagasal rnams kyis yang yang bskur ba'i ngor kho bo sbasapa'i rnal 'byorabadud 'dul nus ldan rdo rjes shar mar spel ba dge legs 'phel sarba masgo lo

sgo da1 chos nyid nam mkha'i 1nga mdzod las: 'dod rgyal dbang gi lcags kyu'i bskul ba myur mgyogs glogs zhags bzhugs:zas rtsajo41 bskul pa dbang gi lcags kyu 'di mda' dar dmar po g.yab bzhin byed hrī:dza ting 'dzin 'phrul snang mi zad nam mkha' mdzod: dga' bde'i ro la rjesachags dam 'dzin pa: 'dod rgyal dmar po dbang gi lcags kyu can: mkha' dbyings lha yi gnas nas da tshur byon: bde stong zung 'jug spros bral rnal 'byor la: rgyan rdzogasa'akhor 'das dpal yon dwangs ma kun: bcud ldan dpal gyi bum pa bzang po bzhin: 'gyur med gzhi la bskyil ba'i phrin las bskul: snyoms 'jug gsal byed ting 'dzina'od lus can: bar snang dbang bsgyur dregs ldan brtan dang g.yo gdongs can nor gter rgya mtsho klu yi dbyig: ma lus gnas 'dir char 'bebs dam tshig bskul: rnamadrug tshe dang mthun bzhi'i bsod nams stobs: mun sel nam mkha'i nor bu chu shes dpal: grags snyan btsan phyugs 'phan dar mkhas dbang mthu: srid na mtshungs dpe bral

ba'i bsod nams bskul: bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i phun tshogs 'byer: klogs pa thos bsam 'khor lo'i sgro 'dogs chod: spong ba ting 'dzin 'khor ba'i srid rtsa bcom khyababardal bum sku'i 'khor lo dbang rgyas thob snum zad mar me gsos 'dre'i nor sgrub dang: gter srung yi dwags dbang mo'i sdug bsngal gter bri gang du mar gyur par 'khoraba'i gshis: gang min kha sbyor bdun ldan 'byor thob mdzod: rang don phyogs gcig bse ru lta bu'i khyu ngal ba 'bras chung bsod nams cha mthun pa: rgyang thag ring po'i salam 'bras bu stsol: yong grol a tis sa lam thod rgal mdzod: 'bod bskul dbang gi snyan gsan gang phul ba: thogs med yid bzhin grub mdzod sa ma yā yang yang bskul bsaphron las myur rno nusalag tu long dang gsal sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya bdo thim snyi zhes pa'ang slob bu mthar phyin nas rin chen gsum pas me tog bcas te bskur ngor nusaldan pas snyel ba dge legs 'phel don gsalargya mtsho yang dgyes pa'i rgyur gyur cig ma le

tham chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las dbang phyug 'dod rgyal dmar po'i bskang ba yid bzhin sprin 'khrigs bzhugs so/zadaka na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye dranatsho ba〉〉snye bskang rdzas yo byad ci 'byor bsags sngags da phyag rgya'i sbya sa bsgyur spel chos nyid nam mkha'i mdzod du spro dregs pa'i gtso mchog dgyes pa bskang mnyes nas dngos grub char 'bebs shi bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur sa ma yā rnga rol snyan pa 'i dbya sa bcas te hūṃ trī: khams gsum dbang bsgyur lha yi bla ma che: 'dod pa'i ro la rol pa'i rjes chags can: legs nyes stong sgog 'dzin pa'i gnyer kha ba: yab yum sras 'khor bcas te gnas 'dir byon: dad pa dam tshig dag pa'i mos ngor bzhugs phrin las lhun gyis grub phyir brda phyag 'tshal: dbu 'phang nam mkha'i dbyings su mnga' gsol bstod dgyes bskyed thams cad bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: snang srid sgyu mar bkra ba'i 'phrul mo che: phyi mchod dngos 'dzin dag pa'i la rdzas bdun: yid sprul bde chen rig ma'i gar bsgyur bcas dbang byug 'dod rgyal yab yum bskang phyir 'bul: chos

nyid nam mkha'i rgyan du shar ba yis: nyon mongs rang grol 'dod yon lnga yi sprin mdzes pa'i lha mo du ma'i gar dang bcas: dbang phyug 'dod rgyal 'khor bcas bskangs phyira'abul myong grol dam rdzas bdud rtsi a dṛ ta: chags pa rab bsgral rak+ta dmar chen po: 'dod yon lnga yi phung po ba lirnya: dbang phyug 'dod 'khor bcas bskangs phyir 'bul grags stong dbyangs snyan rnga rol mkhar rnga'i sgra: dkar gyi tshom bu mngar gyi skyems sna bkram: go khrab mtshon cha dpa' bo'i yo byad rnams: dbang phyug 'dod rgyal 'khor bcas bskangs phyir 'bul: phrin las sgrub phyir dza gad mtsho ltar bskyil: nyams pa gso phyir tshogs ston bsam mi khyab: bstan pa rgyas phyir dbang gi dar chen phyar dbang phyug 'dodargyal 'khor bcas bskangs phyir 'bul: lha bsang ring mo 'dod dgu'i g.yang 'khyil dang bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid nor sna bdun: nyon mongs gcong 'byin sman sna mtha' yas pa: dbang phyug 'dod rgyal 'khor bcas bskangs phyir 'bul: gsang ba'i thod rnga bcu drug ltag sprod dang: mi rkang rba dkar snyan 'gyur rol mo dang: bkra shis chos

thaX dung rgyang grags skad po che:dbang phyug 'dod rgyal 'khor bcas bskangs phyir 'bul khyad par mthun pa dbang lnga'i me tog dang:dug gsum mchod pa dgra bgegs sha khrag rus sha sna snying sna khrag sna bsam mtha' yas dbang phyug 'dod rgyal 'khor bcas bskangs phyir 'bul:ting 'dzin rol mtsho 'khrungs ba'i nor sna dang dar zab regs bya lho sprin ltar du spungs:gser dngul g.yu dang rin po che yi rigs dbang phyug 'dod rgyal 'khor bcas bskangs phyir 'bul:gnyis snang ru tra bsgral ba'i dpa' ston ni:dbang yul phung khams skye mched don snying dang:skye bzhi rten 'brel dus sbyor spar sme rnams:dbang phyug 'dod rgyal 'khor bcas bskangs phyir 'bul lta ba mkha' ltar yangs pa'i dgongs pa dang:spyod pa nyi ltar gsal ba'i brtul zhugs mchog:bsgom pa ma rig mun sel mnyam gzhag gis:'jig rten dbang phyug chen po bskang phyir 'bul:sku yi dgyes bskyed snang srid gdos mtshan grol:gsung gi dgyes bskang grags stong sngags su shar:thugs kyi dgyes bskang stong nyid snying rje'i phyug:yon tan

dgyes bskangs bsod nams dpal gyi 'byor: phrin las dgyes bskang dgra bdud rgol ba 'joms: nus pa'i mdangs bstan spyan ras gzigs dbang dngos: legs nyes sobasrung 'dod pa'i rgyal por gzigs: bde stong bstan pa rab rgyas dbang phyug shar: rnal 'byor grogs gcig tshog bdag glang po'i gdong: mtha' yi dmags bzlog mtshonachas 'khor lo can: skye rgu dbang bsgyur rlung zhags dmar po 'dzin stong pa'i rgyas 'debs u ma gnam sman yum 'byung ba'i srog 'phrog dus bzhi'i rgyal mo sogs: rtena'abrel tsam du gtso 'khor sprul par shar: don la mi dmigs ka dag kun bzang klong: yang dag rtogs na chos sku'i rang zhal spyod: nang dbyings 'bras bu'i rgyal sar skyel bsubyed: don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung ba'i phrin las sgrub: phul phyin dgongs pa'i bsnyen zhing bskul lags na: ma gdung bu la brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis: phrin las rab 'byamasadabyar gyi chu gter bzhin mi nub phyogs bcu kun tu khyab mdzod cig: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma ya: de ltar bskangs bas phrin las sgrub bsod nams dbang thang dpal gyis phyug grub

sgo rto pa'i 'bras bu mngon 'gyur zhing don gnyis lhun 'grub gdon mi za sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gurgya snyi ces pa 'di'ang bsod nams kyi 'phro 'dzoms mthar phyin nas bkra shis lha reg rin chen du ma' skyes bcas bskul ba dang sgob bu paṇa grol nas kyang nan tan chen po'i bskur ngor kho bo bdud 'dul nus ldan rdo rjes chos nyid nam mkha' klo mdzod kya bdo' las bsgyur ba'i ya ge pa ni me tri'i mang gis bgyas pa dge'o/ dge'o/dge'o/ legs so/ sarba maṅga le/

thaX sgo14spyo15 bskang ba ni i yang cig thams cad bskang ba ni: brdal khyab chos dbyings nam mkha' la snod gyi 'jin rten rgya khyon yangs bcud ni dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs: bde stong nyams dga'i bro gar bsgyur: gzugs snang rang grol rgyang zhags mdangs: grags stong 'dzin med rdo rje'i glu: dri mchog bdug pa pad+ma'i ngad: sna tshogs zhen med ro yi mchog bde ba chen po'i a dṛ ta: de nyid stong pa rak+ta'i skyems: 'byung 'jug gnas pa bā lirnyi: sems kyi dngos po spur ba'i ro rang rgyud cha ni phyi yi tshogs: nyon mongs cha ni nang gi tshogs: chos nyid mnyam sbyor gsang ba'i tshogs: ye shes cha rnams de nyid tshogs: lta spyod gdeng ldan rnal 'byor gyis: 'di nayang dag rol ston bkod: gnyis med mnyam pa chen po yis 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang: gnam sman chen mo'i thugs dam bskangs: dus bzhi'i rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskangs: dgyes pas bskang ba'i byin gyis rlabs: rnam bzhi'i phrin las 'grub pa dang phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub stsol: sgrub mchog don gnyis lhun grub shog
zhes pa'ang nusaldan bsasbyar ba dge zhing bkra shisapar gyur cig

sgo da nga rnal 'byor he ru ka yi zhal snga nas hor sogs dmags bzlog yin na 'di nyid zab kha tham hrī: ma chag pad+ma rā ga'i khri steng nas khams gsum dbang phyug lha yi bla ma khyod smon log mtha' ma'i gshed du da bzhengs ran: 'jigs bral mtshon 'khor nag po'i dpa' rngam bskyod: chad thor sbran pa'i gtor skyems 'di bzhes la: mtha' yi dmags dpung bzlog la mtshon rtse bsgyur: gros rog 'dun khang chom la rdzas sngags gtor: gtso bo che dgu sgrol la mtha' bstung nas: me rtag chu dang 'phrad pa'i dpe bzhin du: ming gi lhag mar bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod rang 'dod srid pas khyod bskul mkhan med kyang : bstan 'gror lhag bsam dag pa nga las su: khyod nyid dbang phyug thob pa don ma chung bdud 'joms dpa' bo'i bka' dam chud ma gsan mtha' mi rang gshed rang bab dus la bab: dmag 'khrugs mtshon chas 'khrul 'khor gzings pa bzlog: zhi bar ngal bsos bsil grib bde legs dpal: da ltar nyid du stsol cig sa ma yā: grangs bsogs dmod bor thal mo rdeb dgra dpu bzlog pa'i las 'di zab sa ma yā nor bsgrub yin na 'di nyad shin tu zab kha

thum kya:'dod 'byung dpal ster dbang phyug chen po la:lha klu mi yi dga' ston sprin gyis mchod:don gnyis gegs med 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod grangs bsogs bsod namasadapal la dbang sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya cha 6) ga 'kho zagozug 47)/ ཿsa btsan phyug 'phan dar tshe chos bu nor stsol 'di rnams gang 'dod kyis gsol mchod re yin kyang snyi srid gsumadabang bsdud mos na 'di zab gsung a tham kya:ma hā dhewa gsol mtshod bskang:khyod la phrin las bcol ba ni:snang srid 'byung ba'i dpal yon dang:dgon gnas gra slob rgyal blona'abangs:skyes pa pho mo yan chad kyis:blo yid sems gsum dbang du bsdus zas nor longs spyod 'dod don char:khab len rdo dang lcags 'phrad bzhin rang dbang medapar bdag la stsol:snyed ma hā dī wa hring mi snying 'gul 'gul mi blo bsgyur bsgyur sarba rat+na bā su na na kha dhe yi rdzinyi.a ra ya sirnyi pha la bsdus bsdus bstim:grangs bsogs dbangabasdud rno nus myur sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya 21 lngas go su la 'dzer kyang thugs rjes nyi ma shar gral ma shong yang rang gi mnog chos ste bsre bslad min no bka' yi gnang ba thob khyung drag rtsal la rtogs pa'i gshogs

sgo rto rtsal rgyas rang bzhin stong pa'i mkha' dbyings rlabs kyi gcod rol ba 'gags med thugs rjes rgya yis gdab rig pa'i rgyal po kun bzang pad+ma 'byung bde stong 'bum sprin tshogs kyi spyi rje'i drung bde thar slebs pa'i stobs dang ldan snyoms shor sarba maṅga la
thaX chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las: dbang phyug 'dod rgyal rlung gas zhag dmar po'i nor bsgrubs gter gyi bang mdzod pad+ma dbang gi lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

za dka na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye nacha rnatsutha( 1// rnal 'byor dben khrod 'grim pa'i tshe 'tsho ba sbyor pa'i yon bdag nyudabang phyug 'go rgyal sgrub pa la rdzas dang yo byad kun bsagasate phyi nangagasang ba'i dam rgya bsdam dang po zhi sgrub sngon song nas bskang gsol mchod rdzas rgya cher gtong smra bcad mi dang ma 'phrad par nor sgrub dbang gi lcags kyu 'jug sa ma mā thog mar rmangs sri bkar ba ni 'gong po sde bcu'igazugs su bkod 'gong rdzas ma rab yas dgu bsags nam mkha' mda' 'phang shing ris bkram lha gsal tang 'dzan brtan po yis26:dasko na malce gagasum la phyag 'tshal 81:rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i bden stobs dang ma hā de wa'i nus mthu dang:bden gnyis baspu med bden pa yis 'gong 'dre bse rag bral ba yis triḥ.a ra ya dza dza hūṃ baṃ hoX lan dgu brjod rin chen ming dang gzugs mdzes dang :'jam klas 'jigs kun bral ba yis:de bzhin gshegs la gus phyag 'tshal:glu gtor yid sprul 'byung gyur cig:byu ātshu ha ho hrī:lan gsumabarjod kya:khrag girba glong 'khrugs pa yis:grong khyer mun nag 'thib pa nas:gnod sbyin bu mo kun rgyu ma:ra skyes spu sdug rngam pa bcibs:mi lngags gos bgo sbrul gyis

sgo 1 brgyan: lag na bsha' gri nad khrag 'dzin: yas glud cha ma cho dgu khyer: bsod nams dpal la ma 'jab cig: dbang thang zas nor ma rku zhig: 'dira'adug rgyu ba'i skal ba med brag dmar 'dab ma rten bcas shing : kad phug skyib la gnas pa yis 'gong 'dre the'u rang mthu rgod ni rkang pa rlung gi 'khor lo can: kunamathong dbyug pa lag tu thogs: bsod nams rku ba'i snod stong khur: dbang thang can gyi dpal la 'jab: sems can bde skyid bcom pa'i 'dre: khyod kyi yas glud 'di khyer la gang ba stong du ma byed cig: yod pa chu la ma pho zhig: sri rkun bse rag ma byed cig: bsod nams thab khung ma nyams shig 'di ru 'dug pa'i rgyu skal med: rang rang so so'iganas su dengs ljon shing ger par gnas bcas shing: chu mig rlan la dbang za ba'i: klu srin nag mo bya rog mgoḥ bong bu nag po rol du khrid: glo mchin rol zhing rgyu ma'ibargyan: 'dod chags dmar mo ra nu ma: god kha gtong ba'i nyes byed mkhan: lan chags glud gtor 'di khyer la: gnas 'dir 'dug dang rgyu skal med: dkor gyi g.yang la ma

'jab cig: zas kyi bcud la ma rku zhig: khyims kyi snum la ma rdag cig: dkar rkun bzhen 'dre ma byed cig: nags tshal mang poli1nga dkyil nas sha rgo ri dwags dkoranor can: sde brgyad bu mo glang mgo can: tshang gza' mgo 'khor 'phrul gyi bdag: chang glud yas rnams 'di khyer la: ngan byed 'khor lo ma bskor zhig: than pa'i glad rgya mdakrugs shigs: 'byongs 'di khra tshas ma dmigs shig: 'dir 'dug skal med phyir dengs shig:grongs khyer dag gi sgo 'gram la rgyu ba'i sha za lce spyang gdongs: sha la dga'azhing khrag la rngam grongs khyer kun tu me khyer byed: tshe srog 'phrog pa'i gtum rngam can: chang glud 'bras chan 'di khyer la mi yi gral du ma rgyu zhig: phyug gi g.yang ra ma 'dzinazhig dbang thang bsod nams ma 'phrog cig: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: dri dang 'dams la gnas 'dzin zhing drod dang dbug la nye rgyu ba'i chung 'drenag po gyad poche drod pa'i zhwa la rgyu ma'i brgyan: lag na bu chung mgo phreng 'dren: rlung gi bang rtsal ldan pa yis: mi phyug srid rku chung 'dre byed: khyed cag 'den pa'i tshig la nyon: lan chags

sgo da ka yas glud 'di khyer la 'di ru ma rgyu rang sar dengs: thod pa lcags kyi grongs khyer nas: yi dwags 'phrogs ma zhes bya ba: grongs khyer kun tu thogs med nyul: bsod nam 'phrog pa'i dam sri mo: rgyu 'bras bslu med don la som: yas glud chang skyems 'di khyer la: mi yi sri la ma rku zhigs: phywa g.yang dpal la ma 'khri bar dpag tshad mang po'i pha mthar dengs: 'byung ba kun tu snyoms byed cing srid pa'i grong khyer gtan sprugs shig logs par 'dren pa'i gnod sbyin mo: sha khrag rus la rngam zas byed cir yang bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul can: bshad sgrub bstan la mkhon 'dzing slong: dam tshig sdoms pa 'gal rkyen gtong: nyes pa sna dgu gtong ba'i bdud: khyod kyang bden pa'i tshig la nyon: lan chags glud gtor 'di khyer la: dam chos byang chub ma sgrib cig sa dang lam la ma 'gong shig: mthong ba dman du ma 'phen zhig: gang ba phri ru ma gzhig cig skye med stong pa'i lam la zhugs: rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mthar dengs skad cig rgyu bar ma byed cig las kyi rnam smin rang khar spyod: ma rig nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i bdud

ra dza sgog bdud mi srin pa: rol du ba glang dmar po khrid gru gu byad yas sna tshogs bkal grongs khyer kun tu 'jab cing rgyu: skye 'gro'i tshe srog mdangs la za: log 'dren mi dmar stobs chen khyod: skad cig yud tsam 'dir 'dus la: sha khrag rgyal glud 'di dag khyer: mi phyug dkor la ma 'tshe bar: rang snang 'khrul ba'i gnas su dengs: phyin chad rgyu ba'i bskal ba med: grongs khyer stong pa dag tu rgyu: skyes pa gzhen nu'i gzugs la bza' bud med mdzes ma'i mdangs la chags: gzhon nu chung gi sri la rku: bsod nams nor gyi skal ba 'phrog: dmags tshogs 'khrugs rtsod mkhon pa slong: dam sri mi rigs gcer bu rgyu: kun 'khrigs ra dza 'gong g.yon po: thogs med stobs kyis 'dir 'dus shig: lan chags sku glud yas khyer la: kha 'gong dpal la ma btab cig: 'gong 'dre bse rag ma byed cig: g.yang bcud 'gong bar ma byed cig: snum bcud phyi la ma khyer zhig: 'dir 'dug rgyu ba'i skal ba med: dge bar nyon la bde bar dengs lam bstan ni kye: mas ste nam mkha' stong par rgyu: dma' rnams 'byung ba sa la rgyu: bar snang khams

thaX la dbang za ba'i: 'byung po bgegs tshogs che phra kun lan chags glud gtor byin zin pas: rang rang so so'i gnas su dengs: skad cig rgyu bar ma byedacig: sarba ru tra u tsa ta ya phaṭa: gzhung ltar bka' bsgo 'tshams gcod bya de nas khrus chab gsol ba ni /ཿ 'byung ba chen po bcom ldan 'das dag byed ma ga'i rang bzhin chu: bdud rtsi'akhyil bar byin rlabs pas: phug gi lha la khrus gsol lo: dam grib nyams grib phog pa sbyangs bar gyi g.yang la 'gong 'dre bse rag dri ma bkru: bza' mi yongs la khrus nal rtsog mkhon grib phog pa bkru: sbra dang khyims la khrus mnol rtsog dri ma thams cad sbyangs rta phyug lug la khrus bkrag mdangs dpal nyams rgud pa sbyangs: zas noradakor la khrus gdon bgegs 'khri ba'i nyes skyon sbyangs: khrus kyi mi dag gang yang med: chab kyi mi sbyangs mi srid pas: phyi khrus shel las gsal gyur cig nang khrus mchongalas dmar gyur tsag: gsang khrus gser la rab 'bar te: dri ma sgrib tshogs mo gnas par: skye med stong pa'i 'khor lo sangs: dpal yon nus mthu stobs rdzogs shing: gang

'dod phun sum tshogs gyur cig:37 a mṛta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭaXswā hā:g.yang nyams pa dang rmug pa dang ral pa dang rgud pa dang 'khyal ba thams cad sor chud par gyur cig:sarba shirnyiku ru ye swā hā:rat+na pusnye ku ru sbyo:g.yang bsang ni kya:lha sngags ting 'dzin bden mthu yis dbang bskur byin rlabs 'phrul chen po:ldon zhing sna tshogs dud pa'i sprin:phadagongs sngon rlabs 'khrigs char gyi bkrus:ma dogs mo sa yi dpal gyis bskyed bu ni shing sna rnams pa dgu:sor rtog ye shes rtsal gyis sbar bya ba lhun gyis grub pa'ibardal:'dod yon lnga yi 'od phung 'bar phyi nang gsang mchod bsam yas sprin:khams gsum lha yi bla mar 'bul thugs dam bskang ngo nyams chags bshags:dbang phyuga'adod pa'i rgyal po bsang:dgos 'dod longs spyod char ba phob btsun mo gnam sman chen mo bsang:bde stong dga' bzhi'i ye shes bskyed:'byung ba dus bzhi'i rgyal mobasang:srid pa gsum gyi phywa g.yang stsol:dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga lha klu mi yi dpal 'byor bskyil:'go zhing sdong grogs lha rnams bsang:lus ngag yid gsum srungs

zad ka skyobs mdzod: pha lha ma lha zhing lha kha 'dzin sdong grogs mel brtse'i skyongs zas lha grogs lha thabs lha bsang: dpal bcud g.yang gi mar khu bskyil dgra lha yul lha gzhi bdag gar song don 'grub bkra shis mdzod: phug lha phyug lha g.yang lha ra ba nor gyi gang bar mdzod: phrag lha lus lha mgon skyabs btsan phyug 'phan dar mdzom par mdzod: dgyes bskangs bsang mchod phul ba'i mthus dgra dpung cham la phab pa dang: bgegs tshogs ming gi lhag mar bsgyur: kha yi zas 'dod zas dang sprod lag gi nor 'dod g.yang dang sbyor: snying gi chos 'dod chos dang sprod: ci bsam don rnams 'grub par mdzod: cha'o bkra shis lha rgyal lo: mda' rab ni kyi: bkra shis lha mda' ring mo 'di: 'khrung ni 'byung ba sa la 'brung: bskyed ni 'byung ba'i yab kyis bskyed: g.yu 'od 'bar la gser 'od 'thul: lha mi mthun par sbyor ba'i rdzas dar tshon snalngas 'phan yab btags : 'od gsal sgron me me long btags: g.yang rten bal dang 'phyong la brten: tshe rten mda' dang gser la brten: bla rten g.yu dang shwa la brten

'phrul gyi mda' sgro gsum dang ldan:pha lha ma lha zhing lha brten:tshig pa bcu gsum dpal dang ldan:g.yang rab bcu gsum mthu stobs 'dzoms:mda' ltong dpa' bo thibasakyi chas:dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod:mde'u gnam lcags ngar dang ldan dgra 'dre gdon gyi gnya' ba gnon:khrab kyi byang bu mig mang bkod:srung skyobs tshedapal 'dzoms dang ldan:dkyil 'khor dbus su bkod pa na:rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dgyes bskang rdzas:phrag pa'i gong du khul ba na dbang phyug lha tshogs gnad nas bskul phyogs mtshams kun du bskor zhing dbab mi yi tshe g.yang 'phel bar byed:phyug gi 'phel g.yang rgyas par byed:zas kyi bcu g.yang bskyil zhing dril:phywa yi thag pa sra bar byed g.yang gi mar khu gang bar byed:dpal gyi mdzod khang mer bar byed:'bru yi bang ba gang bar byed:btsan phyug 'phan dar rgyas par byed:de 'dre'i mda' dar ya mtshan can sngags pas bskor zhing phywa g.yang bskul:zhal nas bkra shis bden tshig brjod:smon lam sbyin bdag rnams la 'dus:lha mi yon mchod dar zhing rgyas:bkra shis

ches dpal 'bar lha rgyal lo: phyu dang g.yang gi dngos grub stsol: phye mar ni bso bso bso: de rang bkra shis skyid pa'i nyin: lha yi zhun chen ri ltar spungs: glu yi gar byed gangs ltar chags gnyan gyi mar gdar 'ja' ltar 'khyugs: dregs pa'i dpal bcud zho ltar chags: mi yi 'bru bcud rdza ltar bsnyil: lha lug dkar mo g.yas nas 'khyug: srid pa'i ba dkar g.yon nas rtse: gtsug rjes bya rgyal rtse nas lding: 'phrul gyi rus sbal lto bas brten: de 'dre'i phye mar ya mtshan can: dbang phyug dgyes pa'i rdzas su bkod: thugs dam bskang ba'i byin gyis rlabs mi g.yang rab tu 'phel du gsol: tshe g.yang rab tu 'phel du gsol nor g.yang rab tu 'phel phyug g.yang zas g.yang btsan phyug 'phan dar phun tshogs mdzod: khu ye phywa dang g.yang khu ye g.yang 'ayigasani hrī:dzaḥ lhar bcas skye rgu yongs kyi ngo bo stong: 'jig rten snang sems mched bsdud stong pa'i sgog lugs 'byung kun snang bkod pa'i kun gzhi che 'dod rgyal lha yi bla ma gnad nas bskul: khams sum lha yi phywa g.yang mer gyis bsdus yum gcig u ma

gnam sman chen mo yis srog 'dzin nam mkha'i dpal kun phywa g.yang stsol: srid pa shar gnas dpyid kyi rgyal mo yis: brjid cing lhun 'thug sa bcud phywa g.yang stsol: srid palho gnas dbyar gyi rgyal mo yis rtsi bcud dpal 'bar me yi phywa srid pa nub gnas ston gyi rgyal po yis: 'byu bcud dal 'phel chu gter phywa srid pa byang gnas dgun gyirgyal mo yis: yangs shing g.yo ba rlung gi phywa srid pa lha chen rnam pa brgyad sogs kyi: lha yi phywa g.yang lho sprin ltar du spungs: dga' bo la sogs klu chen rnam brgyad kyis: klu yiphywa g.yang rgya mtsho bzhin tu bskyil mig dmar phur bu la sogs gza' brgyad kyi: bar snang dregs pa'i dpal g.yang 'ja' ltar bsdus: ra gdongs la sogs phyogs skyongasachen po bcu'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og phywa g.yang bsdus: 'jigs byed me 'khor la sogs rnams pa dgu'i: btsan phyug 'phan dar che grags stobs g.yang bsdus smin drug la sogs rgyu skar nyer brgyad kyis: phun tshogs phywa g.yang dngos po thams cad bsdus: zil gnon rgyal po chen po sde bzhi yis: dri za dril bum klu dbang gnod sbyin

za da ka bskul: kun gyi phywa g.yang ma lus 'dir khug cig bran dang lha srin bsam mtha' yas pa yis bkra shis chos g.yang 'chi med tshe yis g.yang: btsan phyug 'phan dar rigs rgyud bu yi g.yang: 'tsho ba zas dang dpal 'byor nor gyi g.yang: ma lus 'dir 'dus 'phel zhing rgyas gyur te: 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal bsod nams mthu 'dzoms shog: grangs mang bsogs g.yang blan ni na moX sra brtan skal ba rlung gis ma zhig par: bsod nams lhun po 'gyur med gzhi 'dzug blan g.yang gi mtsho mo mi rab bcu gsum la sra brtan 'gyur ba med pa'i phywa g.yang blan: tshe sgrub mthar phyin bdun cu rtse mthong bar: gza' mi mthun grogs 'chi med tshe g.yang blan: gang bsam 'dod don thogs med myur 'grub regag: dpag bsam shing 'bras lta bu'i phywa g.yang blan: dgra dpung cham la phab pa'i nus mthu stobs: gnam lcags thog las mthu che phywa g.yang bkra shis rigs rgyud nub pa med pa'i phyir: srid mtsho ring mo'i chu rgyun phya g.yang phywa khug g.yang khug bde legs skyid ldan mdzod: ma hā de ba ba su shra wa.u ma gha gha rat+na puṣ+ṭi dza

nya riḥniḥs sri'u ku tu hūṃ: de wa sa ma a driXtre:a ma ya nig nal nig nal snying ril ril tsher ma ra bsdus bsdus skyes pa pho mo'i snying lag 'gul 'gul sems yid dkyugs dkrugs: srid gsum ka cha nga la shog: hūṃ 'dus 'dus dza a ra ya dza hūṃ baṃ ho: brgya rtsa brjod rten bzhugs niḥ spyoḥ rin chen gter gyi bum bzang bkra shis mnga': dge legs dpal phyug g.yang rdzas rin chen la: phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub ma lus pa: ma 'khyams ma ral sib sib rug rug bstims rten snying lan bdun brjod sā sti sidhi maṅga le hūṃ rat+na gu ru puṣ+ṭi stam: bsngo smon na na mo bsod nams gter chen 'di bzhengs dge ba yis: mkha' khyab 'gro ba bde skyid chos kyi 'tsho dbul 'phong rgud sel 'khor bsgyur mnga' thang 'byor: srid gnyis dam pa chos kyi mdzes gyur cig: bshad sgrub dge mtshan nyams len mthar son te: dngos grub lo bcud 'bras bu 'dzoms gyur cig: lan gsum shes brjod ni na mo byin rlabs 'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyis gter dpal 'byor bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shog dngos grub char 'bebs bde legs kun gyi dbyig yi

za da ka dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bde stong dga' bzhi'i phrin las stobs rdzogs pa:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i las bzhi lhun grub bdud bgegs tshar gcod pa:bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i bsod nams zas nor longs spyod kun gyi mdzod:nor lha gter bdag rnams kyis bkra shis shog:nyin mtshan bar dang rtag par dge ba ni:dam pa chos kyi 'tsho ba'i bkra shis shog:mthar g.yang gtad pa la smon lam ni oṃ dkon mchog rin chenagasum la phyag 'tshal lo:bden tshig smon lam thams cad 'grub gyur cig phywa g.yang gtsug g.yang dmu g.yang ma lus pa:yon bdag skyid ldan 'di la 'byor gyur cig:bkra shis bden tshig kha g.yang brjod pa ltar sbyin bdag bsod nams can la 'byor gyur cig:bkra shis chos g.yang bsod nams mar khu'i g.yang yon bdag lag pa'i mthil du 'khyil gyur cig:dge mtshan dpal khur bal khyung lugs gsum gyi:g.yang gi sna drongs sbyin bdag dpal 'dzoms la:lha mi g.yang 'bod 'dzoms pa'i kha 'dzin dang sdong grogs rgyab brten ma g.yel stobs ma chung:thams ba da dus la

bab po sa ma yu lan bdun brjod la g.yang rdzas mdun du drangs tshe mda' gtan la tsho : tshe dpag med mgon rgyal ba'i thugs rjes zung:rgyal ba rigs lnga'i thabs kyi tshe g.yang bskyed:dbyings phyug yum lnga'i shes rab tshe 'phel mdzod:sems dpa' sems ma'i lcam sring tshe dpal spel mthar byed pho mo'i bran dang tshe dbang bskyed dbang phyug chen po'i mi yi tshe mda' zung:u ma de wa'i sa yi bang mdzod bskyil:dus bzhi'i lha mo'i g.yang gi ra ba srung dpal mgon bdun cu'i btsan phyug 'phan dar mdzod:tshe mda' 'di brten 'chi med lo brgya thob khyims gang skyid dang ldan pa'i bkra shis re ga:phye mar gtad cing 'o skyems drangs zlargyas zla phrum rol du 'am snang ba'i mar me mdun du bkod la 'di skad do hrī:dza ting 'dzin dbang phyug lha yi rjes:'dod pa'i ro la zur mig g.yo:khams gsum dbang phyug chen po yis:lha yi phywa g.yang 'dir bsdus la skal ldan rnams la sib kyis bskyil:klu yi phywa g.yang 'dir bsdus la:sgrub pa po la mer gyis dril:dregs pa'i phywa g.yang sprin ltar gtibs:yon gyi bdag por phun tshogs 'byor:bde skyid skal ba dang ldan zhing bsod

za da / nams dpal gyi gzhi tshug cig: ma hā rat+na ku ru sirnyi pusnye hūṃ g.yang bshos gtad la spyo: rat+na lnga yi gzhong pa ru: 'bru bcud phun tshogs dpal bshos gshams: nyi zla gza' skar tshul kyis bskor: 'dod yon lnga yi 'od zer 'bar dbang phyug gtso 'khor bran 'bang rdzogs: phywa dang g.yang gi char rgyun 'bebs: sbyin bdag pho mo rnams la sbyin: bsod nam dpal yon las la 'khyil: skyid kyi dge mtshan spyi bor 'khrungs: bsam pa'i don kun legs mthar 'grub: khu ye khu ldan g.yang 'phel lo: dgematshan phun sum tshogs gyur cig: rat+na a ka ra pha la na mo sirnyi hūṃ: g.yang rgye gtad la bla dge legs phun tshogs gyur cig: rin chen re'u le'i skyal ba 'di: nor bu rin chen rigs kyi bskyil: stag sgro dar zab gos kyi brgyangs: dred sgo 'bru sna lnga yi phyur g.yang rgye bsod nams dpal gyi gtams: phun tshogs bsod nams nor skal 'di: yon gyi bdag po khyod la gtad: tshe bsod dpal yon g.yang 'phel te: gang bsam 'dod don lhun grub shog: rat+na ma hā gu ru a zlo:tri puṣ+ṭi sirnyi pha la hūṃ: rdzas brgyad gtad la hrī: khyed

cag nad med gegs zhi tshe 'phel zhing: dbang sdud gzugs legs bkra shis dpal kun sbyor: bsam don 'grub phyir bkra shis rdzas mchog brgyad: legs par gtad pa'ibasod nams stobs 'dzoms shog: rat+na maṅga lam a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐ rtag brgyad gto la hūṃ hrī: chos kyi 'khor lo skyobs pa'i gser gdugs dang: grags snyan dung dkar skyon bralagaser nya zung: ljags bde pad+ma gsung snyan mgul bum pa: bde ba'i sku lus rgyal mtshan dad mos kyis dpal gyi be'u bkra shis rtags mchog brgyad rgyal ba'i mtshan dpes yon tan yin mod kyang: gnas skabs 'khor bsgyur bsod nams mchog 'dzoms phyir: yon bdag dpal phyug khyod la gtad par bgyi: maṅga lam gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī sna bdunagam la hū hrī: dad pa'i 'khor lo snying rje'i nor bu'i dpal: bsod nams khyims bdag bde stong btsun mo'i gzugs: tshogs chen rab rdzogs shing rta myur 'gros can thar lam 'dren byed glang po rdzu 'phrul can: phas rgol zil gnon dmag dpon rin chen rnams: don du 'phags pa'i nor bdun kho na yang: gnas skabs 'khor bskyar skal ba

62 phun tshogs phyir yon bdag bsod nams mthu 'dzoms khyod la sbyin: bsod nams lhun po ri rgyal ltar brtan shog: ma ma ṇi rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa tre: shesapa brjod cang me tog 'thor bden tshag grub pa' smon lam gdab de nas g.yang sgo bsdam pa na e: bden tshig dam pa 'grub gyur cig: mchog gsum rgyal ba'i byin gyis rlobs: sna tshogs 'phrul gyi bang mdzod 'di: lcags kyi gzi mig sgrom du chug: rin chen lde'u mig lag tu gtad: khro rgyal lcags kyi mdung ring can: phyi sgo srung ba'i pho nyar bzhag: rin chen sgrom dang sba lcags 'dzin: nang sgo bsdam pa'i gnyer du bcol: phyi mi nang du mi gtong zhing: nang mi phyi la ma dor srung: srid kyi glang chen rgyu ma byed: rus sbal ma na pa ma g.yo srung: gzhan gyi ston 'bod byas na yang: g.yang gi snum bcud phyir ma shor: bu sring phar la bskyal na yang: g.yang gi mtsho mo ma ral zhig: mna' ma tshur la blang na yang: g.yang mdzod srin bu'i ma za zhig dpal bcud bsod nams mer mer bskyil: phun tshogs bkra shis gang yin pas: g.yang sgo bsdam la shes pa stsol: rat+na maṅga lam sirnyi puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye swā hā: zhag

bdun bar du rgyu 'grul bsdam rgasabaskang mja pa rgya cho bya de nasagayang sgo phye ba ni tshe: ting 'jin dbang phyug thugasadam bskul: sbyin bdag mnga' thang dpal 'byor la nyin rdzi mtshan gyi melartse'i skyong: phywa g.yang sgron me rab 'bar te: dkar po lug dang khra bo rta: nag po gnags kyi klasakhyon bkang: phyugs gcig brgya 'phel g.yang sgo phyes: dkar po khri 'phel g.yang sgophyes: nag po stong 'phel g.yang sgo phyes khra bo brgya 'phel mi phyug bsod nams dpal yon kun: gong nasagong 'phel bkra shisashog: bde legs phun sum tshogs gyur cig su /rdomaṅga lam rat+na a yu puṣ+ṭi ku ru spa ra ṇa sa: byin rlabasaskal ba 'dzom pa yis g.yang sgo phye ba'i phun tshogasa'abyor sam yu 'di ltar g.yang bsgrub byed pa'i mi btsan phyug 'phan dar tshesagrang theb chosadang 'dzagarten dpal gyisophyug mnga' thang nasamakha'i mtha' mnyam mo sam mā rgya rgya rgya gurgya bdo thim dzi zhesapa'ang la dbang bsod namasakyi 'phro 'dzomasapa mthar phyin na bkra shi lha regagaser mdog rin chen rnamasaganyisakyi metog 4saste bskul ba dang slob bu paṇa grol na kyang nan bskur ngor kho bo nu ldan 'du pa rtsal gyisachosago nam mkha'i mdzod la bsgyur ba'i yige pa ni midri ming gisabagyi pa dge'o dge'o/ dge'o/ sarba maṅga la

62 chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las: dbang phyug 'dod rgyal dmar po'i bla rdo sgog 'khor bri thabs bzhugs:—1 na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye: rwatshog shāmitha dbang shog bzang drug sbyar ba'i ngor: mthing dang rin chen lnga bsres pas: mu khyud rim pa bdun du bskor:lte bar 'dod rgyal yab yum bri: thugs srog a dang e:yig bkod: mu khyud gnyis par 'di ltar bkod: 'bod sngags: dbu can tshag med gsal ba bkod: mu khyud gsum par 'di ltar bkod: tshe ma hā sogs/ de wa sarba rat+na sogs hūṃḥ mu khyud bzhi par 'di ltar bkod: rgo ma hā de wa sogs sarba rat+na sogs bsdus bsdus nig nal nig nal 'gro ba bu pho bu mo'i snying rtsa bgul bgul sgog rtsa dkrugs dkrugs yid sems slong slong snang ba dbang du bsdus bsdus rat+na sidhi pha la khug skyol: mu khyud lnga par rtsa sngags mthar: nad gdon 'jigs tshogs mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad shirnye ku ru ye swā hā: tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes yon tan dbang thang rlung rta snyan grags thams

swā hā: khams gsum srid gsum zas nor longs spyod 'dod dgu'i phywa g.yang thams cad pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā gnod byed dug lnga dug gsum las byung ba'i log bgegs 'byung po thams cad ma ra ya phaṭa:swā hā mu khyud drug par dbyangs gsal dang rten 'brel snying po bkod pa'i mthar: khams gsum dbang phyug chen lha yi bla ma phywa g.yang gter gyi bdag po gtso 'khor sprul pa bran g.yog dang bcas pa rnams kyis sku gnas par gyur cig: gsung brten par gyur cig: thugs cig: yon tan grub par gyur cig: phrin las 'byor bar gyur cig mnga' thang rgyas pa gyur cig: grags snyan 'phel bar gyur cig: ma su ste sidhi maṅga le:mu khyud bdun par pa tra bkod: pad+ma'i lcags zhags sgrogs dril bya: rdzas ni tsan+ta dkar dmar dang: g.yang rdzas nyer lnga tshad ldan dang: btsan po'i thabs sa bu bdun ma yis gos rgyan dang: glang chen mche ba rma bya'i sgro: 'brug rus li khri mnyams sbyar byug: sna lnga'i rgya ching legs par gdab thabs shes dar gyis na

thaX bza' gsolaḥ da la'i dbus bkod nyer spyod bkram: dang po rab gnas bya ba ni: rten de las 'od zer dbang gi mdog can lcags kyu lta bu spros te khams gsum lha yi gnas nas dbang phyug gtso 'khor sprul pa bran g.yog dang bcas pa nor longs spyod mnga' thang stobs 'byor thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par sib sib rug rug 'dus te sgrub rdzas bla rdo sgog 'khor la thim pas gnyis med ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam la: ma ma hā de wa sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra aṅku sha dza: sarba rat+na ba su na na kha dhe a rtsi tri a ga ya dza hūṃ baṃ ho: oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig brjod: ho dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal po gnam sman u ma de wa 'byung ba dus bzhi'i rgyal mo 'dod 'byung 'dzam lha mched drug bka' sdod dpal 'byor bdun cu sprul 'khor bran g.yog dang bcas pa thams cad rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs su gsol: bzhugs nas kyang bdag sgrub pa po la zas nor longs spyod 'dod dgu'i phywa g.yang gi char chen po 'bebs pa dang: sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin nas sgrub 'bras mngon du gyur de chos mthun gyi

mdzad phrin ma lus pa 'phel zhing dar la rab tu rgyas par gyur cig: tinyi badz+ra: lan gsum gdab la shes pa brjod: rab tu gnas shing sgrub rten 'dzug: mthar ni dngos grub tshul du len: zangs kyi ga'u'i nang du gzhugs lus la 'bral med bcing bar bya: srung ma'i snying nye phrin las myur: 'di la yon tan byin rlabs che: bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya brda thim:thi: ces pa'ang las smon 'phro 'dzoms mthar phyin nas rin chen g.yu phyur bkra shis dge ba'i skyes bcas bskul ba dang: nye gnas mun sel nas kyang thabs shes 'brel ba'i gos dar gyi skyes bcas bskur ngor: 7kho bo bdud 'dul nus ldan rdo rjes dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zin me tri'i mtshan can gyis babye)sa pa dge (pegs 'phe05: sarba maṅga chos/

thas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i snying thig las lha chen rgyas mdzad ser po gser gyi bum bzang can gyi nor sgrub bsdus pa bzhugs sgo da namogu ru pad+ma ka ra ye 545je796 snyo gter bum g.yang rgye gang rung ba lnga tha lnga yis byur bu bkang: sku gzugs snying po zu 'jug bya de nas bskyed chog bya ba ni hūḥ rang nyid yi dam lha ru gsal ba'i mdun: chos bzang lha yi bkod rdzogs yid 'phrog dbus: zla gam dbang gi gzhal med khang mdzes nang: pad+ma dang ni zla byed gdan gyi steng: hṝ yig gser mdog brtan g.yo dpal 'byor tshe: yongs gyur dbang phyug ma hā dhe wa ni rgyas mdzad gser mdog zhi ma khro 'dzum sgegs: gzugs thung brjed chags nor bu'i do shalamadzes gcer bu 'dod ster liṅga rab tu bsgrings: ljang sngon ral ba pad+ma'i thor cog bcing: zla phyed dang ni 'od 'bar nor bus brgyan: zar bu rgyab 'khrul rting pa'i rtsa ru sleb phyag g.yas dbang sdud pad+ma'i lcags kyu 'dzin: g.yon pa'i 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs gter bum bsnams rta bdun dbang po lte ba'i rgyan du 'chang: zhabs gnyis gyad thabs

bsgrad cing gzi 'od 'bar: g.yon du u ma dhe wa mdzes sgegs sku chags pas rgyan spangs dmar ser 'dzum zhal can: pad phreng dang ni yid bzhin nor bu 'dzin ral pa gnag snum rgya g.yu mu tig brgyan pad+ma'i thod gdengs gser gyi me tog bcing: zar bus sku rgyab kheb cing rin chen brgyan: bzhengs stabs yab la reg cing blta na sdug 'gro ba'i dpal du bde stong nyams dgar spyod: phyi rim 'byung ba dus bzhi'i rgyal mo ni: gser mdog pad+ma dkar ser dmar ljang dang: lcags zhags sgrog dril nor sdud phyag rgya 'chang: pad phreng rin chen do shal mdzes par brgyan yid 'phrog blta na sdug pa'i lang tsho can: mthong bas re skong nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor: dam tshig sgog gis bskul te khams gsum nas: dbang phyug gter bdag 'khor bcas spyan drangs bstims lha 'dre mi gsum snang ba dbang bsgyur nas: 'dod rgu'i char rgyun rtags tu 'bebs par dmigs: skyes ma hā dhe wa ma ki shā ra ni dhi pā la ba su dhe wa sarba a:hṝXtriḥpa shaṃ ku ru rgyu ting 'dzin dgongs pas gcun zhang bzlas skabs su dkar mngar 'bru sman skyems sbyangs bsgyur spel nas bskang

thaX gsol ni hrī:dza: khamasagasum lha yi dbang phyug nor lha'i rje: dga' bde'i zil 'khrigs dam tshig byin drod can: ma hā dhe wa 'dir byon rten la bzhugs brtan g.yo'i dpal 'byor zas nor rgya mtsho yis: gso' lo mchod do bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstod: srid zhi'i dge mtshan phywa g.yang char ltar phob rnal 'byor yid la re ba'i smon 'bras stsol: chos mthun bsam pa 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: grang bsogs phrin las rab 'byams 'grub de nasagayang 'bod bya ba ni bache : ltang 'jin dbang phyug gsal byed 'odalus can dga' dang bde bas srid zhi'i sa lam ston: legs yon 'byung gnas gter gyi bum bzang can: 'bod do g.yang bshos nor bu'i dga' ston 'bul: sgrub pa po lalha 'dre mi gsum gyi: zas nor longs spyod grags snyan phywa g.yang stsol mi nub rtag par 'phel rgyas bkra shis regag: yin mā sti sirnyi maṅga lam: ci rigs brjod la mda' dar g.yab denas rten bzhugs bya ba ni ma: rnal 'byor yid mtshor 'khrungs shing ting 'dzin sgrom: bsam 'phel dbang rgyal lta bu'i gter mdzod 'dir: zag med bde ster lha yi bla ma bzhugs

sgrub pa po la thugs mthun dngos grub stsol: ma badz+ra sa ma ya t+t+waṃ: sngags kyi mgo cing bstod pa ni hūṃ nyi snying rje'i gter mdzod bla ma sbyan ras gzigs: khams gsum dbang 'byor ma hā dhe wa'i gar: 'gro ba'i dbul sel gser mdog gter bum can: nor lha'i sprin phung 'khrigs la phyag 'tshal bstod de nasasmon lam gdab pa ni na moḥ skye ba tshe rabs gar brgyud gtan grogs su: ting 'dzin dbang phyug khyod nyid 'grogs pa dang: sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bshad sgom nyi 'od kyis gdul bya'i mun pa bsal nus mthu ldan shog: de nasobakrashisabarjod pa ni ho bsod namasachen po'inam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyams: dngos grub rgyal mtsho'i gter mdzod phyag na 'chang bde chen ye shes kun la snyoms par 'byed: yid bachin dbang gi bdag po'i shis pa 365: gzhan yang shi brjod rgya cher bya thabasade phyi nang g.yang 'khyil zhing yul der bkra shisaphun tshogasa'agyur bka' 'di snying las gcesapa'i phyir dpal mgon tshogasal gnyer bcol bas dam nyamasalag tu ma shor cig snyang gi bu dang 'phrad pa ra shog sa ma wāḥ rgya rgya rgya snyi cesapa 'di'ang skye ba du mar 'brel ba' chosakyi bdag po rig pa' bskul ngor kho bo sprang ban had pos brisapa maṅga lam

tha chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las:dbang phyug 'dod rgyal dmar po'i nor sgrub gter gyi bum bzang bzhugs so:cad na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye 51ze shākaskosarten rin chen bum pa bzang drug dang rin chen 'bru sman dri dar lnga btsan po 'a thabs sa phyugs klas sa 'bri brgya'i mar dang ya rab rgyan bu bdunam yi gos dum sogs bkra shis dge ba'i g.yang rdzas gtam thabs shes dar gyi kha dgab bcang sna lnga'i thag pas rgya chings gdab 'gyur med phyag rgya tham bcas bkod phyi nang gsang ba'i yo byad bkrams mchod dzos nor sna'adod yon bsang rmangs sri bkar zhing 'gong 'dre mnan bsang khrus sngon du btang ba'i rjes nor sgrub bya ba 'di lta ste (ཿrang snang yid sprul dga' ldan lha yi gnas:khams gsum grong khyer brtan g.yos gus bshud pa'i:rin chen lnga ldan 'od 'bar gzhal med khang zla gam dbang gi gzi byin 'byugs pa'i dal:'dod rgu'i char pa rtag tu 'beb pa'i dbus:'gong 'dre bse rag zil gnon pad zla'i khar aḥdamar 'od kyis 'khor 'das dpal yon bstims:yongs gyur dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal po ni:dmar gsal zhi ma khro 'dzum lang
