tshos 'byud: phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu dbang rgyal dang: dgos 'dod dpal yon nub med sgrub por stsol g.yon pas 'ching byed rlung gis zhags pa bsdam: lha 'dre mi gsum mos bzhi dbang du byed: mchan khung g.yon du gter gyi bum pa 'chang phywa 'bebs g.yang sdud nor sna gter du spel: bde stong nyams 'bar gsang ba'i rdo rje bsgreng ma hā a nu'i drod spel rtogs pa spar ljang sngon ral pa thod bcing nor bu'i brgyan: sgrub pa po la snying nye phrin las myur: brtse ba'i zur mig gdul bya'i yul la brtse: skyes pa bu pho bu mo dbang du byed ste bar nyi ma'i zer 'khrigs rmongs mun sel: gcer bu rat+na nor bu'i do shal 'phyangs: bsam don 'bad med yid bzhin 'byung bar byed zhabs gnyis gyad kyis rmangs sri rgab 'dre gnon: dbul sri stong 'dre yul med dben par byed: g.yon dus:las dgyes bskyed gnam sman ma: dmar ser zhi 'dzum chags 'bar bde stong rgyas: phyags g.yas gri gug yab btud thabs shes bsre: g.yon pa nor bu'i gzhong pas dbul phongs sel: ljang sngon ral pa thod bcing pad+ma'i brgyan: gcer bu rat+na'i rgyan

sgo da ka 'phyangs nus pad rgyas: zhabs gnyis gyad kyis yab la reg cing btud: bka' 'khor bde stobs dus bzhi'i rgyal mo yis: 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur dpal yon dwangs bcud spel: 'dzam lha rigs bzhi nor bdag mched brgyad kyis: 'khor 'das srid pa'i dpal yon dbang du byed: thugs srog las spros 'od zer lcags kyu yis:rang bzhin gnas nas rang 'dra sbyan drangs bstims: snyan gsan dbabs pa ni ho dgong su gsol lo: gsan du gsol lo: sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang pos ma 'ong sangs rgyas thar pa'i dbang por lung bstan pa: de 'og pad+ma rgyal po'i nang rgyud yo ga gsum gyi gnyer gtad pa gzhan yang rig 'dzin kun gyi sgog shing rnal 'byor yong kyi grogs po: dam tshig bka'i gnyer 'dzin: zhing bcu'i srog gi gshed ma: 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug: gzugs khams ting 'dzin dbang po: gzugs med snyoms 'jug rgyal po: lha chen 'dod rgyal dmar po yab yum sprul 'khor bcas pa dad pas 'bod do dam tshig gis brten no rtse gcig tu sgrub po: rtag tu mchod cing bskangs lags pas:

da lta nyid du bzhengs shig: gshegs shig: byon cig: badz+ra sa ma yā dza dza: mda' dar dmar po g.yab byin 'bebs pa'i dzos bdug snyan pa'i glu las drangs te spyan 'dren pa ni kyi: kun khyab nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas ting 'dzin snyoms 'jugs dbang po gshegs su gsol: gsal snang 'phrul bsgyur rol pa chen po las 'od lus 'gags med dbang phyug gshegs su gsol: bde dang sdug bsngal gar gyi rnam 'gyur ngoms: lha dbang lha yi bla ma 'dod pa'i ro la rol pa'i dga' gdung can: dbang sdud pad+ma'i lcags kyu dga' bde g.yo bas snyoms 'jug srid zhi'i gter: 'dod rgyal rlung zhags dmar po rig dang ma rig shan 'byed dam 'dzin ma: 'byung ba dus bzhi'i rgyal mo zas nor longs spyod 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pa: 'dzam lha nor skyongs gter bdag bsod nams tshe chos nor gyi dngos grub stsol: phywa g.yang mer chil bskyil bar mdzad du gsol o ma hā de wa a dṛX tre+e:a ga ya rat+na ba su na na kha dhe sirnyi bsdus bsdus puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye swā hā: brgya rtsa brjod bzhugs gsol ni trī: gdengs ga'i gtsug bkur rat+na'i dbang rgyal lhar

zos bsod nams char 'bebs gter gyi bum bzang por: snying gi grogs mchog lha dbang 'dod pa'i rgyal brtan par bzhugs la byang chub sgrub grogs mdzod sa ma yā stum: sa ma yā tiṣ+ṭha lhan: rten snying brjod phyag 'tshal ba ni na re dga' dang bde ba'i zur mig sgrub la g.yo: chags pa'i tshul gyis a nu'i bstan pa spel phun tshogs 'byung ba'i gzhi gcig 'dod pa'i rgyal: grogs kyi grogs mchog khyod la rtse phyag 'tshal: na mo sa ma yā ho mgo lakrul ni hūṃ trī: dbang yul rtog pa'i mtshan ma rang grol zhing bde ba mchog myur dga' bzhi'i mngon gyur phyir: nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga mchod 'bul 'khor los bsgyur rgyal bsod nams dpal 'dzom slad: bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid nor sna 'bul: ma rig mun sangs bde legs dpal 'byor phyir bdud rtsi bsang gi dga' ston spel zhing stobs: zas la bcud 'phel khyim la dpal 'dzom gad: dkar gsum mngar gsum phye mar zas sna 'bul: snan grags phun tshogs phyogs las rnam rgyal phyir rol mo'i rigs grur go khrab mtshon cha 'bul: chags pa dbang

sdud pad+ma rak+ta dang: dam tshig gcig bsres bdud rtsi a dṛ ta: phrin las myur bskur rgyun brten bā yi ta: thugs mthun mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang: phywa dang g.yangagi dngos grub bdag la stsol: ma/ ma hā pu dza sa ma yā ho: bstod pa ni hū hrī: snying rje zhi la mi gnas spyan ras gzigs: rnam rol srid las rab rgyal dbang phyug che zung 'juga'akhor 'das byed po mnyam pa'i dbyings lha yi bla ma khyod la bdag bstod do thabs chen chags pa'i rdo rje 'dod pa'i rgyal shes rab stong dbyings gnam sman chen po'imakhar: zung 'jug dga' bzhi'i ro la rol mdzad pa'i: lha chen snyoms 'jug dbang po khyod la bstod: dgyes pa'i 'dzum g.yo zas nor phywa g.yang 'bebs: brtse ba'i nyamasangoms bde stong rtogs pa bskyed dga' ba'i zhal ston sa lam grogs byed pa'i: dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod thabs kyi cha 'dzin dzam lha nor bdag 'byed shes rab rang bzhin dus bzhi'i mkha' 'gro 'dud: zung 'jug rtsal snang pho nya glogs ltar 'khyag: kun gyi byed po dbang phyug nyid la bstod: de ltar bsnyen sgrub bstod gsol

sgo da 1 byas pa'i mthus mi mthun 'gal rkyen rgud tshogs zhi ba dang legs yon phun tshogs dngos po rab rgyas shing lha 'dre mi gsum dregs tshogs dbang sdud la 'phral snang bdud 'gegs dgra sde mang meda'agyur don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung ba'i grogs byed par dngos nyams rmi lam zhal gzigs lung ston cing byang chub mchog gi sa la skyel ma mdzod phrin las ma g.yel dus bab sa ma yu 'dzab na bdag nyid pad+ma dbang chen du gsal ba'i thugs sgog dbang gi lcags kyu dmar po'i: lha chen 'dod rgyal yab yum sprul 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul: kun gyi gsang gnas 'od zeradamar po dza lcags kyu sbrel ba'i rnam par 'phros te: 'gro ba bu pho bu mo thams cad kyi gsang ba dang snying rtsa bskul te bran 'bangs su khol la gang 'dod kyi dngos po thams cad sgrub rdzas dang ro gcig tu spung zhing dngos grub kyi dbyig chen po thob par dmigs: sa ma hā de wa a pa ra tsit+ta dza: u ma ga ga na dhe wi trī: nya biniḥ4dzahūṃ baṃ ho: ār+ya dzam bhal ba su dhe wa sarba sa ma yā trīX dza: sarba a dṛ triḥ.a ba ya rat+na a yu pubye hṝ me pra dzña dzña na gu ṇa ba su na na kha dhe pha la sarba sirnyi bsdus bsdus puṣ+ṭi pa shing ku ru khug skyol: brgya stong

ca da1 la sogs gang skabs brjod de nas g.yang 'bod la sogs pa nor sgrub gter gyi bang mdzod ltar tshad du 'byel na dngos grub 'byung tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs rgyas gzhan snang bran du kholab dang bdag nyid dbang btsan nus mthu che dregs pa yongs kyi gtsug na rgyal chos dang 'jig rten dpal gyis phyugs grub 'bras dngos grub rgya mtsho thob byin rlabs yon tan bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun lag tu longs dngagasal dkon mod rgyal khab 'grim dang mthong skal ba can gya dpal du shog 'dod sred can la ma shor cig sam pā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi zhes pa 'di'ang las dbang bsod nams kyi 'phro 'dzom pa mthar phyin na bkra shisalhareg dang rin chen gsum pas me tog bcas te bskul ba dang snying nor pad+ma kun grol nas bkra shis lha regs bcas nas bskur ba dang slob bu klong yangs nas bkra shis lha reg dang gosadar gyi rkyes bcasanan tan chen po' bskularo ra nu ldan pasaspel ba maṅga lam

tha chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las dbang phyug 'dod rgyal dmar po'i sregs blugs dbang gi lcags kyu bzhugs so:cad ma hā dhe wa shā ya dbang phyug 'dod rgyal dmar po la phywa g.yang re 'dod bcol ba'i phyar dbang gi sreg blugs 'bul 'dod na sman sna 'bru sna dar sna tshogs me tog li khri ga wang sbyar dbang gi yam shing 'om bu dang 'byu brgya' mar brlan zas sna bsre zla gam dbang gi tha sa khung brtsags mda' dar 'bar me rlung g.yab sogs phun tshogs yid du 'ong bar bkod sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangs bsgyur spel war gsal ting 'dzan brtan po yis skyid pad+ma wa shaṃ ku ru hūṃ: badz+ra dz+wa la ram ram: zhes me sbyar hūṃ hūṃ sarba rat+na puṣ+ṭi ku ru spra ra ṇa khaṃ: zhes rlung g.yab mdun bskyed bsgom pa ni snyen ma hā shu byenya dzñā na badz+ra swā bha wa arma ko ྅ —: hrī: bdeba'i rang bzhin kun nas gzi 'bar ba'i: dbang gi 'od 'byugs zla gam dgu brtsegs klong: dga' gdung lha yi bu dang bu mo brtse stong khams srid pa'i phyu 'bebs g.yang 'bebs 'khyil: rin chen nor sna nye ba'i nor sna mdzoms: yid 'phrog blta na sdug pa'i pho brang dbus chags pa'i rdul bral rin chen

pad zla nyi: zhal sbyor dal dbusa.o:dmar zhu ba las 'khor 'das dpal 'dzin dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal: dmar gsal zhi ma khro 'dzum sogs nor sgrub ltar bya go me daradamar po gapab la spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag la' bcasagrub phral byon skyems 'bul ba ni hūṃ hrī:srid na ya mtshan che ba'i dbang phyug dpal: lha yi bla ma 'dod pa'i rgyal po la dgos 'dod re ba zhu ba'i yon tan tsam zag med bdud rtsi 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes chags gdung pad+ma ra ga'i zhal bzang ngom: 'bral med bde stong 'dod rgu'i dpal yon rtsol: rtsa sngagasamathar a mṛ ta khā hi nyer gcig gisa'abul lo gzhung gi mchod 'bul dang phyi nang gsang mchod sman rag gtor gsum sngags tshig gis 'bul bar bya'o sreg dzos 'bul ba ni skyonapas:hūṃ bdisnyedang dga' bzhi'i 'dzum nyams dpal brgya'i 'byud srid na ya mtshan mchog bsngags dper mi 'os: lha dbang 'dod rgyal yab yum sras 'khor la bdag la 'byor ba'i nor sna zas rgyan gyis: phud rnams bsdus la gus phyag bcas te 'bul: dgyes gdung dga' 'dzum zur mig g.yo bzhin rol dpal spungs nor 'phel phywa g.yang char ltar phob: e baṃ ma la

zas yā: bdag nyid pad+ma dbang chen gyi thugs srog las spros pa'i 'od zer dbang gi lcags kyu'i dbyibs can gyis: mdun bskyed lha chen 'dod rgyal yab yum dzam lha nor bdag gter srung rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul: kun gyi gsang ba nas 'od zer dmar po dza lcags kyu sbrel ma'i rnam pa can nyi ma'i zer ltar spros te 'gro ba bu pho bu mo thams cad kyi gsang ba dang snying rtsa nas bskul te bran 'bang su khol la gang 'dod zas nor longs spyod 'dod dgu'i dngos po thams cad bkug cing spungs la bdag nyid sgrub pa po'i dpal du stsol bar bsam la: snyen ma ha dhe wa a pa ra tsi tasngag ma ga ga dhe wi sa pā ri wa ra ma hā sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta pū dza khā hi: brgya stong la sogs ci rigs 'bul skabs rnams su sarba a dṛ tri:a na ya rat+na a yur pubye dza pra dzña dzña na gu ṇa ba su na na kha dhe pha la sarba sirnyi bsdus bsdus puṣ+ṭi pa shaṃ ku ru khug skyol: bar bar g.yang 'bod bya 'dod gsol gdab pa na sto lha chen ma hā dhe wa 'dod rgyal phywa g.yang gter gyi bdag po: u ma gnam sman 'khor 'das dbang bsgyur: 'byung ba'i dpal 'dzin dus bzhi'i rgyal mo: srid pa'i dpal nor

chos gter gyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pas: bdud rtsi sreg blug gi mchod pa rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs sems can la phan bde spel: mnga'athang dang nor sna bskyed: phywa 'bebs dang g.yang 'bebs mdzod: grags snyan gyi ru mtshon phyor: chos mthun gyi dge mtshan sbyor tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i dge mtshan dpal yon gyidangos po thams cad mi nub par dbang du 'du zhing rab tu 'phel ba'i phrin las mdzod cig: bstod pa bya bskang gsol rgyas par gtong gtang rag ga mchod pa gong ltar phul rjes rtsa sngags da sarba byu dza a dṛ ta khā hi: dzos 'du dang mar nyer gcag gshegs skyems su phul bstod pa bya dngos grub ni e: mi gasku mkha' ltar dag pa'i 17nga yangs nas: bde legs nub med 'char bgang ga'i rgyun: bskal bzang pad tshal smin pa bstan pa'i gsos: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: sirnyi pha la oṃ āḥhūṃ: bzod gsol ni ho snyeng gi lha grogs dbang phyug 'dod rgyal dgongs: ting 'dzin ma gsal mchod rdzas yod byad ral: nyon mongs dbang gyur chags bde rang mtshan gol: thams cad gnong 'gyod dang

thaX bcas bshags bgyi'o: yig brgya bzla bsngo smon ni ho: rnam dkar dge tshogs ma gyur 'gro la bsngo: rgyal bstan dar rgyas der 'dzin 'dus sde smin:gdul zhing tshogs smon las kyi 'brel rnams kun: zla gam e 1nga dbang chen gsung thob 31ga: lan gsum bsdu rims ni ho: 'bar ba'i dam chig mchog la snying nye ba dbang gi 'od du ltems zhu bdag nyid dang: sgrub pa'i rdzas la gnyis med ro gcig gyur: phrin las 'dod pa 'byung ba'i rten du shar: a ā: shis brjod ni na mo: dpe yi mi mtshon chos dbyings stong ba'i khyon: gar gyi mchog gyur brtan g.yos dge mtshan 'bar: gang la spyod pa'i dam tshig dag pa kun yongs su smin cing grol ba'i shis pa stsol: de ltar dbang gi sreg blugs 'di: phul bas rnal 'byor mnga' thang rgyas tshe bsod dpa la yon nyams rtogs 'phel grags snyan 'du 'tshogs phrin las phyugs tshe rang bkra shas ror gter 'byer yon tan bsam mi khyab pa ste bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal dkon mod rgyal khams 'grims dang mtho sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin dkon mchog blo grosanas bkra shis dge ba'i skyes bcas bskul ba dang nye gnas mun sel
dang chos gsal gnyis nas yang yang bskul ngor kho bo sbas pa'i rnal 'byor bdud 'dul nu ldan rdo rjesaspel ba dge legs 'phel sarba ma la

72 chos nyid nam mkha'i slong mdzod las dbang phyug 'dod palirgyal po bsgrub pa che 'gab 'dremanan thabs sra brtan rdo rje zhes bya ba bzhugs theg: ches na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye ra thesardechas dbang phyug 'dod rgyal bsgrub pa'i tshe 'gab 'dre bse rag 'khri srid pas dug shog la ni dug khrag gis liṅga dbang tshangs gnad yag bcas zhal shesaltar du bkod par bya gru gsum lcags kyi sgrom du gzhugs de nas e bskyed bden brdar ni mdun du yinahūṃ: yongs su gyur pa las: gru gsum lcags kyi khang sgrom nag po kha dog cing mthil yangs pa: dug lnga rang gshed du 'bebs pa'i nang du zlo tri:yongs su gyur pa las 'gab 'dre bse rag dam sri pho mo thams cad nyams thag dbugs dang bral la khad pa rkang lag lcags gzer gyis bsdam bzhin du gnas par bsam la na mo mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa ba gsum: bden gnyis baspu med nus mthu yis 'go 'dre bse rag dbul sri rnams liṅga 'di la myur du khug brgya'am nyer gcig brjod: tri0a ra ya badz+ra adru sha dza: rat+na pā sha hūṃ: pad+ma spo ṭa baṃ garma ghan+de ho pra we sha ya phaṭa a we sha ya a: nyes bsgrags

ni dza phung sri 'gab 'dre bse rag 'dis:dang po skye 'gro'i bde skyid bcom bar du phywa g.yang dpal la 'jab:tha ma god kha phung brlag gtang:dge ba'i bya ba khyad du bsad/mi dge'i las las rnam par mnan:nyams pa can gyi dgra bdud bgegs:nyes pa gtong ba'i dam sri rnams:liṅga 'di la gnas par mdzod:rnam smin bag chags sbyangs bdang:'khrul ba'i las rgyun gcod pa'i phyir:gru gsum gzhal yas khang du sdod:'bar ba'i me yi 'od la ltos:'dod chags khrag gi mtsho la reg:gti mug mun pa gos sugyon:phrag dog rlung gi gdan la 'khod:nga rgyal brag rir rgyab brten byos:las kyi rnam smin longs su spyod 'phar ldang mgul bskyod med pa gyis:sngags gzer ni sarba triḥdza:trig nan:tri tri ni nan:bdud tri ni nan:ka tri ni nan:'gong 'dre nan nan ching ching rbad:bse rag nan nan:dbu sri nan nan:the'u 'gong rgyal bsen 'gab 'drenan nan:grangs mang brjod gru gsum e yi sgrom lcags khang dbar ba'i nang du:mun pa nag po rlung thub kyi rgong ngas g.yog te bskal ba'i bar du 'bog cing brgyal la thar

thaX 'chor dang bral bar bsam la ྅: bla ma'i byin rlabs yi dam ting 'dzin dang ma dang mkha' 'gros bden tshig nus stobs kyis: sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i 'gong 'dre rnams bskal ba'i bar du 'phar ldang med par gyis: khyen le: a le: ( le: sā le: hā le s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: ma ra ya nan: 'phar ldang med par phyag rgya' btab de nas bsgrub pa ma chog la 'jug 'gong 'dre bse rag nye mi nus bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang las smon 'phro 'dzoms mthar phyin nas bkra shis lha reg rinachen gnyis pa' skyes bcas bskul ba dang nye gnas mun sel nas kyang bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'dul dpal gyi rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i 'phrul mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin me tri' mang gis bgyis pa dge sarba ma la

rngo zag chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las: 'dod rgyal dbang gi lcags kyu'i bsang gsol bdud rtsi'i sprin phung bzhugs so:byed na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye shākasnyo/rtog1118zu lha shing sna tshogs dud pa btang sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangs bsgyur spel lhar gsal ting 'dzin brtan po yiḥ rnga rol dbyangs bcas 'di skad gyer hrī dza: khams gsum grong khyer lha yi pho brang nas zhi bde mnyam rol srid zhi'i dbang phyug pa: 'dod pa'i rgyal po dga' bzhi'i dpal 'dzin mchog u ma lugs skyes dus bzhi'i drod 'dzin ma: dzam lha spun drug dpal mgon dam 'dzin tshogs: dung dung glu yis bskul lo da tshur byon grags snyan rol mo'i bstod dbyangs 'bul bzhin bskul: mkha' dbyings 'ja' gur padre'i tshal klong bzhugs: yid sprul rgyal srid bkra shis rdzas rtags rol: dam la dgongs bzhin brtse gdung nyams ldan par: rnal 'byor rig pa'i brgyan shar bsangs sprin la: lha klu mi yi dga' ston phun sum tshogs: spro dga' ting 'dzin nam mkha' mdzod kyis gter: mi grogs lha yi kha 'dzin mdzad phyir

'bul zhal bzang dung ltar dkar phyir gus pas 'bul: bsod nams gter gyi char rgyun dbab phyir 'bul srid na mtshungs bral ya mtshan 'dzom phyir 'bul: tshe chos bshad sgrub bde stong 'bar phyir 'bul: las dbab klung rta grags snyan rgyas phyir 'bul: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du phyir 'bul: mtha' bzhi'i dmags 'khrugs ru gzeng bzlog phyir 'bul nad dang mu ge rims yams zhi phyir 'bul: skye rgu bde skyid dpal 'byor 'dzom phyir 'bul: chos gra sbyin bdag chab srid dar phyir 'bul rang gzhan sgyu lus bde ba'i sbyangs phyir 'bul bstan pa'i chom po lag dmar 'joms phyir 'bul: pad+ma'i rang lugs nang rgyud rgyas phyir 'bul: zab gter gsang ba skor drug 'phel phyir 'bul: dgyes bde tshims pa'i zlos gar 'khyugs bzhin rol: phun tshogs bzhed don de dag sgrub po zhes: 'dzum pa'i zhal nas snyan pa'i sgra byung te: sgrub mchog yid tshims 'bod gsol don dang ldanaḥ yar phyed tshe 'di'i mdzad phrin mkha' dang mnyam: mar phyed phyi ma'i dgos 'dod bya ba 'grubaX 'ja' lus 'od sku grub pa'i bshul lam zin:

zas dbang chen gsung gi rgyal ba'i gdud 'tshob nas rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i gnyer mdzod cig:bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā:de ltaraphulaba'i phrin las 'grub don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung bar 'gyur sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang slob bu mthar phyin dang mun sel gnyis kyis dar bcas yang yang bskul ngor nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i bdo mdzod las bsgyur ba dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga le/

/rdo chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las:dbang phyug 'dod rgyal dmar po'i dgra bla bskang gsol yid 'dod char 'bebs bzhugs:zaX na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye: zaza11 dar phyar bsangs spro rol mo sbir snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad gyer hrīḥdza stong dbyings nam mkhar dbang gzhu'i zla gamaklong:re 'bras 'dod pa 'jo ba'i gter gcig pu:lha yi bla ma 'dod rgyal bskang gsol bstod bde stong dga' bzhi bskyed pa'i dgra bla mdzod:dbyings phyugs mi gnas rjesachags 'dzum pa'i gar:chags pa'i dpal la brtse ba brgyas 'khyud pa'i:u ma lugs skyes 'dzin ma bskang gsol bstod:yid chos las dben dga' spel dgra bla badzod tshad med rol gar phrin las phyag gis 'dzin:mtha' bzhi'i dmags bzlog 'byung ba'i drod 'dzin ma:bde sbyin dus bzhi'i rgyal mo bskang gsol bstod:'du ba rnam bzhi'iphyugs pa'i dgra bla mdzod: stong gzugs 'od kyis phyag rgyar mngon g.yos shing:khams gsum lha yi gtsug na yongs 'phags pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi mgon po bskang

gsol bstod sgo gsum dga' bde'i 'tsho ba'i dgra bla mdzod:steng 'og phyogs mtshams phrin las rgya mtshos phyugs:cir yang re 'bras thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i: phyogasabacu'i mgon po 'khor bcas bskang gsol bstod:g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dgra bla mdzod:sha za khrag 'thung mngon spyod las la dgyes:gar rbad sa ru mi ro gcalabakram byed:sde brgyad mgon po 'khor bcas bskang gsol bstod zhing bcu pham par byed pa'i dgra bla mdzod:thogs med las la myur ba'i bya ma rta:dbang drag glogs ltaramyur ba'i pho nya ba:lha dmags bye ba'i tshogs rnams bskang gsol bstod:rgyal bstan 'dzin spel nus pa'i dgra bla mdzod:zhing dang gtsug lags sgrub gnas kun nyul zhing legs nyes stong sgog 'dzin pa'i gnyer kha ba dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga bskang gsol bstod:don gnyis thogs med 'grub pa'i dgra bla mdzod:snying gi lha grogs chos skyongs khyed gsol na dgra bla mi dang ma bral kha 'dzin mdzod:lus dang grib ltar 'bral ba med bzhin du:srid na ya mtshan che ba'i bsngags pa sgrogs:thabs kyi cha la che

byed grags stobs rtsal bskyed shes rab rang bzhin zhi dul lang tshos 'khyud khyims la g.yang chags ra ba nor gyis gang: tshe chos bsod nams 'phel ba'i dgro rā mdzod kha g.yang bkra shis brjod pa'i dpe bzhin du: sa cha yul phyogs mnga' ri'i chab srid kun: lugs zungs dpal 'byor rgya mtshos 'tsho bzhin du: phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dgra bla mdzod: gzhi phyes lam gsum bya ba kun 'grub cing: tshong shag gtam las rnam par rgyal ba dang: mkhas btsun bzang gsum dge legs rgya mtsho yis: yongs su dge zhing 'tsho ba'i bkra shis 31ga: de ltar dgra bla dpang bstod pa sa rnam bzhi'i phrin las lhun grub cing phyi nang bar 'ad g.yul las rgyal don gnyis lhun grub the mi tshom sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim lha zhes pa 'ang nye gnas mun sel dang slob bu chos gsal mkhasabatsun dkon blo dad lngan klong yang rnams kyis bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'joms nus ldan rdo rjes spel ba dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lam̐/

( rno chos nyid nam mkha'i klong mdzod las:dbang phyug 'dod rgyal dmar po lam lha gnyer bcol bsam don lhun grub bzhugs so:ches na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ tham stesnyo ja cha skyems phud gtor ma gams sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangs bsgyur spel lhar gsal tang 'dzan brtan po yas srung ma mngon sum gsal byas ta hrī dza:lha min dmags bzlog lha rnams dbugs 'byen pa'i:dbang phyug tshogs bdag 'dod rgyal sras 'khor bcas rnams mang dga' ston rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis bskangs:zhal bzang dung las dkar ba bdag la phyogs dpal mgon bla ma'i chos gral snyogs pa'i tsheX bshad sgrubs nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan kun:zla ba yar gyis ngos bzhin gong 'phel ba'i:grogs kyi dam pa 'dod pa'i rgyal lo mdzod:mkha' 'ayo rigs dang lha klu gnod sbyin mo:pad+ma dung glang ru mo ri dwags ma'i:ḍak+ki su kha'i rtsa la spyod pa'i tshe bde ba mchog sbyin u ma dhe was mdzod:'jigs tshogs zhi ba'i phrin las rtsom pa dngaḥnyams rtogs shar zhing snying rje'i rtsal 'bar phyir wāng ba dpyid dus

dge mtshan gang bsgrub kyang:lha mo 'gugs byed chen mo'i grogs mdzod cig:tshe dpal bsod nams 'byor ba rgyas pa dang: yon tan ye shes byams pa'i dpal 'phel phyir:'byung ba dbyar dus dge mtshan gang brtsam kyang:lha mo 'ching byed chen mo'i grogs mdzod cig:lha 'dre mi gsum zas nor 'du ba dang:bde stong dga' bzhi'i ye shes mngon snang phyir 'byung ba ston dus dge mtshan gang dmigs kyang:lha mo sdom byed chen mo'i sgrub grogs mdzod dgra gsum bdud bzhi g.yang sa drug bcom zhing mngon spyod mthu nus stobs rtsal phun tshogs phyir:'byung ba rgun dus legs tshogs bsgrub pa'i tshe:lha mo myos byed chen mo'i grogs mdzod cig:mi la tshe dang nor la g.yang 'dzoms shing:zas la bcud dang khyims la dpal 'dzom pa'i phywa g.yang sgrub pa'i las la brtson pa'i tshe:dbang phyug rnam sras nor lha'i grogs mdzod cigaḥphyogs bcur don gnyer bya ba kun brtsam nas:tshongs mgron dmags jag shwa rgyan shags las sogs gang yang gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa yis:kha 'dzin sdong grogs dpal mgon tshogs kyis

/rdob mdzod: 'dod pa'i re smon yongs su gang ba dang: dge mtshan dpal la rtag par longs spyod cing: lugs zungs 'byor ba'i don gnyis mthar phyin pa:315 brgyal snying rje'i gter ltar phun dzamags regagaḥ de ltar lam pa bska gsol bas 'dod don thogs med lhun gyi grub chos mthun spel mdzod sgrub po' grogs skal ldan yo sa kyi dpal du bsngags sa ma wā rgyargya rgya gu rgya brda thim 3ni zhes pa' nye gnas mun sel dang / chos gsal sogs kyis bzhed don rko phyir nus ldan rdo rjes spel ba yongs su dge zhi bkra shis par gyur cig sarba maṅga la/

lam lha mdzod srung la ma g.yel skyabs su ma chung cig dgra mgo brdung la bgegs tshogs sma phab cing0 chos mthun bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang phyogs las rnam rgyal dgos 'dod char phob laḥ nam zhig 'og min rnam snang thugs ka —3 myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dang dbyer med mdzod de ltar bskang bas phrin las 'grub bsam don 'bad med thed bzhin 'byung sam māḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥdziḥzhes pa'ang slob bu pad rig nas bskul ngor nus ldan rdo rjes spel ba maṅga lo/ zhus so/༷/ dgra chings re 'byams nag po:snyi: dug shog la sbrul gyi khrag byugs te rnga mong ngam phag gam sha rgya'i khrag dang dug sna bsres te lang tshe bcu drug tu bcad: dang po la mi mgo gyong bo: gnyis pa la khram ris: gsum pa la nad rkyal: bzhi pa la rgya gram de 'og dang po la tho ba: gnyis pa la zor ba gsum pa la j-i:tri: bzhi tha la me ri: de 'og dang po la rtse gsum: gnyis pa la sgrog gsum pa la rdo yi ri mo: bzhi pa la spyang gi: de 'og dang po la ri bong: gnyis pa la sa ris: gsum —pa la chu ri:

04 bzhi pa la rlung ri: de rnams brtsam nas mi khas rdzas ngan sna tshogs byugs te mjug nas yar dril: khyi sbu ra bal gyi rkud pas bcing la rdo nag bcu bzhi pa'i sngags khri dang dmod pa brgya yis sgrub nas lam chen bzhi dang khas ltong bzhi mnan zhing gtad du brgyab na dgra sri gcod cing jag rkun 'ching bar the tshom med pa ngan sngags sbu gri'i 'khor lo dang 'dra bas shin tu zab po: 'dod sred can la ma shor dam tu rgya gla rngan sprad la ma sbyinasnyi: zog po g.yo rgyu can la gu h+ya: snying nor brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i dpyal du shog: a tsā ra rdo rje me yi gshogs pa can gyi srungs shig: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyis yig med rig pa'i brda sgrom las bsgyur ba'o: zhal dro: zhan dgra mnan(ni: byad ma 'bum bzlog las: rdo nag yi ge bcu bzhi pa shin tu zab rgya: lha 'dre rgyug 'thab rgod pa'i rdo nag g.ya' leb laḥ dgra gzugs mkhar rgong srin can gyis bris la: phyi rim tu dug dang khrag sna bsres pas: phaṭa ༷ya ༷raXmā saḥraḥdatsha naX tsaXraḥmaḥs gaX.a: ces dbu can tsheg med du bkod la dgra gzugs bskor: ngag nas

sngags shub bur bzla:phreng ba go rlog te bgrengs bden brjod ni na mo bslu ba med pa dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang:lha dang drang sgong ngag gi dam tshig grub pa rnams kyi bden pa dang bdud 'dul drag mo seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi bden pa dang: bden gnyis baspu ba med pas bden pa'i mthus:dgra shom jag shom 'phrog shom rku shom byed mi rnam gyi bla tshe bsod nams dran sgo za kha dbang thang sngon las 'phral rkyen thams cad drag po'i rdo nag gzugs rten dang bcas pa 'di la phob cig: bstims shig g.yo mgul 'phar ldang med par gyur cig: lan gsum brjod la bsdigs mdzub gzir zhing thal mo brdab:rdo kha sbub nas mal 'og tu mnan la:'o: rgol ba ngan pa re ma zhing lag la 'debs pa'i dbang thang kha sbub la dran pa nyams nas brgyal du chug cig:ye ye:a mu ka myag:rmug 'thibs brgyal 'bog:rbad 〈snad:nyer gcig brjod la mun pa rlung 'thibs rgo ngas g.yog par bsam la lam du phyogs:dgra sde mang nyung gis rgol kyang glags rnyed par mi 'gyur ro:sa ma yā:shin tu zab bo rgya rgya rgya:drang srong 'bum gyi
84 sgog zig gu rgya: man ngag spu gri reg gcod3ni las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog

thaX yang yig nam mkha' 'od gsal las: dzam dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i gsol 'debs pad+ma'i lcags kyu bzhugs:za da 1 na mo ār+ya dzam bha la ya 11tshan snga/ bdeb mtshog sbyin pad+ma'i zhal dbang sdud rgyal por gus phyag 'tshal chos mthun bsam pa 'grub pa 'i phyir khed shes dad pas gsol gdab na na mo gu rtsa ma chags pad+ma rā ga'i zhal bzang can: chos sku mgon po 'od snang mtha' yas la: gsol ba 'debs so rjes chags bde ba sbor don gnyis yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs sgegs bzhad ha la'i sgra sgrogs dpa' rtags ngoms: gnyis snang ru tra 'dul ba'i he ru ga: gsol ba 'debs so don gnyis yid bzhin rnga yab srin gling mkha' 'gro'i 'du ljong nas: mtsho byung rgyal ba pad+ma thod phreng la: gsol ba don gnyis o rgyan dhu ma tha la'i tshogs kyi rje: gsang ba ye shes rnal 'byor dbang mo la: gsol ba don gnyis dgos 'dod longs spyod gter gyis pho brang nas: bsod nams char 'bebs pad+ma dzam bha lar: gsol ba don gnyis khams gsum dbang sdud chags

pa'i zur mig can: skal ldan skyongs mdzad mkha' 'gro mched bdun la: gsol ba don gnyis bstan dang 'gro ba'i legs nyes so bsrung ba'i: rdo rje'i sgog ldan bka' sdod pho nya la: gsol ba 'debs so phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub: byin rlabs dngos grub char rgyun nub med rtsol: snang zhen rnam dag ye shes lha ru smin: sgra grags bde chen gsung gdangs rol bar rdzogs 'gyu 'phro ye shes thugs kyi rdo rje dag: bde gshegs snying por mngon par byang chub re ga: de ltar gsol bar btab pas mas bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa dang phyi nang bar chad bdud las rgyal rig 'dzin sa la skyel ma byed sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya zhes pa'ang dpal ldan dzam lha'i bla mtsho nas mthang gsal beḍār+ya ya 'od thig gi 'bru bdun gter gyi snying po las kho bo rig 'dzin gter bzhed snying po' bsgyur te su kha badz+ra dpal gyas 'dzum la bsgo skal du gyur bas rten 'brel legs pas zhing po pad+ma yi ger bkod pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma le/

ches yang yig nam mkha' 'od gsal las sngon gto 'bul ba phrin las char 'bebs bzhugs/sgod pa na mo ār+ya dzam bha la ya ra1rjes/ca/ke dzam dmar sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bas ja chang skyems dang dkar dmar bshams sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangs bsgyur spel lhar gsal ting 'dzan brtan po yis kye:stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten la dbang drag dregs pa sde bcu ni: rang rang g.yog 'khor dpung dang bcas: bsgrub pa'i grogs su 'bod do byon: gtsang sbyar gser skyems gtor ma bzhes 'gal rkyen bzlog la mthun rkyen sgrubs khyad par yul gzhi'i bdag po ni: dkar nag gnyis skyongs thams cad kun: byams pas sbyin gtor gnas 'dir 'dus: 'dod yon skyems phud dga' ston bzhes: rnam mang phrin las char ltar bsnyil: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zlog: dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: dkar dmar gtor ma skyems bcas mchod byang chub bsgrub pa'i grogasasu bkol sto nyid rdzogs pa'i lta bas gzir 'da' 'khru ldog pa' skyon bral bya sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda' thim snyi zhes
skal ldan dzam lha'i bla mtsho nas rig 'dzin gter bzhed snying posabaton te su kha badz+ra dpal la sman phyir lung zin pad mas yi ger bkod pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅka le/
yang yig nam mkha'i 'od gsal las jam dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i bsgrub pa yid bzhin dbang rgyal bzhugs so:

za da ka namo ār+yadzam bha la ya 11ljag1 ste/sgo bde ba mchog sbyin pad+ma'i zhal rjes chags bshad pa'i he ru ka dzam dmar dbang gi rgyal po la mthon mazing ral bsagatud de 'dud de yibasgrub la brtson 'dod tshe bla rdo srog ga 'khor lo dang byu ru mig gsum dung gi shā in+t+ra g.yu dang be+eḍūr ya za 'og khug mar thum byas te skye bo gzhan gyis mi mthong bar bsgrub rten bya zhing gsang thabs 'chang snying po thugs kyigasang srog ga zhal lasashes pa ltar du bkod bkra shis dpal 'phel bde legs 'dzoms 'dod pa' don 'grub the tshom med sa ma pā dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni na re dadage mche ga kun dnge sa.ār+ya ram̐ bha la nor ster dbang gi rgyal por skyabs su mchiḥ sems can dbul phong sdul bsngal bsal bya'i phyir: nor bdag 'phags pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bya: tshogasabasags ni na 33 khams gsum dbang bsdud pad+ma dzam bha lar: bdag lus rdul rnyed grangs sprul gus phyag 'tshal : lha klu mi yis dga' ston nor sna 'bul: ma byin len dngaser sna rmongs sgrib bshags bsod nams gter 'byung rgyal por rjes yi rang gdul bya'i bsod nams nub med rtsol bar bskul: bskal pa rgya mtshor bstan 'gro'i mgon

ches po bzhugs dge kun gcig bsdus 'khor gsum dag par bsngo:'gro kun rang rig mngon gyur byang chub 3 ga:bka' bsgo ni hūṃ:med snang 'khrul bar gol ba'i bdag gnyis gdon:chos nyid sgyu mar rol ba'i glud gtor 'dis:ngoms zhing tshims par gyis la rang gnas dengs:gsang mchog bsgrub pas gnas 'dir rgyu 'os min:hūṃ hūṃ bhisne ta krita pāṭa:sru 'dzar ni hūṃ hrī:snang srid dag mnyam bde ba chen po'i zhing:ma brtsal rdzogs ldan rang byung lhun grub dal:ye shes rang snang gzhal med khang dbus las mi 'da' rdo rje'i ting 'dzin mchog tu gnas:sa ma yā rak+ka:byin 'bebs ni hūṃ hrī:'og min chos dbyings dbus mtha' med pa nas:dgongs brda' snyan brgyud bla mas byin phob cig dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i pho brang nas:yid dam khro bo khro mos byin phob cig:bde stong dga' bzhi rab 'bar pho brang nas:'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gros byin phob cig:rdo rjes srog ldan gsang ba'i pho brang nas:bka' sdod pho nya rgya mtsho'i dgos 'dod longs spyod gter gyi pho brang nas:dzam dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i

byin dpal spel bsod nams nor gyis char 'bebs pa: gnod sbyin bu mo bdun gyis byin bka' yi tha ram snying la dril ba yi dregs pa mdung dmar can gyis byin bdag gnas sgrub rdzas yo byad ma lus pa: lha sngags dag mnyam rol par dbang skur cig: e h+ya hi sa ma ya pho : mchod dzos bin rlabs ni hūṃ hrīḥ dbang yul shes ngor shar ba'ichos so cog: bde chen ye shes rol bas rgyan du spel gang shar rang grol dgongs pas gzi byin phab dbyings las gton te ye shes dbyings su 'bul: cha badz+ra pū dza sa maya ho: lha bskyed ni hūṃ hrī: 'khor 'das kun khyab chos sku de bzhin nyid: ma 'gags rang gsal bde chen kun tu bzang: rgyu yi sems dpa' 'gro bas don du bskul: spro bsdusa'od kyis brtan g.yo dag par sbyangs: yul lnga'i mkha' 1nga bde ba chen po na pad+ma 'bum bshad dbang gi dkyil 'khor rdzogs: 'dod yon lha mo du mas bkur sti 'bul: phyinang gsang bas dga' ston dpag med sprin: lha klu mi yi nor sna bsam yas 'dzoms: sna bdun rat+na'i gzhal med khang mdzes dbus: nor bdag 'bum gyi zhabs pad khur

the bas khrir:khams gsum dbang bsdud pad+ma dzam bha la lhun gnyer brjid chags khro 'dzum smar smin 'bar:dmar ser ral ba thol cog rat+na'i mdzes zal bu rgyab grol nor bu'i phreng ba dang:rin chen mu tig dar dpyangs mdzes par klub:phyag g.yas dbang sdud pad+ma'i lcags kyu dang:g.yon pas nor ster yid bzhin ne'u lebatsir:gnod sbyin bu mo bdun gyis bkur sti 'bul:nor bu rin chen dgos 'dod longs spyod stobs:phywa 'bebs g.yang 'bebs lha klu'i dpal 'byor 'dzoms phrin lasachar 'bebs gnod sbyin mdud dmar can glang chen khar rol nor bu rin chen stobs:kun kyang dga' bde'i zil ba 'khrigs bzhin tu:snang stong 'dzin med 'od kyis sku ru gsal:sregag gis bskul te dag pa'i zhing khams nas:nor bdag dzam lha 'khe ra bcas spyan drangs bstims spyan 'dren pa ni hūṃ hrī:zla gam dbang gi zer sprin 'khrigs pa'i klong:pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan steng nas:nor gyis char 'bebs ār+ya ram̐ bha laḥganod sbyin bu mo bdun dang nor lha'i tshogs:phyu 'bebs g.yang sdus dngos grub rtsol bzhin tu

ma thog bsgrub pas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs: brtse bas zur mig ngoms la zhal bzang ston: pad+ma kro ta ār+ya ram̐ bha la hrī dwa ya sarba sa ma yu dza dza: bzhugs gsol ni hūṃ hrī:bla rdo srog 'khor dam tshig dag pa'i rten: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas yo byad la: dgyes shing brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur ston bzhin tu: mi 'gyur bde ba mchog tu 'azhugs su gsol sa ma yā stum: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra phyag 'tshal ni na mo sgegs bzhad zhi ma khro 'dzum brjid nyams chags: brtse gdung zur mig skal ldan pad tshal g.yo: bde nas bde ba mchog la kha sbyor bas dbang sdud dzam bha lha la gus phyag 'tshal: na mo sa ma yā ho: mchod pa ni hūṃ hrī: bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid nor sna bdun nye ba'i rin chen 'dod yon lha mo'i tshogs: phyi nang gsang bas dga' ston mtha' yas pas: dzam dmar sku gsung thugs mchog bskang bar bgyi: rgo ma hā a nu rā ga pū dza sa ma yā hoX bstod pa niḥ / hrī:khams gsum dbang bsngad gnod sprin nor lha'i tshogs srid gsum dam 'dogs 'byung po zil gyis gnon: phyu g.yang char 'bebs gdul bya'i re ba sgongs: dzam dmar

zas dbang gi rgyal po khyod la bstod: lha klu gnod sbyin tshogs kyis mngon par bsngags: bde sbyin phyag rgya du mas dga' ston stobs: mngon par byang chub mod kyang gdul bya'i mgon: gter gyi bdag po khyod zhabs gtsug gis bstod: dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su rnam par 'khrul: brtse bas zur mig skal ldan dpal du rol:'brel tshad bde mchog pad+ma brtsegs par 'god: gdul bya'i skyabs mgon khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'di gzung ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar sa lam nyams rtogs spel nas grogs po mdzod: mi mthun rgud pa'i phyogs rnams ming lhag gyur: don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung ba'i grub mchog stsol 'dzab dmigs na rang khams gsum dbang sdud ār+ya ram̐ bha lar gsal bas thugs sgog hrīḥdamar po la sngags kyi bskor bas 'od zer gyis 'phags pa mchod: sems can gyi don byas: 'khor 'das 'byung bas dwangs bcud thams cad bsdus te yang yang bstims pas srid zhi gnyis kyi mnga' thang stobs 'byer la dbang bsgyur bar mos la: oṃ pad+ma kro ta ār+ya dzam bha la hrī dwa ya sarba sirnyi trī ting 'dzin dmigs

ba 'i ngar ldan pas bye ba bzlas pas nyams rtogs 'bar sa lam yon tan mthar phyin te don gnyis lhun grub gdon mija sa ma mā bsgrub 'dzab ni rang ār+ya dzam bha lar gsal bas thugs 11ga sngags phreng dang pho nya'i tshogs mu mtha' yas par spros te 'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i dpal yon srid zhi'i bde legs kyi dngos po thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyis rnam par bsdus nas bdag dang sgrub rdzas la yang yang bstims pas dngos grub nor gyi skal bzang po 'dzoms zhing bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pas dge mtshan 'bar bar mos la: slo pad+ma kro ta ār+ya dzam bha la hrī:dwa ya aḥn+niḥtri a ga ya bsdus sirnyi pha la stam: yengs med ting 'dzin gnad ldan pas bye ba bzlas pas dngos grub thob sa ma yu las sbyor 'dzab dmigs ni de ltar khams gsum dbang sdud ār+ya dzam bha la'i gsang sngags snying po bung ba tshangs zhugs pa ltar bzlas pas mchog thun mongs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par dmigs: tshe pad ma kro ta ār+ya dzam bha la hūṃ sarba rat+na bā su na na kha dhe aḥn+ni tri a raX ya bsdus bsdus hūṃ rat+na sirnyi pha la khug 11la: las sngags 'bum phrag dag par bsgrangs ting 'dzin gsal bas gnad ldan na

sgo da1 dngos grub gegs med yid bzhin thob dbang phyug dpal gyis dam par 'gyur sa ma yā tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba laḥ dang po byin gyis rlabs pa niḥ hūṃ hrī: bde ba'i 17da mchog pad+ma'iyol go na tshogs rdzas bza' bca' btung dang ldag gzhib bkod dpa' bo dpa' mo thabs shes zung 'jug tshogs: dga' ston rgyal ba dgyes pa'i mchod sprin spro: slo ma hāgā ṇa tsakra pū dza sa ma ya ho: spyan 'dren na hūṃ trī: dgos 'dod longs spyod gter gyi pho brang nas nor bdag pad+ma kro ta rje bha la: gtso 'khor sprul pa sdul rted grangs mnyam pa 'du ba tshog la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rmad byung rol bas dga' ston bkra shis la dgyes par dgongs shing brtse ba mchog gi rol: ar+ya dze+e bha la sa ma yā dza dza: tshogasaphud ni hoḥ dga' ston tshogs kyis longs spyod brjid dang ldan: sha lnga 'dod yon rol ston bag re spro: sgrub mchog skal ldan pho mo dam re gtsang: 'di la dgyes pa mchog gisarol mdzod cig: tshe ma hwa ga ṇa tsakra pā dza kha hi bar bshags ni hoḥ nyon mongs bag rdul 'dres pas nongs pa yiḥ sor byang sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa kun: mchod dang sprin

pas dngos po ma dag pa thams cad mnyam nyid thabs chen tshogs kyi bshags: sa ma ya bhi shud+dhi a: tshogs bsgral ni hūṃ hrī: bdag tu 'dzin pas rtog pa thad gar gcod: gnyis med mnyam pa'i blo yis gdul bya skyongs: thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i dgongs spyod kyis: ma rig bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma bsgral bar bya: sarba rū tra ma ra ya pāṭa: bstabs pa ni hūṃ hrī: chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i zhal ho du: log rtog bsgral bas phung khams skye mched bstabs: 'ub chub bde ba chen por 'dren rol nas: 'khrul ba ka dag sku gsum mngon gyur shog me sa rak+ta tsit+ta la khā hiḥ lhag ma ni pho: chos nyid dag pas gsang srog 'chang ba yis: dbang byug ma sring ging ling 'bar ma rnams: bshud pa brda' dang g.yab mo'i 'bod lags na: sgrub pa mchog 'dir dam tshig dbang gis gshegs pham phab bzhes la rnam mangs phrin las sgrubs: bde stong dga' bzhi'i 'od gsal sbar ba dang: bsod nams longs spyod nor gyis char ba phob: sa ma mā hrī u ṭa bha lirnyi kha hi: bskul ba ni hūṃ bh+yo: ma g.yel ma bul nor bdag rja lha'i tshogs: lha klu mi yis dpal

bsha 'byor dbang du sdus:skal ldan sgrub pa po la dus 'dir rtsol:sde bzhi'i dpal gyis mngon dpal mtho bzhin du phyogs las rnam rgyal bkra shis char ltarabasnyil:dgos 'dod re ba 'jo bas skal bzang rtsol:thug dam ma g.yel brngan ston 'di bzhes la rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod:ra mdo ni bh+yoḥ.o rgyan slon dpon pad+ma sam bha was:spyan sngar khas blang mna' bor dam mnos pa'i:phyi nang gsang ba mchog gi sde brgyad rnams sngon nas zhal bzhes dam tshig mnos pa ltar sgrub pa mchog gi grogs su da tshur gshegs:bsnyen bsgrubs ting 'dzin bsgom pas bar chad bzlog:tshe dpal nyams rtogs yar ngos zla ltar spel:thugs mthun bzhed don gang gā'i rgyun ltar rtsol:dgra bdud dam sris 'tshe ba dbyings su zlogaḥrig 'dzin brgyud pa'i rjes su slob pas phyir grogs po khyod la gtang rag gtor ma 'bul:'dod pa'i re 'bras gegs med 'byung bar mdzod:bstan ma ni bh+yo:tshogs kyis dbang phyug pad+ma he ru ga'i:spyan sngar khas blangs gna' bor dam mnos pas bdag nyid chen mo la

sogs bdud mo bzhi: gangs dkar sha med la sogs gnod sbyin bzhi gong btsun de mo la sogs sman mo bzhi: bod khams skyongs mdzad che zhe chen mo rnams: a su ra yis brag phug dam gnos ltar: ma g.yel sgrub pa mchog gi gnas 'dir 'dusaḥ bshal chu'i skyems dang bha ling brngan mchod bzhes rig 'dzin 'ja' lus rdo rjes bshul lam skyolaX dhu ma tha lar spyod pa'i grogs mdzod cig: ma mā trī badz+ra pra mo ha bha ling ta kha hiX rta bro ni nyu: rang bzhin mnyam pa chos dbyings e klong du: rnam rtogs gnyis snang bdud dang rū tra brubaḥ ma ldang ldang med ye shes bro rgyas gdab: byang chub bar du ldog med stum bha ya: cha ā:hūṃ swā hā mā ra ya nan nan: dngos grub ni hūṃ hrī: nor bu rin chen dgos 'dod 'byung ba ltar: bsam 'phel rja lha dbang rgyal bsgrub 'bras bu: tshe dang bsod nams chos dang longs spyod nor: bdag cag skal ldan rnams la dus 'dir rtsol: rtsa sngagasamathar midhi pha la stum: bshags pa ri ho: bdag ni ma rig rmongs shing gti mug pas: bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin ma gsal bying rlug 'thub: le lo g.yeng ba som nyi'i dbang gyur

tham nongs: mi 'chab mi zed ye shes lha la bshags: sa ma ya ā: bsngo smon ni ho: dus gsum bsags pa'i rnam dkar dge tshogs kun gcig tu bsdus te mgyur 'gro la bsngo: lus ngag yid kyis 'khrul snang ka dag te: rang bzhin gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings mngon gyur 31ga lan gsum bsdu rim: āḥ snod bcud gzhal yas lha rnamasachos skur bsdus: dgongs pa spros bral de bzhin nyid du bzhag a ā: lhar ldang ni pāṭa: slar yang mkha' las glogs 'od 'khrugs pa ltar: rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i lha skur ldang: pāṭa phaṭa shas brjod ni na mo ༷ bsod nams lhun po ri rgyal bzhin du bstan: dngos grub longs spyod gang gā'i rgyun ltar bsreng bsam pa'i re 'dod yid bzhin nor ltar 'phel: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis regag: de ltar bsgrub pa zab mo 'di'i phyi nang bar chad kun sel zhing nyams rtogs yon tan lo 'bras smin don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za 'bum phragamakha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod 'di slob dpon pad+ma'i thugs khrag ste skal ba can gyis dpal du shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda tham snyi zhes pa'ang dpal ldan dzam lha' bla mtsho bkra shis g.yang 'khyil nas mthing gsal 'od kya

thig le'i brda' snying lasakho bo rig 'dzan gter bzhed snying po'i dag par phab pa su kha badz+ra dga' ba'i dpal gyis bgo skal du gyur bas rten 'brel phun tshogasadabang gisayi ger chosabadag pad+mas bkod pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma la/

zas yang yig nam mkha' 'od gsal las dgyes bskangs bsod nams gter sprin nor lha'i rgyud bskul bzhugs:sgod pa na mo ār+ya dzam bha la ya rnabhachesaspyos/ bde ba mchog sbyin pad+ma'i zhal dzam dmar dbang gi rgyal por 'dud phyi nang gsang ba'i dga' ston gyis nor bdag dgyes pa bskangs bar bya sa ma yu rnga rol snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas teḥ ( trī: ma chags pad+ma rā ga'i zhal bzang can: 'od dpag med mgon rgyal bas thugs dam bskangs rjes su chags pas bzhad gad glu ru len dbang chen h+ya skṛ wa'i thugs dam bskangs mtsho byung rgyal ba mi mjed zhing gi mgon: pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis thugs dam bskangs: khams gsum dbang bsdud phywa g.yang char 'bebs pas: dzam dmar gter gyis bdag po'i thugs dam bskang: phyag g.yas snang ba dbang bsdud lcags kyu yis skye rgu'i dbul ba bsal mdzad thugs dam bskangs g.yon pas 'dod 'byung nor gyis skyal pa btsir: snyigs ma'i rgud pa sbyobs mdzad thugs dam bskang: nor bu ratā mu tig char ba 'bebs: skal ldan skyongs bar mdzad pa'i

bsod nams nor g.yang lho sprin ltar du gtibs: dbul phong sdug bsngal bsal mdzad phrin las rnam bzhis re ba skongs mdzad pa'i: gnod sbyin bu mo bdun gyis phywa 'bebs g.yang sdud dngos grub char 'bebs pas nor bdag dzam lha'i tshogs kyis phrin las dbul ba sel bas sbyin stobs can: gnod sbyin mdung dmar 'chang mdzad rgyal ba'i bka' nyan bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i: bka' sdod pho nya rnams kyis thugs dam bskang: / hrī: ma bzung yul snang dag pas dga' ston dang: spangs blang zhen 'dzin grol ba'i mchod sprin gyis: ma lus gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang: dmigs med 'khor gsum yongs dag nyid du bzhes don gnyis yid bzhin 'grub pa'i dalnga sa dza/ba spyodapa: de ltar bskangs ba'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib dag nyams rtogs mkha' ltar rgyas sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda' thim snyi zhes pa'ang dpal ldan dzam lha'i bla mtsho nas kho bo rig 'dzin gter bzhed snying po' mthing gsal 'od kyis brda' byang lasabasgyur te su kha badz+ra dpal gyas dga' ston du shar bas mod la yi ge'i mthun rkyen lung zin pad+mas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

62 yang yig nam mkha' 'od gsal las gnam phudasrung ma'i bskang ba bzhugs so:sgodapa na mo ār+ya dzam bha la ya rna/phyo/khre/la dpal ldan ār+ya dzam bha la dga' ston tshogs kyis dgyes bskang tshe srung ma las la 'byun pa dang dngos grub gegs med thob pa'i phyir gnam phudabaska ba 'di nyid bya glu gar rol mo'i dbyangs bcas te hūṃ bh+yo mtsho byung rgyal ba'i bka' sdod pa: brag dmar khyung rdzong gnod sbyin rgyal: a grags nor bu dung rtse dang: klu mo gzigayang nor gyi bdag: bka' 'khor sprul pa g.yog dang bcas glu gar rol mos 'bod cing bskul 'du ba tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs dpa' bo'i bzhes lhag dga' stonastobs: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bskangs nyams chags 'gal 'khrul nongs pa bshags: 'khu ldog gdug rtsubs mi mdzad par ma bu'i dam tshig rnam dag pa: byangachub bsgub pa'i grogs mdzod cig: phrin las ma g.yel sa ma yā: dza gad phud dang stogs ston mchod phrin las gang bcol thog med 'grub pad+ma'i thugs bcud zab mo 'di skal ba can gyas dpal du shog

sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda' thim snyi zhes pa'ang dpal ldan dzam lha'i bla mtsho nas kho bo rig 'dzin gter bzhed snying pos bton ste su kha badz+ra dpal la sman phyir mkha' 'gro'i brda' mdzod lasabasgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zinapad+mas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba ma le/

tha dgongs gter nam malta' mdzod kyi chos sde las: gter srung yongs rdzogs kyi gsol mchod nyung bsdus phrin las glog 'khyug bzhugs so:tha ༷ na mo gu ru ya jashadz+ran sha khrag ja chang skyems phud bshams rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis hūṃ bh+yo: rdo rje khrag 'thung pad+ma rgyal po yi: spyan sngar khas blangs mna' bor dam mnos pa'i tshogs rje tshogs bdag legs ldan phyag bzhi pa: phyag drug ma ning ber nag gur mgon dang: drag shad bdud mgon phyogs bcu sde brgyad mgon lha dmag bye ba dung phyur gsol mchod bskang: lha yi bla ma dbang phyug 'dod pa'i rgyal: gha ṇa pa ti u ma gnam sman yum: dus bzhi'i lha mo dpal mgon bdun cu dang: rnam sras nor lha dzam dmar spug 'dzin dang: dzam dkar ser nag phyug lha ljang ku sogs ar+ya re man gter bdag gsol mchod bskang dmar po lha lnga dam can sde bdun dang: dreg pa sde dgu gtsang btsan thig le rtsal: gza' dmar me 'phreng gzarā nag dug sdong rgyal: btsan rgod chen po rdo rje yang le ber: dgra bla ge sar dpa' brtul yang banyul tshogs: ja ma dung

sman yang g.yog gsol mchod bskang: nyi 'od 'bar ma rdo rje g.yu yi sgron: e ka dza ṭi tshe ring mched sde lnga: brtan ma bcu gnyis sbas pa'i ma mo gsum: srog bdag sde bzhi las gshin ging ging rgyal:sha zan spyang mo drug dang sha za ging: rgyal chen sku lnga yum blon gsol mchod bskang: thang lha gnyen po rma rgyal sbom ra dang: dge bsnyen g.yu rtse rdza yi gser khrab dang: 'brong ri spug po rnga la stag rtse dang: tsa ri tsha 'dra tsa gong tsha sgo'i brag yar lung gnas bdun khri shog spre'u rdzong shing lo he brag gteng srung gsol mchod bskang: spu gri mched gsum a tsar nag po bdun: yak+ka nag mo sha za kha mo che:ti se ti sgro ti gong gnas gter bdag mdor na zab gter chu bo bdun ldan gyi: mtshan nas zin dang ma zin dam can rnams: tha tshig bsgrag nas 'bod do gsol mchod bskang: gnyis 'dzin dbang gis nong pa gang song bshags: sgrib med sa ler gzigs pas srung skyobs mdzod: chos mthun phywa g.yang dngos grub char du snyil nyer 'che'i phyogs zhi legs pa'i dpal yon rgyas: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang bsdus dgra 'gegs sgrol: don

sgo dka gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i grogs mdzod la: byang chub bar du sgrub pa'i grogs su bsnyen: 'og min dag pa'i gnas su skyel ma mdzod: zhal bzhes thugs dam ma g.yel dam tshig can: gra sa bsogs snyi nye phrin las myur dgos 'dod longs spyod char ltar 'bebs rig 'dzan sa la the mi tshom sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang sprul pa'i sku mchog pad+ma'od gsal snyi po nas bskur ro ra nus lda na pas bris pa dge legs 'phe la sarba maṅga la/

sko1 chos nyid dgongs pa'i klong mdzod las: dzam dkar 'brug zhon lha lnga'i zab sgrub yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so:za dka na cho ār+ya rje bha la ya 31rte/1mi dkyil 'bor mchod rdzas yo bshad bkrams rnam lnga la sogs mdzes par bya 'o phud dang ni dkar gtor bshams zang gzhong 'o chab bkang ba'i nang sku gzugs bkod la dar gur phub de nas las kya bzhung 'dir 'jug sa ma yu spyi don rnam pa bcu yi bstan dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni na re : yid bzhin gter mjod ār+ya dzam bha lar: don gnyis lhun gyis grub phyir skyabs su mchi: brgal dka' srid pa'i rba klong skem byas phyir: rin chen byang chub sems mchog bskyed bgyi'o: lan gsum gnyis pa yan lag bdun pa ni na mo: 'dod 'byung dzam lha dkar po phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'byor yid sprul bkra shis rdzas rtags 'bul: ma byin blang dang brnab sems ser sna bshags: dgos 'dod gter du bzhugs la rjes yi rang chos dang mthun pa'i dge legs stsang ba bskal: phongs rbad dbul sel rtag tu gsol ba 'debs: rnam dkar dge kun 'khor gsum dag par bsngo phyam

gcig sku dang ye shes mngon gyur shog lan gsum gsum pa lha bskyed sgom pa niḥ hrī: chos kun mi dmigs de bzhin nyid kyi ngang: rang bzhin lhun grub rten 'brel sgyu ma'i 'phrul:ngo mtshar zhing gi bkod pa phun sum tshogs: brda don rtags rdzogs rang byung gzhal med khang sgo gru rta babs mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dbus: dgos 'dod longs spyod char 'bebs sprin 'khrigs dbus: 'phags pa rdza dkar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas be con g.yon pas nai'u le btsir: dar dang rat+na nor bu'i do shal mjes: zhal 'dzum spyan zlum zhi ma khro nyams ldan: lhun gnyer brjid chags gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ 'chang: g.yu 'brug gdan steng phyed rol thabs su 'bying: 'ja' 'od klong du snang stong zung 'jug sku: ye shes 'od gsal dwangs ma'i phung por bskyed shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhi zhing 'dzum: dkar po lcags kyu g.yas la ne'u le g.yon: lho ru rin chen mkha' 'gro gser gyi mdog: be con g.yas la rin chen zhags pa g.yon: nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro byu ru'i mdog: pad phreng g.yas la lcags sgrog ne'u le g.yon byang du garma mkha' 'gro ljang gsal

thaX mdzes shing tog pu ra g.yas la dril bu g.yon:kun kyang dar dang rat+na rus pas brgyan:'ja' 'od gur klong snang stong zung 'jug sgoms:gzhan yang nor lha gter bdag bsam mtha' yas:ma 'dres dngas gsal 'od sku 'dzin med shar:gnas gsum rdo rjelis bon yi ge dang:thugs ga'i sgog las 'od 'phros ye shes pa rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs gnyis med bstims:dam ye ro gcig bde ba chen po bzhugs:ngo mtshar mdzad phrin mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal:gzung 'dzin dag pas byi nang gsang mchod sprin stag seng khyung 'brug bkra shis rdzas rtags 'bul:'dod yon kun bzang sprin gyis thugs dam bskangs gdung dbyangs rol mo dam tshig dag pas bstod:gnyis snang nongs pas thugs 'gal dri ma bshags:'phags pamithugs gar ram̐ḥl sngags kyis bskor:bzlas pas sngags 'khor 'od 'phros don gnyis byas:tshur 'dus 'khor 'das dpal yon 'byung bzhi'i bcud:zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i char chen po:sku dang phyag las sib sib rdol rdol bab:rang gnas bang mdzod tho phyi ma

lus pa mer mer chil gang dpal 'byor rgyas par dmigs sa pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam:bha la hrī:da ya hūṃ pāṭa bye ba bzlos pas dpal 'byor longs spyod rgyas chos mthun bsam 'grub don gnyisalhun gyis grub sa ma mā 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i bzlas sngags ni rang srog 'od kyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro bskul 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol bar dmigs habadz+ra ḍasko ni ā yu sarba sirnyi hūṃ 'bum phrag lnga bslos tshe srog bkrag mdangs 'phel rang sgog 'od kyis rin chen mkha' 'gro bskul: zad med nor gyis dngos grub stsol bar dmigs riḥrat+na ḍak+ki ni bā su sarba sirnyi pha la /: 'bum phrag lnga bzlos zad med nor la dbang rang sgog 'od kyis pad+ma mkha' 'gro bskul: lha 'dre mi gsum dpal 'byor stsol bar dmigs: niyad+ma ḍak+ko ni aḥzloḥtriḥ.a ga ya bsdus bsdus rat+na sirnyi pha la (ཿ 'bum phrag lnga bzlas khams gsum dpal 'byor dbang rang srog 'od kyis garma mkha' 'gro bskul: bcud ldan zas kyi dngos grub stsol bar dmigs sa7/slo ḍāk+ki ni na na kha dhe sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ: 'bum phrag lnga bzlas bcud ldan zasaskoms 'byor bzlas pa gsung gi rnal 'byor ste sa bcad bzhi pa'o lnga pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni bsangasasbyangs

tha spel la 'di skad do hrī: rin chen mjes pa'i snod du dkar bgos niḥ gangs ltar brjed ldan 'dod yon lnga'i phung po: zad med zad bral ngo nor bdag dzam dkar gtso 'khor bcas la 'bul: tshe chos dpal 'byor nor gyi dngos grub stsol: snye pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam bha la hrī dā ya sarba bā lirnya kha ha ri:ni sa ba:lirnyi khā hi grangs bsogs dgyes bskang nor gter stsol drug pa 'o chab 'bul ba na: bas sa sbyangs spel bsgyur grub nas slar snyen āḥ(ཿ rin chen bye da du mngar gadza ma bdud rtsi 'o chab 'dod yon lnga'i phung po dkar gsal sngo mdangs chags pa'i rgyun bzang 'di: 'bru gsum nus pas zag med a bṛ ta ye shes lnga yi rol ngabasgyur0 de nyid mdun gyi dzam lha rigs lngar 'bul: dgyes bskang lte ba'i ram̐ gyis dbal zhi nas chos mthun zas nor longs spyod 'dod dgu'i char: sgrub pa stsol bar dmigs: 31 pad+ma kro ta ār+ya je bha la trī da ya ha ri ni:saX ḍak+ki ni sarba a dṛ ta pu dza khā hi: brgya stong la sogs sku la mnyes chab 'bul bdun pa dngos thub zhu ba ni hrī:

phyin mthar son sku yi rigs: yid bzhin re ba skong ba'i stsol shugs can mgon po ram̐ dkar ḍāk+ki bcas la bstod: bdag la longs spyod nor gyi dngos grub stsol: sarba sirnyi trī: brgyad pa phywa g.yang 'bod pa niḥ hrī: nor gyi dbang phyug gnod sbyin nor lha'i rje: gangs ltar lhun po lta bu'i dzam bha la: yid bzhin re rkongs sbyin pa'i stobs shugs can: khyed la skyabs mchi phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs: brtan g.yo srid pa'i dge mtshan phywa dang g.yang: 'dir khug 'dir 'dus mi nub dar 'phel rgyas: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis mchog: rnal 'byor sgrub pa po la stsal du gsol: zhes grangs bsogs na phrin las myur ba'o dgu pa bzod gsol niḥ ho: bdag rmongs ma byin blang dang ser sna byas: brnab sems brgyud btsog byas pa'i nyes sgrib kun: mgon po rja bha lha la bshags bgyi'o: sgrib bral tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: sa ma ya shudhe āḥ bcu pa bsngo ba smon lam ni ho bsod nams bsags pa'i dge ba ci bsags kun: phun tshogs skal ba 'dzom byir bsngo bar bgyi: 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i dpal yon dbang thob nas: kun mkhyen mgon po'i

tha ༷ sa la byang chub shog: bcu gcig pa brten bzhugs bya ba ni hrī: mi 'gyur lhun po dam chig gsang mdzod dang ye shes 'khor lo gnyis med rtag bzhugasasgrub pa po yi chos mthun gsos sna tshogs: 'bad stsol med par rtag tu bde legs stsol: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: bcu gnyis mchod bstod 'bul ba ni hrī: dngos 'byor yid sprul ting 'dzin ‘gyi nor: phyi nang gsang mchod kun bza nam mkha'i mdzod ye shes sgyu 'phrul ltad mo nor lhar 'bul: tshe chos bsod nams srid kyi dngos grub stsol: o ma hā pu dza saho hrī: gangs dkar mdangs la rta bdun 'khyugs pa'i 'od gdul bya'i blo yi gnyis rtog mun pa sel: bsam 'phel gter bum dpag bsam las 'phags pa'i dmar rigs bzhi'i ḍāk+ki bcas la bstod: bcu gsum shis pa brjod pa ni na moḥ sgrin grol char 'beb dbang byin 'od stong 'khyugs: srid zhi'i dpal ster sa lam bsgrongastegs: yon tan kun 'byung bde legs 'byung ba'i gnas: mgon po dzam bha lha yi bkra shis 31ga: bsngo ba smon lam mtha' brgyan bcas grub pas bsod nams dpal 'byor bskyed do

yid bzhin ngang gisa'agrub the tshom bral lo sam mā rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thim lha zhesapa 'di'ang chos bdag kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyisabaskul ngor/bdag 'dra ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi sprul pa pad+ma gar dbang rtsal gyi dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga le/

tha ༷ chos nyid dgongs pa'i klong mdzod las: dzam dkar 'brug zhon lha lngalirtsa dbang phun tshogs dpal ster bzhugs so:zad nama.ār+ya jebhal ya rta sgrub/〉〉/ dal bkod bdag mdun bum bzlas bya tshogs bsags rig pa'i me tog dor slob ma gral bsdu khrus bgegs bsal srung gur phub rjes maṇ+ḍal 'bul gsol ba 'di ltar gdab par bya kye chogs kyi dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs: bdag cag bsod nams skal ba mi dman phyir: nor bdag ār+ya dzam dkar rigs lnga yi: rtsa dbang dam pa gnang ba'i bka' drin zhu: lan gsum bla mas ho: bsod nams skal ba smon lam 'phro bzang can: 'dir tshogs mos ldan pho mo dgyes pas gson: dgos rgu 'byung ba rat+na'i nor dbang mchog: sbyin par sla ste yon dang rin thang dka': ci yod bdog tshad bla mar 'bul ba dang lto gos gtam la zhen pa ltos thag gcod: bsnyen sgrub brtson zhing rig pa'i nor sna kun: dpal ldan dzam lhar 'bul ba'i dam tshig laX nges par gnas na dbang gi skal ba sprin mi nus pa rnams rang gnas phyir dengs shig: rgyud

sbyang bya de nas dam 'dzan na ho: bka' drin mtshungs med rdo rje'i bla ma dgongs: srid pa'i dpal yon zhen med rgyan du spyod: 'dzin bral rig pas mchod sprin lhag lhar 'bul: mi g.yo chos kyi rgyal po'i go sar snyogs: phan bde'i phrin las gdul zhing yongs la smin: srid zhi'i thabs mkhas gsang sgog dam tshig 'dzin: dran shes ldan pas nam yang nyams med bya: de nas dam chu sbyin pa ni ho: gsang ba las kyi mna' chu a mṛ ta: dam ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i lce la bzhag: dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub tshe 'dir thob: nyams pa gang la bka' chad drag po 'bebs: rdo rje'i dmyal bar gnar 'gyur gzu bor byos dbang sgog dam tshig rgya mtsho 'da' med srungs sa ma ya na ra gan: me tog sbyin cing mig dar bkab sgob ma lhar gsal ye shes dbab de nyid brtan bzhugs gdong g.yog bkrol lha ngo sprad la me tog 'bul de nas bum dbang bskur ba ni hū hrī: dri med 〈snang yangs bum pa'i gzhal yas dbus: lha tshogs ma 'dres bkra ba'i byin rlabs rgyun: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la sbyin par bgyi: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal thob 31ga: rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a snyi ṣiñtsa tshe: de nas dzam dkar

thaX gyi sku gtad la hūṃ trī: ngo bo sangs rgyas kun dang tha mi dad: rang bzhin nor lha yongs kyi spyi rje bo thugs rjes gdul bya yongs la dgos 'dod 'bebs: nor bdag dzam lha dkar po'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya de nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sku gtad la hūṃ hrī: thugs rje lcags kyus gdul bya gnas nas 'dren: dgos 'dod char bas dad ldan blo bde 'byung: smon lam mthu yis yangs pa'i rgyal khams skyobs 'gugs byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya rin chen mkha' 'gro'i sku gtad la hūṃ trī: byams pa'i zhags pas 'gro drug gnas rnams stong: kun bzang yum chen dgongs klong smin grol byed: rnal 'byor chos bzhin spyod la mthun rkyen sbyor 'ching mdzad rin chen mkha' 'gro'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya pad+ma mkha' 'gra'i sku gtad la hūṃ trī: dga' ba'i sgog gis nyon mongs g.yul ngo 'joms: ma rig 'khrul 'khor bde ba chen por sbor: thug rje brtse bas gdul bya'i re ba skongs rmongs byed padru mkha' 'gro'i dbang basmar ro: rtsa sngags mthar ka ya las kyi mkha' 'gra'i sku gtad la ྅hri

btang snyoms dril bus byang chub sems rgyas 'debs: khams gsum g.yo 'khrugs sku gsum dgongs klong sbyor: dad ldan bu la mchog thun dngos grub sbyin myos mdzad dril bu ma yi dbang rtsa sngags mthar kā ya gsang dbang bdud rtsi sbyan la hū hrī: bde skyongs snod bzang ka pā la yi nang: bde stong gsang mdzod byang sems dkar dmar bskyil: skal ldan bu yi lce la bzhag pa yis: spros bral rtogs pa mngon gyur dbang thob shog:rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka a bhe ṣiñtsa ā: sngags 'khor gtad la hū hrī: snying po sngags ni ting 'dzin 'gyur med sgog: gsang gsum ye shes rdo je 'byed pa'i sgo: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas gsang sngags bzlas pa mthar phyin dbang thob regag: rtsa sngags mthar wāk+ka sher dbang rag ma gto laḥ hū hrī: bde ba'i rang bzhin mdzes pas zur mig g.yo dga' ba'i dpal ster rigs lnga'i rtags 'chang ma: las ldan snying gi bu mchog khyod la sbyin: 'ju 'dul mthar phyin khams gsum rol bar shog rtsa sngags mthar pradzña dzña na a bhi ṣiñtsa /: gter bum gtad la hu hrī: bsod nams chen po yangs pa'i sprin ltar 'khyugs: dngos

thaX grub rgyun bzang rgya mtsho che ltar bskyil: bkra shis dpal kha rdzogs ldan ltar snang ba'i dge mtshon bum pa bzang po'i dbang bskur ro: rtsa sngags mthar rat+na a snyi ṣiñtsa tram̐: lcags kyu gtad la hūṃ trī: lha 'dre mi gsum 'gro ba'i snang ba g.yo: thogs med stobs kyis srid zhi'i dpal yon 'gugs: thabs kyi phyag rgya bde ba'i lcags kyu yi dbang mchog dam pa rigs ldan bu la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar rat+na aṅku a snyi ṣiñtsa stum ne'u le gtad la hūṃ trīsnye dgos 'dod char 'bebs nor byi dpal 'dzin pa: khyod nyid dgyesan nor bu'i dngos grub rgyun: dad ldan sgrub mchog lhag bsam dag la ster: yid bzhin dbul sel ne'u le'i dbang mchog sbyin: rtsa sngags mtharangat+na ne'u 'gasarba a bhi ṣiñtsa s+t+waṃ gser gzhong nor sna'i bka ba gtad la hūṃ hrī bkra shis rin chen dang po'i gzhong pa na phun tshogs nor sna 'bru sman zas kyis bkang: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ba bde legs 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar sarba ra 2 a snyi ṣiñtsa hrī: tshig dbang 'ja' shel gtad la hūṃ trī: mtshan ma chig bral ka dag don gyi dbang rang byung ye

shes rang la rdzogs mod kyang: gnyis chos yol bas re zhig gab gsang gyur: rten 'brel dri bral rtags kyi dbang bskur bas: brda mdzod 1nga rdol rig stong mngon gyur shog rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta e ga ga dharma dhartu hūṃ hūṃ a snyi ṣiñtsa ā: mtha' rten gtor ma'i dbang bskur ni hūṃ hrī: brdal khyab ka dag yangs pa'i gzhong pa dza lhun grub sku dang ye shes gtor chenabashams: rtsa ba gsum gyi spro bsdu 'khrigs pa 'di sgrub dang dkyil 'khor 'dus pa'i gsang mdzod ste: rigs ldan khyod la dpal chen dbang bskur ro: srid na mtshungs dpebral ba'i dpal thob 31ga: rtsa sngagasamathar bā lirnya a snyi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥ/ hrī: de nas smon lam dbang bskur ni me togs 'azor la 'di skad do hūṃ hrī: bkra shis dpal gyi dbang bskur 'di sbyinapas bu khyod bsod nams nor dang ldan sher shog 'chi med rdo rje tshe la mnga' brnyes shing: chos srid rin chen snying por spyod gyur cig: lha khams ma lus dbang du bsgyur ba dang: dregs pa sde brgyad las la 'chun par re ga gling bzhi mi yi dpal la dbang za zhing sa bdag klu yi nor la mnga' brtes 31ga: bkra shis rdzogs ldan gsar tshes lang

sgo dri tsho la: bde skyid chos bzhin spyod pa'i bkra shis re ga: mtha' sten bkra shis rdzas rtags gtad dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab des ni dpal 'byor bsgrub la dbang don gnyisalhun grub the tshom med sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thim ñtsā zhes pa 'da'ang lung zinakun bzang bstan 'aram̐n rgya mche'ibazhed ro ra/khe bo bdud 'dzams pad+ma gar dbang rtsal gyisadag par phab pa sarba masgo lo/

—11 dzam lha spug 'dzin dkar po'igasol mchod dgos 'dod char 'bebs bzhugs:—11) namo gu ru ya 11(15 'o chab mar gyi ral bu bshams sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangs bsgyur spel lhar gsal ting 'dzan brtan po yis mdun tu nor lha gsal bawa te kye rang mdun lnga ldan 'od 'khyil 1nga: sna tshogs pad+ma'i char 'bebs dbus: 'dod rgu'i phywa g.yang gter rdol 1nga: nor bdag 'phags pasmug 'ardzan dkar: phyag g.yas pad+ma'i lcags kyu yis: 'gro blo dbang du sdud par byed: g.yon pa rat+na'i gzhong pa bsnams: dgos 'dod longs spyod char ba 'bebs: dar dang rat+na'i rgyan rnams spras: phyed 'gyeng stabs kyi glang po'i khar 'dzum sgegs brjid pa'i lang tsho 'bar: thugs sgog dzaḥlas 'od 'phros pas: brtan g.yos dpal yon dwangs bcud bskul: sgrub pa po yi mthun rkyen dpal ma lus dbang du 'byor bar dmigs: ma dza bha la tsun+dha sarba rat+na bā su na na kha dhe bsdus bsdus:pa shaṃ ku ru hūṃ: brgya rtsa la sogs ci rigs brjod rnam bzhi'i phrin las lhun gyis grub sa ma yu kye

dgos 'dod char 'bebs 'phags pa sgrug 'dzin laḥ zas nor longs spyod bdog pa ci mchis 'bul: dgyes par rol la chos mthun dgos 'dod char: sgrub pa po yi mthunarkyen gsos su stsol: brgya stong la sogasagang skabs brjod de nas g.yang 'bod bya ba na bso: dbang gi lcagasakyu rno ba'i 'od zer gyis: brtan g.yos zas nor longs spyod phywa dang g.yang ma lus sgrub pa po yi dpal du stsol: bshad sgrub nyams len kun gyi gsos gyur cig: sirnyi hrī shis pa brjod cing smon lam gdab de 'bras bde legs dpal 'byor 'gyur sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang slob bu klong chen nas bskul ngor/nusaldan pas spel ba masko le/sgo 'phags ma'i rgyun khyer niḥ hrī: ma skyes rig pa chags bral la: bde chen rtogs pa'i skyabs su mchi: dug lnga'i myos pa'i sems can rnams: 'phags(khyo gsang ba gsum la bkod: hrī: bde stong klong yangs mkha' spyod zhing: sgyu 'phrul dag chen zhing bkod dbus: lhun grub 'od lnga'i gzhal med klong: chags pa'i rdul bral

——1 pad zla'i khar: rig pa hrī:las shar ba yi: ku ru kusgopad rag mdangs: zhi ma khro 'dzum sgegs nyams 'bar phyag bzhi pad+ma'i mda' bzhu dang: lcags zhags rgya yis 'khor 'das kyi: dpal yon dwangs bcud 'ub chub byed: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ro gdan brdzis: ye shes 'od 'bar me klong 'bye rig bdag snang ba mtha' yas gsal: thugs gar pad+ma 'dab drug sbubs: rig pat+t+waṃ:la sngags kyis bskor bzlas pas brtan g.yos dpal 'byor dang: lha 'dre mi gsum zas nor kun: sgrub pa po yis mthun rkyen gsos: ma lus dbang du gyur bsam la: snyen ku ru kul+le hrī bye ba bzlas pas nyams rtogs 'phel zas nor longs spyod dbang du 'gyur sa ma wā sngags kyi mchod rjes bstod pa ni trī: bde ba'i mthar son stong pa nyid: rjes chags bzhad pa'i 'dzum nyams can: brtan g.yo dbang du byed pa mo: ku ru kul+ler phyag 'tshal bstod: bdag niji srid 'tsho yi bar 'dod gro'i dpal yon mthun rkyen stsol: 'di 'og lha mo mchog byung te: mkha' sprod gnas su bsu ma mdzod: gal yang bsngo smon rgya cher gdab de nas g.yang 'bod bya ba na kye: bgachen

sbyin mdzad lha mo khyod nyid kyiḥ dbang gi lcags kyus brtan g.yo'i dge mtshan bskul: 'dir khug 'dir bsdus sgrub pa po la stsol: bskyed rdzogs nyams len mthar ru phyin par mdzod: skyid ku ru kul+le sirnyi hrī: shis pa brjod cing me tog 'thor de 'bras dge mtshan dpal gyis 'byor sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zim snyi zhes pa'ang dad ldan slob bu slong chen nas bskul ngor/nus ldan pas spel ba masgo le/ tshogasabasdus ni reyokheX dum gcig bhan+ta yangs pa'i nangaḥ bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs rnams bsags: myong grol ye shes bdud rtsir spel: 'phags ma'i dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul: rnal 'byer chags nyams rtog sgrib bshags: gzung 'dzin rgyu ba dhu tir sgrol: chos kun mnyam pa nyid du bstabs: dkyil mkhor lha tshogs dgyesapa bskang pham phab bzhes la phrin las sgrubs: bsod nams ye shes tshogs chenags nas dam pa sku gnyis thob par rdzogag: de ltar bul bas tshogs rdzogasashing sgrib dag don gnyis lhunagrub 'gyur sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thim snyi zhes pa' slob bu klong chen nas bskul ngor/nusaldan pasaspel ba maṅga lo/

badz+ra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dzam lha dkar po'i zab sgrub shin tu bsdus pa nor gyi gteramadzod bzhugs so:pa rte na mo gu ru padha ka ra yeḥ sa zanasnar jam rnal 'byer chos laspyod pa'i tshe mthun rkyen zas nor bsgrub pa' thabs dzam lha dkar po gter rgya mdzod de ya zab sgrub bsdus pa bstan sa ma pā 'ad la sbyor dngos rjes dang gsum dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni na mo: dgos 'dod kun 'byung ār+ya dzam bha la gtso 'khor sprul par bcas la skyabs su mchi: bdag gzhan dbul phongs rgud pa bsal ba'i phyir nor bdag 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor sgom par bya: de nas yan lag bdun pa niX na mo gter gyi bdag po ār+ya je bha lar: dngos 'byor yid sprul bkra shis rdzas rtags 'bul sgo gsum sdig sgrib sbyangs phyir gus phyag 'tshal: ma byin len dang ser sna byas pa bshags dgos 'dod kun 'byung gter la rjes yi rang: mdzad med zas nor gaṅga'i rgyun bzhin bskul: nad mug mtshon 'khrug ming med thugs rjes skyobs: dge tshogs bsdus te ma gyur 'gro la bsngo: bla med rdo rje 'dzin pa'i

sa thob 31ga: gnyis pa dngos gzhi lha bskyed bsgom pa niḥ hrī: snod bcud rnam dag zhing bkod phun sum tshogs: 'dod 'byung ljon bzang yan lag brgyad ldan mtsho: gser gyi bye ma g.yu yi ne'u seng: sman gyi spang ri sna tshogs ku mud bzhad: bya rigs ri dwags mang pos rtse 'jo byed: cang shes thal dkar bse ru 'dod 'jo'i ba: rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad: gter bum ma rmos lo tog bzhad pa'i dbus: rat+na'i gzhal med mjes shing yid 'ong ba: gru bzhi sgo khyud rta babs gdugs dog mdzes: de dbus yid bzhin nor bu spungs ba'i khar: 'ja' sprin sbrang char 'od gur 'khrigs pa'i klong be+e ram̐ḥlas byung ār+ya dzam bha la dkar dmar mdangs ldan 'dzum mdzes lang tshos 'khyud rat+na'i srog zhu pad+ma'i thod gdengs sbud: rin chen snyan cha dar dpyangs cod paṇa 'phur: smad dkris 'ja' sham rat+na'i phreng ba spras: phyag g.yas be con g.yon pas rte'u le 'dzin: dgos 'dod longs spyod sbrang char bzhin du 'bebs zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur g.yu 'brug gdan la rol nor gyi lha mo mched bzhi 'dud cing bzhugs: gco 'khor

bsgotshu lnga po'i thugs srog sa bon las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas spyan drangs bstims nor bdag dzam lha 'khor bcas dbyer med gyur bla rdo sgog 'khor sgrub pa'i rdzas la bzhugs: dgos 'dod phrin las bsgrub phyir gus phyag 'tshal: rmad byung phyi nang gsang mchod rgya mtsho 'bul: bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid sna bdun dang dar zab 'bru sman rin chen sna tshogs dang: ri dwags g.yung dgas chu gnas bya gcan dang: 'dod yon mdzad med nam mkha'i mdzod chen 'bul sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rdzogs la bstod: 'gal 'khrul nongs pa gang mchis bzod par gsol: bskyed pa'i thugs gar dza:la sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas snang srid 'khor 'das 'byung bzhi'i bcud: zas nor longs spyod char chen 'bebs par dmigs: snyen rdo bha la dza len+d+ra hrī dwa ya sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs gang 'os bskyar skabs su mchod cang bstod pa na hūṃ ༷ rnams dag mchod sprin rgya mtsho bsam mi khyab: bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid sna bdun dang: ngo mtshar yid 'ong bkod mdzes ma lus pa nor bdag ram̐ lha 'khor bcas

dgyes phyir 'bul: slo ma hā pañtsa pu dza ho: hū hrī: gter gyi bdag po ār+ya dzam bha la dbul phongs rgud sel yid bzhin nor lta bu sgrub pa po la longs spyod char 'debs pa 'gro ba'i dpal du gyur la phyag 'tshal bstod bdag gis yang dag byang chub bsgrub pa la: phyi nang nyer 'tshe ma lus kun zhi zhing tshe dpal 'byor ba nyams rtogs sgrub pa'i gso'i: gang 'dod gegs med chu bo'i rgyun bzhin stsol sarba sirnyi hrī: gsum pa g.yang 'bod bya ba ni bzang drug phud mchod bsang dud spro rol mo'i sgra bcas 'di skad do kyi: 'bod do gter bdag ār+ya dzam bha laX ma thogs gsang ba'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs: 'dod yon phud skyems bsangs dud mchod pa bzhes sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dgyes pa bskangs: dam tshig nyams chags ser sna 'jur 'gags bshags: sgrib bral tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol rnal 'byer bdag cag sgrub pa po rnams la tshangs pa lha yi phywa g.yang char bzhin phob: gtsug na rin chen klu yi nor g.yang stsol: dzam lha nyer gcig 'dod rgu'i phywa g.yang stsol: nor rgyun lha mo'i tshe bsod 'bru g.yang stsol 'jig rten

badz+ra khams kyi zas nor gos g.yang stsol:chos mthun bsam pa 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol:sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin pa'i chos g.yang stsol:sgrub tshugs ri la zin pa'i gnas khang stsol:'ja' lus 'od sku 'grub pa'i man ngag stsol:gol nor 'phrang kun bsal ba'i lam stegs stsol:tshe chos mtha' ru phyin pa'i bkra shis stsol:gzhan phan phrin las 'grub pa'i nus stobs stsol:bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: yul phyogs thams cad la bkra shis par gyur cig:sa gzhi thams cad la bcud chags par gyur cig:phun sum tshogs pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig:lan gsum la sogs ya yang brjod gnad des tshe dpal 'byor ba rgyas bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal the tshom mi gos grub 'bras 'byung sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'da'ang sbyan bdag bsod nams mkhas grub kya bskul ro ra/gter ming nus ldan pas spal ba dge legs 'phal/sarba maṅga le/

3 lngasaḥ gza' bdud dug sdong nag po'i zhi drag gi sgrub pa byed pa'i dran tho glen tshig mdo 'gags tsam bstan pa bzhugs so:00ཿ mi bdīd 'jigs rung srin zhal can: bka' gter rim dgu'i bstan srung ba: drang sgong smug nag 'od 'phro rgyal: bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzan khyod la 'dud de la 'dir gza' bdud dug sdong nag po'i zhi drag gi sgrub par 'jug 'dod pa rnams kyi: dbang gis smin cing dam tshig la gnas pa gal che/ dkyil 'khor ldeng khri thogamar gru gsum sum rum gyis nang du liṅga dang byang bu'i 'khor lo bkod/ de rgyab 'khor lo rtsib bzhi brtsam pas shar du dmar gtor nag po g.yon gcis dang phag dkar mtshon 'khor khur ba lhor gtor nag dang glang can mtshon cha'i sna can: nub gtor nag dang lce spyang mi ro khur ba: byang gtor nag dang stag mo ro la rngams pa: kun la mtshe dug khragayungs rtsangs dmar gis brgyan pa'o/ de rgyab 'khor lo rtsib brgyad la dgra gzugs re bkod rteng dmar gtor snying gis brgyan pa g.yas gcus brgyad gang ltar brgyan bcas

bkod de rgyab ling tshe nyer brgyad du bkod pas re'u mig rnams su mig nyer brgyad bkod: de rgyab mu khyud gcig la khrag byug yang mu khyud gcig la dug sna bkram de rgyab mu khyud la phung shul gyi sa dang rab chad khangs pas dreg pa mchod rten zhig po'i sa sna bkod: de rgyab mda' mdung gri dang rtsang drwa lcags zhag sgrogs dril la sogs pas bskor nas bzhag go: 'di ni drag bsgrub kyis dkyil 'khor bca' thabs yin/ zhi sgrub la rin po che'i snod du 'khor lo rtsib bzhir bkod pa'i lte bar nyi zla'i khar gza' bshos g.yas gcus kha gdong gi mtshan/ de rgyab gdong mo bzhi'i gtor ma g.yon gcus bzhi/ de rgyab gza' brgyad g.yas gcus brgyad/ de rgyab rgyu skar gyi bshos bu mig mtshan pa nyer brgyad/ gzhan yang nor sna 'dod yon bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid sna bdun gdugs me ru dar sogs kyis brgyan nas mdzes par bkod: dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gzhugs la mchod rdzas yo byad dpung mang rgya cher spro bzhin pas: phur nag dang rta nag la sogs yi dam gang rung gi bsnyen pa sngon du btang la las kyis gzhung 'dir 'jug pa

9)ཿ la/ thog mar shing rtsi sna tshogs kyis bsang sprin la ra sha tshil gyis gsur dud btang la/ sngags dang phyag rgyas spel nas bkod gcod rlung 'tshubs bya ba lani grangs bdun nam nyer gcig gang 'os brjod la gtor 'gugs btang / dug sdong nag po'i gnad zab me yi 'khor lo ltar/ rā: mdun du khrag mtsho sogs da tshur byon de nas gnad 'phyang dug gi me tog las/ snyan gsan dbab pa lan gsum dang / spyan 'dren btang mthar/ nam mkha' mdzod sngags kyis spel de/ rten 'dzug rin chen bang khang sbyar/ gzhung gi bzhugs gsol btang / a ka ro'i spel la/ mnga' gsol yid bzhin nor bu sbyar/ gzhung gi phyag 'tshal btang / nam mkha' mdzod sngags dang a ka ro'i spel la/ dam bsgrags gnam lcags rdo rje sbyar/ gzhung gi dam bsres dang mchod pa gnyis ka btang la/ kha ram̐ kha ༷'i bar ro/ sngags drug phyag drug spel la/ rgyug mchod phud bskang gnam lcags thog myur btang / gzhung nas/ bh+yo: gza' bdud dug sdong nag po'i zhal du sogs khrag gtor mchod la/ bstod pa bya/ gnyer gtad bum pa bzang po

btang / gzhung gi bshags pa btang la/ zab gnad me'i 'khor lo las/ yi dam gnad dbab sogs par dmigs bar/ skabs 'dir/ 'bod bskul thog mda' dmar pobatang / 'bod sngags chu bo'i bzhung ltar bzlas la rtags thon par bya'o/ gtor ma la dgra bgegs 'gugs bstims byas te/ drag gsol bstan dgra rdul brlag bdun nam nyer gcig dang / gsol mchod pha rol dpung 'joms la grangs 'dzin no/ zhi sgrub yin na/ gzhung gi mchod bstod dang / mjug gi bshags pa brtan bzhugs bcas la nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum de ltar du bskyal bzlas bya'o/ drags sgrub yin na/ mchod bstod byas la las mtha' gshin rje'i lto zhal ltar/ gser skyems kyi 'jug tu bod bskul thog zer ngar ma btang / gnad zab las/ srung ma'i skra mtshams su sogs/ rbad sngags la rgyun 'dzin/ dus su gtor ma la 'gugs bstims byas te/ drag bskang rgol 'joms spu gri'i 'khor lo la grangs 'dzin/ bsgral gzhung las/ gzu dpang gsol/ 'gugs pa lan mang bskyal mthar/ bsad bskul dug khrag khol ma btang /

()ཿ gnad zab las/ srungs ma me rlung sogs bsad sngags la rgyun 'dzin/ dus su za ngu dgra brdung tho ba grangs mang bskyal mthar/ khyad par las gcun reg phu nag po btang la/ lha dbye sngags la rgyun 'dzin pa dang / yang byang me btsa' dmar po btang la dgra bo lha srung dang dbye bar bya'o/ bsgral gzhung 'gugs 'ching sdom myos las bzhi btang / skabs 'dir khrag skyems gtor ma bshams la de la dgra bgegs 'gugs bstims nan du byas teḥ bskul ba gnam lcags thog ngar gtong ngo / bsgral gzhung ltar sngags gzhung la rgyun 'dzin de nas thun rdzas sna tshogs kyis gdab/ yang mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis gdab pa/ bsgral gzhung ltar la/ las gcun reg phung nag po'i mjug gi thun sna tshogs kyis gdab sngags/ badz+ra ma ra du na shag rbad sogs ma ra ya phaṭa/ bar la rgyun bzung nas dgra gzugs dum bur gtub cing brdung bcag sogs bya'o/ bstabs pa gnad 'phyangs ltar/ bh+yoḥ gza' bdud dug sdong nag po'i zhal du sogs mā ra ya rbad bh+yoḥ bstod pa yang bya bzlog pa mtshon cha'i 'khor lo lan gsum mam

9)ཿ pa'i phyir lho brag gnam skas brag dang gcig ma sang g.yu mtsho'i klong dang gnyis ri yi rgyal po gangs can gsum zab pa'i rgya bcas gter du bkodaḥ o rgyan sprul pa gcig gas rted bdud dang dmasricho dpung pham nas sku tshe mdzad 'phrin 'phel bar byedaḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang grogs rat+na sa ra'i bgo skal du gyur pa' rten 'brel gyis dbang gis mos blos bskul ngor kho bo gsang sngags mi bskyodagling pa'am mkha' mnyam ye shes rdo rjes mkha' 'gro bsang ba'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zin 'gyur med ming gis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga le/

rje'i bka' dam bzhinaḥ rlung las mgyogs pas da tshur byonaḥ yi dam gnad dbab srog gzir tsheX snying khrag lhud byung bdag la thob: drang srong srog 'phrog bran khol nas ci bcol phrin las sgrub par dmigasaḥ trīḥkṛ shag ru rag ram̐X na ge tsit+ta snyeḥ ma ma yo za steX ha nye yo ge sha la dza dzaX 'bod sngags chu bo'i gzhung ltar bzla 'du 'tshogasargyas rmi bya skad sgrogs rwa gzhob dra 'thul me 'od 'char 'bod pa'i rtags mtshan them pa'oḥ sa ma yu srung ma'i skra mtshams gnam lcags kyiḥ rdo rje phyed pa las spros pas lcags sdig bung ba'i gzir tsa na drang srong las la 'chun pa dngaḥ dgra yi steng du chas par dmigasaḥ hrī kri shag ru rag ram̐ḥ nā ge tsit+ta snyeX ma ma yo ga snyeḥ ha he yo ge sha la d+dhi tri a mu ka la rbad rbadaḥ rbad sngags tshag sgra thag thagabazla dmags dpung che shom stag seng zhen nyi zla gdan 'ding g.yosasbyor byed rbad pa 'i rtags tshad them pa'oḥ sa ma ya srung ma me rlung 'khor lo'i bskulaX nam mkhar dpag te dgra la chasaḥ 'byung lnga'i khams nas dregs tshogs bskul gnyis med bsres te gzi byin bskyed: ma nyes la yog zhe nas 'doraḥ shin tu 'khrugs nas chas par dmigasaḥ hrī kṛ shag ru ram̐ḥ nā ge tsit+ta

brgya bzla brten bzhugs niḥ hoḥ sngon nas dam sgog thob pas rā hu laḥ rtse gcig bsnyen sgrubs bsgom bzlas byed lags na lus dang grib bzhin 'bral med 'grogs pa dang phrin las gang bcol g.yel ba med par (6paX badz+ra sa ma ya rak+ta tiṣ+ṭha lhan me tog 'thor zhang rab tu gnas bsnyen pa bye ba gnad du che rbad bsad rnams kyang de yis byed smra bcad ting 'dzan ldan pasasgrogs bskang gsol dag la cher brtson cing mchod dzos yo byad rgya cher 'bul rtags 'byung tshe na mngon spyod las bskul bsad brlag las lhun gyis grub mthu yis grags pa rgyas par 'gyur ze tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ sam yāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥdziḥ zhes pa 'a bdud 'dul dpal gyis rdo rjes mnog chos soḥ sarba ma la/ / bkra shisani/ na mo drang don thabs mang lam gyis 'gro khams skyongs nges don lta spyod mdzad sgong rig 'dzin sminaḥ gza' yul gzung 'dzin bdud sgrol chos skur dag0 che ba'i dbang phyug mchog des shis pa stsol nus ldan pas so

9)ཿ regs phung dug sdong nag po'i srog tig rin po che'i ga'u bzhugs so mthing shog dri ma bral ba'i ngor rin chen dang po bzang drug bsreḥ mu khyud ram pa bcu ru bskor lte bar gza'ababyed dug sdong bri mu khyud gnyisapar 'khor rtsibs bzhir 'od lnga'i thig ler ma re 'god rtsib mchan la ni 'byung bzhi'i srogaḥ baṃ le re yi mchan no mu khyud gsum pa ra 'khor rtsibs brgyad ra yig re re'i mtshan par bya rtsibs mchan sde brgyad snyang po niḥ aḥya maḥduḥn tsamag na mchan mu khyud bzhi par 'bod sngags bri lnga pa la ni rbad sngags bkod dbu can tshag med dag par brtsam drug pa la ni mig nyer brgyad bdun pa la ni bsadasngags dgod brgyad par dbyangs gsal rten snying mthar sgrub pa po' nad gdon 'jags brgyad mi mthun pa'i phyogs ris ngan pa thams cad sharnye ku ru ye swā snya sgrub pa po' tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogasalas dbang rlung rtathams cad pu/ ku ru ye swā snya sgrub pa po'i zas nor lo sa sprod 'dod rgu'i phywa g.yang thams cad pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā snya sgrub pa po la nye bar 'tshe ba' dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po thams cad mā ra yu phaṭa swā snya dgu par 'dod gsola'adi ltar gdab hoḥ gza' bdud dug sdong nag po ma skrun gdung mo mched bzha sgrul pa' gza' chen rnam brgyad rgya skar nya shu rtsa brgyad bka'i lha phran sde brgyad sprul pa bran g.yog dang bcas pa rnams kyis sku gsung thugasayon tan phrin

9)ཿ bsgrub lhur blang na srung ma lus dang grib ltar 'grogasaḥ mngon spyod lhun grub dbang thob shog rtsa sngags mthar ba ling ta a bhi ṣiñtsa skye gza' sku gto laḥhrīḥsde brgyad gang gang sgog gi bdagaḥ 'jigs byed chen po mthu rtsal can gza' bdud dug sdong nag po yiḥ srog dbang dam pa thob par shog rtsa sngags mthar ka ya a bhi ṣiñtsa tsheḥr yig gto la /༷ 'khor 'das thams cad bskyed pa'i rgyu rang rang sa bon nyid las sgrub rgyu yis ma bskyed gang yang med bskyed byed yi ge'i dbang bskur bsaḥ gsung gi gsang ba yongs rdzogs 31ga rtsa sngags mtharaḥ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā me long gam laḥtrīḥ gzugs kun 'dzin pa'i a dar+sha dregs pa'i srog snying gsal bar byed mthong khol mngon sum 'byung ba'i dbangaḥ skal ldan khyod la yongs rdzogs shogaX rtsa sngags mtharaḥ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa 〉ཿ smon lam niḥhoḥ rigs kyi bu mchog dam pa khyed la gza' bdud dug sdong nag po'i srog gi dbang mchog dam pa bskur ba yin pas thob par gyur cigaḥ thob nas mngon sum dbang po'i yul du snang bar gyur cigaḥ snang nas 'bral ba med par lus dang grib
